data.Name: property
data.Description: Any SDM Property defined in this catalogue

data.Name: amount of substance per time per area
data.Description: was mole per time per area
data.Code: amount of substance per time per area

data.Name: acceleration
data.Description: The rate of variation of velocity with time.

data.Name: gravity
data.Description: Strength of the gravitational field at some location. Also referred to as the acceleration of gravity, measured in units of acceleration.

data.Name: x gravity
data.Description: Strength of the x-axis component of the gravitational field at some location.

data.Name: y gravity
data.Description: Strength of the y-axis component of the gravitational field at some location.

data.Name: z gravity
data.Description: Strength of the z-axis component of the gravitational field at some location; used to correct total z-axis acceleration of a logging tool to compute actual tool movement.

data.Name: x acceleration
data.Description: Acceleration along the X-axis.

data.Name: y acceleration
data.Description: Acceleration along the Y-axis.

data.Name: z acceleration
data.Description: Acceleration along the Z-axis.

data.Name: acoustic dispersion
data.Description: Variation of acoustic velocity with frequency. Dispersion may be normal (velocity decreases with frequency) or inverse (velocity increases with frequency).

data.Name: acoustic impedance
data.Description: Property which controls the propagation of an ultrasonic wave in a medium. It is the product of the material density and the acoustic wave velocity within the material.

data.Name: acoustic contrast
data.Description: Interface property which is the difference between the Acoustic Impedance values of two adjacent beds.

data.Name: elastic impedance
data.Description: Property which controls the propagation of a seismic wave at a particular (non-zero) angle of incidence. It is a function of the material density, the compressional wave velocity within the material, the ratio between the shear and the compressional wave velocities, and the angle of incidence. This property, analogous to Acoustic_Impedance but for non-zero incidence angles, is described in 1998 SEG Paper "Calibration and Inversion of Non-Zero Offset Seismic Data", by Patrick Connolly (BP).

data.Name: compressional impedance
data.Description: Acoustic impedance to compressional waves

data.Name: shear impedance
data.Description: Acoustic impedance to shear waves

data.Name: specific acoustic impedance
data.Description: The specific acoustic impedance is a ratio of acoustic pressure to specific flow, or flow per unit area, or flow velocity.

data.Name: address
data.Description: The location where some entity or information may be found or contacted.

data.Name: email address
data.Description: Address used for electronic mail, such as an Internet address (clinton@white_house.gov)

data.Name: phone number
data.Description: Telephone number

data.Name: alternate phone number
data.Description: Alternate phone number, including country code.

data.Name: fax number
data.Description: Telephone number used for FAX (facsimile) transmission and/or reception.

data.Name: postal address
data.Description: Location to which postal correspondence may be sent for a person, business or other entity.

data.Name: street address
data.Description: Physical location of a business, residence, or other installation, as would be used by a courier service or visitor to locate the installation.

data.Name: url
data.Description: Address of Worldwide Web site; acronym for Universal Resource Locator

data.Name: admittance
data.Description: The reciprocal of Impedance. The property of a medium to allow for the flow of an alternating current.

data.Name: adsorption
data.Description: The adhesion in an extremely thin layer of molecules (as of gases, solutes, or liquids) to the surfaces of solid bodies or liquids with which they are in contact

data.Name: amount
data.Description: Quantity, total number

data.Name: absolute abundance
data.Description: Quantity of members in a group, as expressed as a count and count units, such as 5 sacks, 3 boxes, or 4 items.

data.Name: amount of substance
data.Description: The amount of a particular substance (e.g. chemical) expressed in units of moles.

data.Name: initial amount
data.Description: Initial amount. Usually used to quantify the initial amount of some material.

data.Name: mass spectrum abundance
data.Description: The abundances of the molecular constituents of a material; may be represented as voltage of a flame ionization detector, amount relative to a standard solution or actual mass quantities.

data.Name: max amount
data.Description: Maximum Quantity

data.Name: min amount
data.Description: Minimum quantity, number of items.

data.Name: package size
data.Description: Quantity of material contained in each package. Unit depends upon the type of material and packaging.

data.Name: amount of substance per area
data.Description: was mole per area

data.Name: amplitude
data.Description: The extent or range of a property; especially, the maximum departure of a wave from its average value.

data.Name: acoustic amplitude
data.Description: A measure of the maximum departure of an acoustic wave from the average value

data.Name: analytic trace
data.Description: Complex seismic trace resulting from combination of input trace and its Hilbert transform. Normally represented as a pair of floating point numbers. [GeoFrame Value type: Complex32_t]

data.Name: apparent seismic polarity
data.Description: Sign of trace sample scaled with Reflection_Strength; used for seismic displays.

data.Name: cosine of phase
data.Description: Cosine of Instantaneous Phase, also known as normalized seismic amplitude

data.Name: instantaneous amplitude
data.Description: Amplitude component of an analytic seismic trace, when decomposed into amplitude and phase components (absolute value).

data.Name: reflection strength
data.Description: Amplitude of analytical seismic trace (Hilbert transform technique). Synonym of Instantaneous_Amplitude.

data.Name: cement bond amplitude
data.Description: A measure of acoustic wave amplitude used for cement bond evaluation.

data.Name: corridor stack
data.Description: A summation of the traces in an upgoing Vertical Seismic Profile that have been processed to retain only primary reflection events and that have been time-shifted to their two-way arrival times at the surface. Summation is over a data window (corridor) beginning at the first break time and usually ending 200-300 ms later.

data.Name: seismic arc length
data.Description: A measure of reflection heterogeneity which is used to quantify lateral changes in reflection patterns. Used as a stratigraphic sequence indicator.

data.Name: amplitude difference
data.Description: Amplitude difference between two interpretations. Usually, one interpretation is hand-picked and the other one snapped or smoothed (i.e. a slight modification of the first one).

data.Name: amplitude estimate
data.Description: Amplitude value on one side of an intersection

data.Name: avg amplitude
data.Description: Average (mean) value of amplitude.

data.Name: avg peak amplitude
data.Description: Average of the amplitudes of waveform peaks.

data.Name: avg trough amplitude
data.Description: Average of the amplitudes of waveform troughs.

data.Name: echo amplitude
data.Description: The amplitude of an echo signal.

data.Name: integrated trace
data.Description: The integral of an instantaneous attribute over a given interval.

data.Name: integrated apparent seismic polarity
data.Description: The integral of the Apparent Polarity trace over a given interval

data.Name: integrated cosine of phase
data.Description: The integral of the Cosine Of Phase trace over a given interval

data.Name: integrated instantaneous frequency
data.Description: The integral of the Instantaneous Frequency trace over a given interval

data.Name: integrated reflection strength
data.Description: The integral of the Reflection Strength trace over a given interval

data.Name: integrated seismic amplitude
data.Description: The integral of the Seismic Amplitude trace over a given interval.

data.Name: integrated seismic magnitude
data.Description: The integral of the absolute value of the Seismic Amplitude trace over a given interval.

data.Name: longitudinal amplitude
data.Description: Amplitude of the longitudinal component in multi-component seismic.

data.Name: max amplitude
data.Description: Maximum value of amplitude

data.Name: min amplitude
data.Description: Trace min amplitude

data.Name: noise amplitude
data.Description: The amplitude of noise or unwanted portion of a signal.

data.Name: pressure sensor noise
data.Description: Random changes in pressure sensor response.

data.Name: peak peak delta amplitude
data.Description: Amplitude difference between two peaks.

data.Name: peak trough delta amplitude

data.Name: post cursor amplitude
data.Description: Difference in seismic amplitude between a reference position and the corresponding deeper extreme.

data.Name: pre cursor amplitude
data.Description: Difference in seismic amplitude between a reference position and the corresponding shallower extreme.

data.Name: reflection heterogeneity
data.Description: An indirect measure of how much a reflection signal is changing or of how erratic a trace is. A constant has a Reflection_Heterogeneity of 0. Heterogeneity can be computed from any of several signals, including seismic data, instantaneous phase, instantaneous frequency, apparent polarity and reflection strength.

data.Name: heterogeneity cosine of phase
data.Description: Measure of heterogeneity computed from the Cosine of Phase trace over a given interval.

data.Name: heterogeneity instantaneous frequency
data.Description: Measure of heterogeneity computed from the Instantaneous Frequency trace over a given interval.

data.Name: heterogeneity instantaneous phase
data.Description: Measure of heterogeneity computed from the Instantaneous Phase trace over a given interval.

data.Name: heterogeneity reflection strength
data.Description: Measure of heterogeneity computed from the Reflection Strength trace over a given interval.

data.Name: heterogeneity seismic amplitude
data.Description: Measure of heterogeneity computed from the Seismic Amplitude trace over a given interval.

data.Name: rms amplitude
data.Description: Root Mean Square of amplitudes.

data.Name: rover amplitude
data.Description: Difference between seismic amplitude and the straight line connecting the two nearest extremes (with same kick).

data.Name: signal amplitude
data.Description: The amplitude associated with a generic type signal.

data.Name: sum amplitude
data.Description: Sum of the amplitudes

data.Name: sum negative amplitude
data.Description: Sum of amplitudes less than zero.

data.Name: sum positive amplitude
data.Description: Sum of amplitudes greater than zero.

data.Name: transverse amplitude
data.Description: Amplitude of transverse component in multi-component seismic.

data.Name: trough peak delta amplitude
data.Description: Amplitude difference between trough and peak.

data.Name: trough trough delta amplitude
data.Description: Amplitude difference between two troughs.

data.Name: volume reflection spectrum
data.Description: Volume Reflection Spectrum, i.e. spectral decomposition of the amplitude response in interval

data.Name: x transverse amplitude
data.Description: X component of Transverse_Amplitude in multi-component seismic.

data.Name: y transverse amplitude
data.Description: Y component of Transverse_Amplitude in multi-component seismic.

data.Name: z transverse amplitude
data.Description: Z component of Transverse_Amplitude in multi-component seismic.

data.Description: Signal Amplitude and Phase represented as a complex number in polar coordinates, in the form Ae^jP. The first component A is the amplitude; the second component P is the phase in degrees.

data.Name: angle per volume

data.Name: angular acceleration

data.Name: angular dispersion

data.Name: bowl speed

data.Name: differential speed

data.Name: motor speed
data.Description: The rotational speed of a motor.

data.Name: spinner speed

data.Name: tool rotation speed

data.Name: anisotropy
data.Description: Measure of the variation of a property based upon the direction in which it is measured.

data.Name: alkhalifah eta
data.Description: Alkhalifah's eta anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout Compressional velocities.

data.Name: interval alkhalifah eta

data.Name: stack alkhalifah eta

data.Name: bale kappa
data.Description: Bale's kappa, the mode-converted wave equivalent to eta, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout mode-converted wave velocities.

data.Name: interval bale kappa
data.Description: Interval value of Bale's kappa, the mode-converted wave equivalent to eta, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout Converted wave velocities, for each layer.

data.Name: stack bale kappa
data.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Bale's kappa, the mode-converted wave equivalent to eta, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout mode-converted wave velocities.

data.Description: Bale's xi, the shear wave equivalent to eta, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout shear wave velocities.

data.Name: interval bale xi
data.Description: Interval value of Bale's xi, the shear wave equivalent to eta, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout shear wave velocities, for each layer.

data.Name: stack bale xi
data.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Bale's xi, the shear wave equivalent to eta, describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout shear wave velocities.

data.Name: permittivity anisotropy
data.Description: Change in permittivity based upon the direction in which it is measured.

data.Name: resistivity anisotropy

data.Name: thomsen delta
data.Description: Thomsen's delta anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between vertical and moveout Compressional velocities.

data.Name: interval thomsen delta
data.Description: Interval value of Thomsen's delta anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between vertical and moveout Compressional velocities, for each layer.

data.Name: stack thomsen delta

data.Name: thomsen epsilon
data.Description: Thomsen's epsilon anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between vertical and horizontal Compressional velocities.

data.Name: interval thomsen epsilon
data.Description: Interval value of Thomsen's epsilon anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between vertical and horizontal Compressional velocities, for each layer.

data.Name: stack thomsen epsilon
data.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Thomsen's epsilon anisotropy parameter.

data.Name: thomsen gamma
data.Description: Thomsen's gamma anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between Horizontally polarized Shear (SH) velocities in the vertical and horizontal directions.

data.Name: interval thomsen gamma

data.Name: stack thomsen gamma
data.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Thomsen's gamma anisotropy parameter.

data.Name: thomsen sigma

data.Name: interval thomsen sigma
data.Description: Interval value of Thomsen's sigma anisotropy parameter, describing the relationship between Vertically polarized Shear (SV) velocities in the vertical direction and moveout SV velocity, for each layer.

data.Name: stack thomsen sigma
data.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Thomsen's sigma anisotropy parameter

data.Name: atomic number
data.Description: An experimentally determined number characteristic of a chemical element that represents the number of protons in the nucleus which in a neutral atom equals the number of electrons outside of the nucleus and that determines the place of the element in the periodic table.

data.Name: atomic weight
data.Description: The average relative weight of an element referred to some element taken as a standard; basis may be hydrogen with an atomic weight of 1, oxygen with an atomic weight of 16, or carbon with an atomic weight of 12.

data.Name: attenuation
data.Description: Loss in energy or reduction in sensitivity. In seismic work, loss in acoustic energy due to absorption, reflection, etc. which occurs between any two points of travel.

data.Name: acoustic attenuation
data.Description: The amount of reduction in the amplitude of an acoustic wave.

data.Name: response strength
data.Description: Reflection strength at local maximum of reflection intensity

data.Name: attenuation rate
data.Description: A measure of the rate of attenuation of a wave per unit length.

data.Name: acoustic attenuation rate
data.Description: A measure of the rate of attenuation of an acoustic wave per unit length.

data.Name: electromagnetic attenuation rate
data.Description: A measure of the rate of attenuation of an electromagnetic wave per unit length.

data.Name: bandwidth
data.Description: Effective frequency range, typically between the half-power points (the frequencies at which the power drops to half of the peak power). Bandwidth is occasionally represented by the central frequency of the band or as the difference between the lower and upper limits of the frequency band, but generally the absolute frequencies should be specified, such as by using Band_Low/High_Frequency properties or by using a complex value type with the Bandwidth property.

data.Name: bandwidth rating bias
data.Description: Statistical estimation of bandwidth of data within window. Aids in determining appropriate spectral operators for subsequent operations. Computation: Let the autocorrelation of the trace be A[i]. Then compute M = max(A) and S = sum(A[i]**2). The bandwidth rating bias B is then : B = M**2 / r(2 S - M**2), where r is the sample rate.

data.Name: bandwidth rating debias
data.Description: Statistical estimation of bandwidth of data within window. The bandwidth rating debias D is computed from the bandwidth rating bias B as follows: D = 5/3 B - 1/(s*n), where n is the number of sampled used in the computation. Generally more stable than Bandwidth_Rating_Bias, unless window is small.

data.Name: bending moment per length

data.Name: capacitance

data.Name: charge density

data.Description: Default Unit System used

data.Description: Code of an SDM Value Domain

data.Name: value type
data.Description: Code of value type of data

data.Name: value type code
data.Description: Code of value type of data

data.Name: depth value type
data.Description: Value type of depth data

data.Name: vertical datum code
data.Description: Code of the permanent Vertical Datum to which the local elevation reference is related. Typical Vertical Datums are "MSL" and "GL".

data.Name: coefficient
data.Description: A number which serves as a measure of some characteristic of a process, substance or device.

data.Name: affine coeff a
data.Description: Coefficient "A" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

data.Name: affine coeff b
data.Description: Coefficient "B" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

data.Name: affine coeff c
data.Description: Coefficient "C" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

data.Name: affine coeff d
data.Description: Coefficient "D" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

data.Name: affine coeff e
data.Description: Coefficient "E" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

data.Name: affine coeff f
data.Description: Coefficient "F" in an Affine transformation between two coordinate systems. The input and output coordinate systems may be local or projection systems.

data.Name: anelasticity factor
data.Description: Factor used to compute loss of wave energy due to anelasticity (deviation from a linear proportionality between stress and strain). Loss is computed as exp(-pi * f * Anelasticity_Factor).

data.Name: attenuation factor
data.Description: Coefficient used to quantify the attenuation of a plane wave: a wave traveling a distance X will be reduced by a factor of e**(-AX), where A is attenuation factor.

data.Name: avg sequence trend
data.Description: A coefficient that characterizes the upwards or downwards increasing conductivity trend within a given depth interval

data.Name: biot coefficient
data.Description: The proportion of fluid pressure in a material which acts to counterbalance overburden pressure. Used in the calculation of net overburden: P_eff = P_overburden - (Biot_Coefficient * P_fluid).

data.Name: capillary pressure function coeff
data.Description: Coefficients used in the capillary pressure function.

data.Name: consistency index
data.Description: The k parameter in the Power-Law and Herschel-Bulkley rheological models. The Power_Law model is "Shear_Stress=k times (Shear_Rate at the power of n)". The unit of k is traditionally lbf.sec^n/ft^2 or Pa.s^n.

data.Name: correction factor
data.Description: Coefficient used to correct data, such as for environmental effects.

data.Name: crossflow coefficient
data.Description: Characterization of the flow in the reservoir from one layer to another layer, usually known as "Omega" in Reservoir Dynamics

data.Name: decimation factor
data.Description: Number indicating the degree of data reduction from decimation (resampling at lower sampling frequency); e.g. a Decimation_Factor of 5 indicates that only every 5th input sample is retained as output.

data.Name: detection gain
data.Description: Coefficient used to adjust signal amplitude for detection of some event, such as the first arrival in a sonic waveform.

data.Name: gas deviation factor
data.Description: Dimensionless quantity expressing how a gas deviates from perfect gas law, commonly expressed by PV=ZnRT. Sometimes named Gas Compressibility Factor, but NOT the same as Gas_Compressibility. Z usually varies from 0.7 to 1.2.

data.Name: inertial flow correlation coef
data.Description: Cooke's inertial fracture flow correlation coefficient (b). Empirical coefficient relating Fracture inertial flow coefficient Beta to Fracture permeability. Non RP66 Unit

data.Name: j function coeff
data.Description: Coefficients used in the J function, a function used to normalize capillary pressure to account for differences in permeability, porosity, and fluid systems.

data.Name: klinkenberg factor
data.Description: Empirical conversion factor used to estimate Klinkenberg permeability from measured gas permeability.

data.Name: longitudinal dispersivity coefficient
data.Description: A coefficient used as a multiplier of interstitial velocity to estimate dispersion in the direction of movement for a displacement front in permeable media.

data.Name: mre latitude coefficient
data.Description: Coefficient for a latitude term in a multiple regression equation for computing geodetic datum shifts.

data.Name: mre longitude coefficient
data.Description: Coefficient for a longitude term in a multiple regression equation for computing geodetic datum shifts.

data.Name: noise coefficient
data.Description: Noise coefficient of pressure sensor

data.Name: normalization factor
data.Description: Coefficient used to normalize data for comparison or correlation.

data.Name: nrm factor
data.Description: NRM factor

data.Name: relative permeability function coeff
data.Description: Coefficients used in the function.

data.Name: sayers anellipticity
data.Description: Sayers' normalized anellipticity factor, an alternative to eta for describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout compressional velocities.

data.Name: interval sayers anellipticity
data.Description: Interval value of Sayers' normalized anellipticity factor an alternative to eta for describing the relationship between horizontal and moveout compressional velocities, for each layer.

data.Name: stack sayers anellipticity
data.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Sayers' normalized anellipticity factor.

data.Name: scale factor
data.Description: Coefficient used to convert or correct data, as to some standard.

data.Name: geocentric s
data.Description: Scale factor used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

data.Name: geocentric scale factor
data.Description: Scale factor used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

data.Name: map scale factor
data.Description: The ratio of the scale along the meridian or along the parallel at a given point to the scale at some map point or along some line; each point on the map has a distinct value.

data.Name: projection scale factor
data.Description: Scale Factor which is used as a defining parameter for a projection, typically taken along the Central Meridian or along one of the major parallels

data.Name: projection scale reduction
data.Description: A number by which the scale along a designated meridian, great circle, or parallel is reduced or enlarged during the projection process to reduce the scale error elsewhere in the projection.

data.Name: scale x
data.Description: Scale factor in X dimension

data.Name: scale y
data.Description: Scale factor in Y dimension

data.Name: scale z
data.Description: Scale factor in Z dimension

data.Name: property multiplier
data.Description: An arbitrary multiplier applied to properties in a simulation

data.Name: schoenberg ellipticity
data.Description: Schoenberg's ellipticity factor, the ratio of horizontal to vertical velocity

data.Name: interval schoenberg ellipticity
data.Description: Interval value of Schoenberg's ellipticity factor, for each layer.

data.Name: stack schoenberg ellipticity
data.Description: Effective value through the subsurface of Schoenberg's ellipticity factor, for each layer.

data.Name: total geometric spreading
data.Description: The total effect of geometric spreading along ray. Factor giving the reduction in seismic amplitude (less than 1) due to spreading of the wave between two points. Includes both spherical divergence and cylindrical divergence.

data.Name: transverse dispersivity coefficient
data.Description: The coefficient used as a multiplier of interstitial velocity to estimate dispersion normal to the direction of movement for a displacement front.

data.Name: transverse isotropy coefficient
data.Description: The degree of transverse isotropy in a medium; that is, having the different property values when measured within or normal to a plane. Usually represented by the 5 coefficients of the Stiffness matrix: C11, C13, C33, C44, C66.

data.Name: z factor
data.Description: The factor which corrects for the deviation of a gas from the ideal gas law when calculating PVT relationships.

data.Name: coherence
data.Description: A measure of the similarity between two or more functions; used with seismic waveforms to distinguish seismic events and to implement automatic picking schemes.

data.Name: semblance
data.Description: A measure of waveform coherence with respect to slowness and time, computed as a function of coherent energy to total energy; also called "Slowness_Time_Coherence"

data.Name: slowness time coherence
data.Description: A measure of waveform coherence with respect to slowness and time, computed as a function of coherent energy to total energy; also called "Semblance"

data.Name: color
data.Description: The aspect of objects and light sources that may be described in terms of hue, lightness, and saturation for objects and hue, brightness, and saturation for light sources.

data.Name: color distribution
data.Description: A descriptive remark with respect to the distribution of a color within the area of a rock surface; e.g. solid, spotty, streaky.

data.Name: color fluorescent light
data.Description: The color emitted by the fluid upon exposure to fluorescent light. Certain photoactive hydrocarbon molecules display characteristic color patterns under these conditions.

data.Name: color intensity
data.Description: A descriptive comment with respect to the intensity of color; e.g. bright, dull, powdery.

data.Name: color map
data.Description: Name of entity which maps from Implementation index values to color; GPD_COLOR_MAP arrays are commonly used.

data.Name: color normal light
data.Description: The color of a hydrocarbon show under normal incident light.

data.Name: lithologic color
data.Description: The characteristic color of a lithologic sample.

data.Name: spore color index
data.Description: Relative color of fossil spores as caused by thermal processes. Index is used as an indicator of thermal maturation of organic material.

data.Name: companion data
data.Description: Collection to hold miscellaneous competitor data in any form (parameters, arrays, ...), not described in the Data Model

data.Name: compliance
data.Description: The relationship of strain to stress, a tensor quantity expressible as the inverse of the stiffness matrix.

data.Name: compressibility
data.Description: The change in specific volume and density under pressure; the reciprocal of Bulk Modulus, 1/k.

data.Name: gas compressibility
data.Description: Change in gas volume per unit volume per change in pressure (dV/V.dp) at a given pressure and temperature.

data.Name: matrix compressibility
data.Description: The compressibility of a homogeneous solid material.

data.Name: oil compressibility
data.Description: The compressibility of oil at a given pressure and temperature.

data.Name: pore volume compressibility
data.Description: The relative change in the pore volume of a rock under conditions of changing confining pressure.

data.Name: produced fluid compressibility
data.Description: Compressibility of the Total Produced Fluid for the Hydraulic Unit. It is corrected from Reservoir_Fluid_Compressibility by taking into account the actual volume fractions produced based on the saturation of the fluid within the reservoir.

data.Name: reservoir fluid compressibility
data.Description: Compressibility of the reservoir fluid

data.Name: rock compressibility
data.Description: Compressibility of the rock matrix.

data.Name: total compressibility
data.Description: Compressibility of the rock matrix combined with fluid compressibilities within the matrix.

data.Name: water compressibility
data.Description: The compressibility of water at a given pressure and temperature.

data.Name: concentration
data.Description: The relative content of a component; e.g., the concentration of salts in brackish water, the concentration of electric charges in a circuit, etc.

data.Name: acid concentration
data.Description: Concentration of acid.

data.Name: alkalinity
data.Description: Concentration of basic anions in an aqueous solution (e.g. OH-, CO3-- and HC03-)

data.Name: mud filtrate methyl orange alkalinity mf
data.Description: The volume ratio of 0.02 normal (N/50) standard sulfuric acid (Mf_Titration_Volume) including that amount required for the Pf endpoint (Pf_Titration_Volume) to mud filtrate, API RP13 Section 8, Chemical Analysis.
data.Code: mud filtrate methyl orange alkalinity mf

data.Name: mud filtrate phenolphthalein alkalinity pf
data.Description: The volume ratio of 0.02 normal (N/50) standard sulfuric acid (Pf_Titration_Volume) to mud filtrate volume, API RP13 Section 8, Chemical Analysis.

data.Name: mud phenolphthalein alkalinity pm
data.Description: The volume ratio of 0.02 normal (N/50) standard sulfuric acid (Pm_Titration_Volume) to mud volume in API Mud Phenolphthalein Alkalinity test (API RP13 Section 8, Chemical Analysis).

data.Name: aluminum concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Aluminum by weight.

data.Name: c2h6 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of C2H6 by volume. Typical value in natural gas 6%.

data.Name: c3h8 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Propane (C3H8); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 2%.

data.Name: c4h10 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Butane (C4H10).

data.Name: c5h12 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Pentane (n-C5H12).

data.Name: c6h14 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Hexane (C6H14); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.3%.

data.Name: c7h16 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Heptane (C7H16)

data.Name: c7plus concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Heptane and hydrocarbons heavier than Heptane; typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.5%

data.Name: cation concentration
data.Description: The concentration of cations, the positively charged particles, in volume of material.

data.Name: cesium concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Cesium.

data.Name: ch4 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Methane (CH4); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 85%.

data.Name: chloride concentration
data.Description: Concentration of chloride ions in water based mud or in the water phase of oil based bud

data.Name: co concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Carbon Monoxide (CO)

data.Name: cobalt concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Cobalt.

data.Name: concentration 1
data.Description: Concentration or proportion of first component in mixture or other composition.

data.Name: max concentration 1
data.Description: Maximum concentration or proportion of first component

data.Name: min concentration 1
data.Description: Minimum concentration or proportion of first component

data.Name: concentration 2
data.Description: Concentration or proportion of second component in mixture or other composition.

data.Name: max concentration 2
data.Description: Maximum concentration or proportion of second component

data.Name: min concentration 2
data.Description: Minimum concentration or proportion of second component

data.Name: concentration 3
data.Description: Concentration or proportion of third component in mixture or other composition.

data.Name: max concentration 3
data.Description: Maximum concentration or proportion of third component

data.Name: min concentration 3
data.Description: Minimum concentration or proportion of third component

data.Name: concentration 4
data.Description: Concentration or proportion of fourth component in mixture or other composition.

data.Name: max concentration 4
data.Description: Maximum concentration or proportion of fourth component

data.Name: min concentration 4
data.Description: Minimum concentration or proportion of fourth component

data.Name: gel concentration
data.Description: Concentration of gelled fluid (fracturing gel, gelled acid ...)

data.Name: i c4h10 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of iso-Butane (i-C4H10); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.3%.

data.Name: i c5h12 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of iso-Pentane (i-C5H12); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.3%.

data.Name: i c6h14 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of iso-Hexane (i-C6H14).

data.Name: lime concentration
data.Description: Lime content in water based mud as determined per API RP13P Section 8

data.Name: liquid concentration
data.Description: Concentration of liquid

data.Name: loss on ignition
data.Description: Proportion by weight of a sample which remains after the sample has been heated (e.g. 1000 degC) in an oxygen atmosphere and the volatile oxides evaporated.

data.Name: loss on ignition h2o plus
data.Description: Volatile Hydrogen component of Loss On Ignition, sometimes abbreviated H2O+.

data.Name: molar concentration
data.Description: The ratio of the number of moles of a material in a sample to the volume of the sample.

data.Name: mole fraction
data.Description: The ratio of the number of moles of a component to the total number of moles present.

data.Name: co2 mole fraction
data.Description: Mole fraction of Carbon Dioxide to total gas composition

data.Name: h2s mole fraction
data.Description: Mole fraction of Hydrogen Sulfide to total gas composition

data.Name: hydrogen mole fraction
data.Description: Mole fraction of Hydrogen to total gas composition

data.Name: nitrogen mole fraction
data.Description: Mole fraction of Nitrogen to total gas composition

data.Name: mud chloride concentration
data.Description: Concentration of chlorides in mud.

data.Name: mud nitrate concentration
data.Description: Concentration of nitrates in mud.

data.Name: n c4h10 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Normal Butane (n-C4H10); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.6%.

data.Name: n c5h12 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Normal Pentane (n-C5H12); typical volume concentration in natural gas is 0.25%.

data.Name: n c6h14 concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Normal Hexane (n-C6H14).

data.Name: neo-c5 concentration
data.Description: Neo-pentane gas concentration as a volume fraction of the drilling fluid

data.Name: ph
data.Description: An indicator of the degree of acidity or basicity of an aqueous solution. A value of 7 denotes a neutral fluid, lower values correspond to acidic fluids and higher values to basic fluids.

data.Name: polyol concentration
data.Description: Polyol Concentration per fluid Volume (Polyol are glycol-glycerol alcohol derivatives)

data.Name: potassium concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Potassium by weight.

data.Name: potassium ion concentration
data.Description: Potassium K+ cation concentration

data.Name: salinity
data.Description: Concentration of the total salts in solution (Na, K, Cl, So4, ..).

data.Name: borehole salinity
data.Description: Salinity of the fluid in the borehole.

data.Name: mud filtrate salinity
data.Description: Salinity of mud filtrate

data.Name: water salinity
data.Description: Total salts in solution (Na, K, Cl, So4, ..). Normal sea water has around 35,000 ppm (parts per million) salinity. Less than 2,000 ppm is considered "fresh".

data.Name: bound water salinity
data.Description: Salinity of the water bound to clays in the formation

data.Name: solids concentration
data.Description: Solid Concentration (Cutting, clays, polymer) per fluid Volume

data.Name: hgs concentration
data.Description: High gravity solids Concentration

data.Name: lgs concentration
data.Description: Low gravity solid Concentration

data.Name: sand concentration
data.Description: Sand content per Mud Volume, API RP13B, Section 5, Sand

data.Name: conductance
data.Description: The readiness with which a material conducts electric current; the inverse of resistance. Also, the product of conductivity and thickness.

data.Name: profile conductance
data.Description: Measurement related to conductance but not necessarily scaled or calibrated for quantitative use.

data.Name: conductivity
data.Description: A measure of the quantity of electricity transferred across unit area per unit potential gradient per unit time. In isotropic material, it is the reciprocal of Resistivity. Sometimes called Specific Conductance.

data.Name: array conductivity
data.Description: Formation conductivity as measured by a device capable of taking measurements at various combinations of resolution, depth of investigation, azimuth; such surveys allow detailed investigation of the invasion profile.

data.Name: array induction conductivity
data.Description: Formation conductivity as measured by an induction device capable of taking measurements at various combinations of resolution, depth of investigation, azimuth; such surveys allow detailed investigation of the invasion profile.

data.Name: array laterolog conductivity
data.Description: Formation conductivity as measured by a laterolog device capable of taking measurements at various combinations of resolution, depth of investigation, azimuth; such surveys allow detailed investigation of the invasion profile.

data.Name: bound water conductivity
data.Description: Conductivity of water bound to clay in the formations.

data.Name: deep conductivity
data.Description: The conductivity which represents a measurement made several feet into the formation; generally considered a measurement of the undisturbed formation.

data.Name: deep induction conductivity
data.Description: The conductivity, measured by an induction log, which represents a measurement made several feet into the formation; generally considered a measurement of the undisturbed formation.

data.Name: deep laterolog conductivity
data.Description: The conductivity, measured by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, which represents a measurement made several feet into the formation; generally considered a measurement of the undisturbed formation.

data.Name: fluid conductivity
data.Description: The electric conductivity of a fluid

data.Name: mud conductivity
data.Description: The electric conductivity of mud

data.Name: mud conductivity in
data.Description: The electric conductivity of mud going into the hole, usually measured in the active circulating pit

data.Name: mud conductivity out
data.Description: The electric conductivity of mud coming out of the hole, usually measured in the ditch before the shale shakers

data.Name: flushed zone conductivity
data.Description: The conductivity of the zone immediately behind the mudcake and which is considered to be flushed by mud filtrate, i.e., it is considered to have all mobile formation fluids displaced from it.

data.Name: formation conductivity
data.Description: Formation Conductivity

data.Name: medium conductivity
data.Description: The conductivity which represents a measurement made approximately two to three feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contain fluids which are a mixture of mud filtrate, connate water and possibly hydrocarbons.

data.Name: medium induction conductivity
data.Description: The conductivity, made by an induction log, which represents a measurement made approximately two to three feet into the formation.

data.Name: medium laterolog conductivity
data.Description: The conductivity, measured by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, which represents a measurement made approximately two to three feet into the formation.

data.Name: micro conductivity
data.Description: A measurement of the conductivity of the formation within the first few inches of the borehole wall.

data.Name: micro laterolog conductivity
data.Description: A measurement of the conductivity of the formation, by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, within the first few inches of the borehole wall.

data.Name: micro spherically focused conductivity
data.Description: A measurement of the conductivity of the formation, by a spherically focused tool, within the first few inches of the borehole wall.

data.Name: mineral conductivity
data.Description: Mineral Conductivity

data.Name: profile conductivity
data.Description: Conductivity profile measurement, used primarily for pattern recognition; may or may not be calibrated.

data.Name: shallow conductivity
data.Description: The conductivity which represents a measurement made approximately one to two feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contains fluids which are comprised primarily of mud filtrate.

data.Name: shallow induction conductivity
data.Description: The conductivity, measured by an induction log, which represents a measurement made approximately one to two feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contains fluids which are comprised primarily of mud filtrate.

data.Name: shallow laterolog conductivity
data.Description: The conductivity, measured by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, which represents a measurement made approximately one to two feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contains fluids which are comprised primarily of mud filtrate.

data.Name: spherically focused conductivity
data.Description: The conductivity, measured by a spherically focused log, which represents the resistivity approximately one to two feet into the formation.

data.Name: water conductivity
data.Description: Conductivity of Connate Water (in formation)

data.Name: continuous
data.Description: Abstract property intended to serve as a root of numeric properties with unit labels

data.Name: correction
data.Description: Correction applicable to a measurement, to remove environmental effects or measurement errors; the unit quantity is determined by that of the data.

data.Name: amplitude correction
data.Description: Amplitude correction applied to one side of an intersection

data.Name: kb receiver correction
data.Description: Correction vector to receiver position relative to Kelly Bushing

data.Name: kb source correction
data.Description: Correction vector to source position relative to Kelly Bushing

data.Name: msl receiver correction
data.Description: Correction vector to receiver position relative to Mean Sea Level.

data.Name: msl source correction
data.Description: Correction vector to source position relative to Mean Sea Level.

data.Name: nominal receiver correction
data.Description: Nominal correction vector to receiver position

data.Name: nominal source correction
data.Description: Nominal correction vector to source position

data.Name: count
data.Description: A number indicating the number of occurrences of something.

data.Name: acid treatment count
data.Description: Number of acid jobs

data.Name: bit revolution count
data.Description: The number of revolutions of the bit since it started drilling

data.Name: bore count
data.Description: Number of bores, as in a production packer.

data.Name: burner head count
data.Description: Number of heads of the burner (conventionally, 3,4 or 6)

data.Name: byte count
data.Description: Total number of bytes used or required by a collection of data.

data.Name: ads blocking factor
data.Description: Blocking factor for the Array Data Server

data.Name: digital storage
data.Description: Total number of bytes being stored

data.Name: record length
data.Description: Total record length in bytes, such as for a seismic trace header.

data.Name: cardinality
data.Description: Number of instances of an Entity type which may be referred to by another Entity in a particular relationship; may be ONE or MANY.

data.Name: cell count
data.Description: Number of cells

data.Name: centralizer count per joint
data.Description: Number of centralizers per joint, e.g. 2 per joint.

data.Name: compartment count
data.Description: Number of independent storage units

data.Name: completion count
data.Description: The count of the number of completions.

data.Name: core box count
data.Description: The number of core boxes containing samples from a cored borehole interval in a particular well.

data.Name: cutter count
data.Description: Number of cutters, as for drilling hole openers and reamers.

data.Name: cycle sample count
data.Description: Target number of samples per hour.

data.Name: dimension count
data.Description: The number of dimensions for an object or a representation of such an object, e.g. dimensions of an array.

data.Name: element count
data.Description: The number of elements, usually in an array or along an axis.

data.Name: max element count
data.Description: Maximum number of elements in a group or collection.

data.Name: min element count
data.Description: Minimum number of elements in a group or collection.

data.Name: mute taper length
data.Description: Number of samples muted in the traces

data.Name: fold cdp
data.Description: Number of traces stacked at a CDP.

data.Name: gauge count
data.Description: Number of gauges

data.Name: horizon sample count
data.Description: Number of horizon samples to use while smoothing.

data.Name: interpretation grid count
data.Description: Number of Interpretation grids that exist for the horizon.

data.Name: job count
data.Description: Number of jobs performed or included.

data.Name: joint count
data.Description: The number of joints of tubular goods.

data.Name: level count
data.Description: Number of levels in a sequence or portion of a sequence, such as in a hierarchy.

data.Name: material addition count
data.Description: Number of packaging units of chemicals added to the drilling fluid. (e.g., Add 5 sacks of Barite C100 100lb/sack to the drilling fluid)

data.Name: max data set count
data.Description: Maximum number of Data Set

data.Name: max gauge count
data.Description: Maximum number of Gauges possible with this type of Equipment

data.Name: max sequence count
data.Description: Maximum Sequence Count

data.Name: nom station increment
data.Description: Nominal increment in station number for consecutive stations

data.Name: non zero sample count
data.Description: Number of samples that do not have a value of zero.

data.Name: nozzle count
data.Description: The number of nozzles in an equipment item, such as a drill bit.

data.Name: perforation count
data.Description: Total number of perforations over the perforated interval

data.Name: personnel count
data.Description: Headcount of personnel satisfying role of Personnel_Role; these may be implemented as lists.

data.Name: personnel on board
data.Description: Count of number of people on board the vessel or structure.

data.Name: plunger count
data.Description: Number of plungers e.g. 3 for a triplex pump.

data.Name: population
data.Description: A count of the number of persons or objects.

data.Name: port count
data.Description: Number of ports, such as in a Coiled Tubing BHA

data.Name: qhse report count
data.Description: Number of QHSE reports issued for the reporting period

data.Name: receiver group count
data.Description: Total number of receiver groups attached to the cable

data.Name: rotor lobe count
data.Description: Number of rotor lobes in a drill motor configuration (PDM only). Note: Stator is equal to rotor plus one.

data.Name: sample count
data.Description: Number of samples.

data.Name: screen count
data.Description: Number of Screens

data.Name: sequence increment
data.Description: The non-zero, positive integer indicating the difference between index values of a sequence, most commonly "1".

data.Name: simulation multiple count
data.Description: Number of multiple reflections considered in the simulation

data.Name: solids control cone count
data.Description: Number of cones of a solid Control Equipment

data.Name: stage count
data.Description: Number of stages in an activity.

data.Name: stroke count
data.Description: Cumulative number of strokes over a time interval

data.Name: summed traces number

data.Name: zero crossing count

data.Name: critical volume

data.Name: current density

data.Name: data compression rate
data.Description: The rate at which data is compressed

data.Name: data mask
data.Description: Data pattern which allows storage and access of several types of independent data within a simple representation; common masks use individual bits of integer representations, or individual characters of string representations, to carry independent information.

data.Name: computation mask
data.Description: Application-specific mask for the computation options (one Anadrill example: 0001 - Torque and Drag, 0010 - BHA Tendency, 0100 - Bit Side Forces, 1000 - Buckling, 10000 - Yield Stress)

data.Name: drill operation mask
data.Description: Mask for the drilling operating mode, such as 0001 - Rotating, 0010 - Sliding, 0100 - Reaming, 1000 - Trip in, 10000 - Trip out

data.Name: snap criteria
data.Description: Set of parameters used by an application for "snapping" interpretation values to their corresponding data samples

data.Name: user data ident
data.Description: User-defined mask

data.Name: user evaluation code
data.Description: Auxiliary user-defined mask

data.Name: density
data.Description: The density (mass per unit volume) of a material. Usually at Standard conditions (STP). Also used to indicate the frequency of occurrence.

data.Name: api gravity
data.Description: A measure of hydrocarbon density equal to 141.5/(specific gravity @ 60 degF) - 131.5; usually reported with a temperature.

data.Name: avg density
data.Description: Average value of the material density.

data.Name: bulk density
data.Description: Density of bulk material, including any void space or other materials contained in the subject volume. In well logging, it is the density of the rock, including fluid-filled pore space, as measured with a "Gamma-Gamma" type logging device.

data.Name: electron density
data.Description: Electron density. Gamma-gamma logging techniques respond to electron density, which is near bulk density for most formation types.

data.Name: litho density
data.Description: Formation density as measured with a Litho-Density or Gamma-Gamma type logging tool; conventionally abbreviated RHOB.

data.Name: cement density
data.Description: The density or weight per unit volume of cement (or cement slurry).

data.Name: density in
data.Description: Density of the input material, such as the drilling fluid in the mixing tank.

data.Name: density out
data.Description: Density of the output fluid, such as the drilling fluid returning from the well annulus.

data.Name: filter cake density
data.Description: Density of the filter cake (mudcake).

data.Name: fluid density
data.Description: Density of a fluid sample; e.g., from Borehole, Formations, Cores, etc. Also density of cement.

data.Name: frame density
data.Description: Bulk density of the solid frame of the rock. The solid frame of the rock includes the porosity but not the content of the pore spaces. Frame_Density = (1 - Porosity) * Grain_Density.

data.Name: gas density
data.Description: Density of gas (air, hydrocarbon, etc.) at a particular temperature and/or pressure; e.g., gas density at well bottomhole conditions or at well surface conditions.

data.Name: grain density
data.Description: The density of a unit volume of a mineral or other rock material at zero porosity. Sometimes called Matrix Density.

data.Name: net reservoir core grain density point match
data.Description: Average grain density in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from core data by point-match method.
data.Code: net reservoir core grain density point match

data.Name: net reservoir log grain density point match
data.Description: Average grain density in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from log data by point-match method.
data.Code: net reservoir log grain density point match

data.Name: hydrocarbon density
data.Description: Density of hydrocarbons.

data.Name: interval density
data.Description: Interval value of the material density (density for a layer).

data.Name: matrix density
data.Description: Synonym of Grain_Density. The density of the material in a porous system that is not within the pores.

data.Name: max density
data.Description: Maximum density

data.Name: min density
data.Description: Minimum density

data.Name: mineral density
data.Description: The density of a mineral.

data.Name: shale density
data.Description: The density of shale cuttings

data.Name: mud density
data.Description: The density of mud, or drilling fluid, used during drilling operations.

data.Name: critical mud density
data.Description: The mud density that initiates formation shear or tensile failure.

data.Name: equivalent circulating density
data.Description: Drilling fluid density that would be required to produce the same effective borehole pressure as the combination of fluid density, circulating pressure and cuttings loading of the drilling fluid in the wellbore.

data.Name: fit equivalent mud weight
data.Description: Equivalent mud weight determined by the formation integrity test (FIT) for a new formation below last casing shoe via increasing the pressure until a pre-determined value.

data.Name: lot equivalent mud weight
data.Description: Equivalent mud weight determined by the leak off test (LOT) for a new formation below last casing shoe via increasing the pressure until the formation starts taking fluid.

data.Name: max mud density
data.Description: Maximum allowable mud density

data.Name: mud density in
data.Description: The density of mud going into the hole, usually measured in the active circulating pit

data.Name: mud density out
data.Description: The density of mud coming out of the hole, usually measured in the ditch before the shale shakers

data.Name: oil density
data.Description: The density of oil.

data.Name: partial density
data.Description: Apparent density of a component (fluid, gas, etc.) in the presence of other components. The sum of the partial densities equals total density.

data.Name: proppant density
data.Description: The density of the proppant material

data.Name: reservoir fluid density
data.Description: The density of the reservoir fluid i.e. the mixture oil, gas and water.

data.Name: specific gravity
data.Description: The ratio of the density of a substance to the density of some other substance taken as a standard (e.g. water, hydrogen).

data.Name: c7plus specific gravity
data.Description: Specific Gravity versus air at standard conditions of the Heptane (C7H14) and heavier component found in crude oil

data.Name: gas gravity
data.Description: The ratio of the molecular weight of the gas to that of air

data.Name: dry gas gravity
data.Description: The ratio of the molecular weight of the dry gas to that of air (Dry gas = free gas without condensate)

data.Name: wet gas gravity
data.Description: The ratio of the molecular weight of the wet gas to that of air (Wet gas - mixture of free gas plus condensate)

data.Name: matrix specific gravity
data.Description: Specific gravity of the rock matrix. Typical value is 2.7 .

data.Name: oil gravity
data.Description: The ratio of the density of the produced or reservoir oil to that of pure water at atmospheric conditions. See also API_Gravity

data.Name: water gravity
data.Description: The ratio of the density of the produced or reservoir water to that of pure water at atmospheric conditions

data.Name: water density
data.Description: The density of water.

data.Name: general weather description

data.Name: grain distribution

data.Name: legal description

data.Name: litho description

data.Name: occurrence

data.Name: resolution description
data.Description: Textual description of the qualified resolution, e.g., 0.005 psi at greater than 4 s sampling rate, 0.01 psi at 1 s sampling rate.

data.Name: show description
data.Description: A textual description of the hydrocarbon shows in a rock sample.

data.Name: show distribution
data.Description: A textual description of the distribution of hydrocarbon indicators on a rock surface; e.g. solid, spotty, streaky.

data.Name: show flow rate
data.Description: A textual description of the rate at which fluid emerges from the rock sample. Example keywords include: dead oil, live show, streaming or bleeding.

data.Name: show quality

data.Name: spot description
data.Description: The fractional part of interest within the section

data.Name: text

data.Name: trace elements

data.Name: diffusivity
data.Description: A measure of the tendency for diffusion to occur. See Hydraulic_Diffusivity.

data.Name: hydraulic diffusivity
data.Description: The characteristic of a rock-fluid system that describes the relationship of pressure change in time to pressure gradient. It is defined as permeability divided by the product of porosity, fluid viscosity and fluid compressibility.

data.Name: layer diffusivity
data.Description: Diffusivity (permeability divided by the product of porosity, fluid viscosity and fluid compressibility) for a reservoir layer.

data.Name: dimensionless layer diffusivity
data.Description: Ratio of layer storativity ratio to layer transmissibility ratio ("etaDj")

data.Name: thermal diffusivity
data.Description: A measure of the rate at which heat is conducted through a medium. Typical value for rock material is ~.01 cm2/s.

data.Name: dimensionless
data.Description: An abstract dimensionless property whose sole purpose is to be specialized into other dimensionless properties. A dimensionless property

data.Name: depth gradient
data.Description: Change of depth versus distance

data.Name: logarithmic permeability
data.Description: The logarithmic expression of permeability usually used in petroleum systems models with a wide range of permeability values

data.Name: maturity

data.Name: disclaimer

data.Name: duty cycle

data.Name: electric charge

data.Name: battery charge

data.Name: electric current

data.Name: electric polarization

data.Name: electric potential

data.Name: electric susceptibility

data.Name: electrical property
data.Description: Coarse classification of the electrical nature of a material; e.g. Conductive, Resistive

data.Name: electrical stability

data.Name: electrochemical equivalent

data.Name: electromagnetic moment

data.Name: energy
data.Description: Capacity for doing work

data.Name: acoustic energy
data.Description: Energy of an acoustic wave, calculated as the sum of the squares of the amplitudes of the elements in a wavelet, sometimes multiplied by a proportionality constant.

data.Name: avg seismic energy
data.Description: Energy of seismic trace within window, computed by summing the squares of the amplitude values and dividing by the number of samples summed.

data.Name: enthalpy
data.Description: The internal energy of a thermodynamic system plus the product of its pressure and volume.

data.Name: heat
data.Description: Energy that causes substances to rise in temperature, fuse, evaporate, expand, or undergo any of various other related changes.

data.Name: latent heat
data.Description: The amount of thermal energy required to convert an unit mass of liquid at its boiling point to completely vapor.

data.Name: work
data.Description: Work is the energy transferred by a system to its surroundings

data.Name: energy density
data.Description: The amount of energy per unit volume

data.Name: calorific value
data.Description: The amount of heat released during the combustion of a specified amount of a specific substance.

data.Name: mechanical specific energy

data.Name: reservoir energy density

data.Name: energy per area

data.Name: energy per mass

data.Name: specific energy

data.Name: dose equivalent

data.Name: vaporization heat

data.Name: equivalent dose rate

data.Name: cementation factor

data.Name: drilling exponent

data.Name: flow behavior index
data.Description: The n parameter in the Power-Law and Herschel-Bulkley rheological models. The Power_Law model is "Shear_Stress=k times (Shear_Rate at the power of n)". n is dimensionless.

data.Name: inertial flow correlation exponent

data.Name: saturation exponent

data.Name: extensive heat capacity

data.Name: body heat capacity

data.Name: extensive heat capacity per temperature
