data.Name: battery weight
data.Description: Battery Weight

data.Name: conn 1 approx weight
data.Description: Approximate weight joint/connection 1

data.Name: conn 2 approx weight
data.Description: Approximate weight joint/connection 2

data.Name: cutter set weight
data.Description: Approximate weight of the set of cutters

data.Name: injector head weight
data.Description: Weight of the injector head of a coiled tubing unit

data.Name: linear weight
data.Description: Weight of an equipment item per unit length; e.g. Casing weight, pipe weight, cable weight, etc.  Deprecated: see Linear Mass

data.Name: module weight
data.Description: Module Weight

data.Name: nom weight
data.Description: Nominal (approximate, for naming purposes only) weight of an equipment item.

data.Name: weight per joint
data.Description: Weight of each joint in a string of equipment

data.Name: api approx weight
data.Description: API approximate weight of one section

data.Name: api nom weight
data.Description: API nominal weight of tube with joint for drill pipe and casing pipe

data.Name: weight on bit
data.Description: The downward force exerted by the drillbit on the formation being drilled.

data.Name: avg weight on bit
data.Description: Average "Weight On Bit" (WOB)

data.Name: downhole weight on bit
data.Description: The weight on bit measured by an MWD/LWD tool

data.Name: max weight on bit
data.Description: Maximum weight on bit

data.Name: surface weight on bit
data.Description: The weight on bit calculated from surface measurements

data.Name: force area
data.Description: A measure of force area

data.Name: force per length
data.Description: Force per unit length

data.Name: surface tension
data.Description: Surface tension

data.Name: spring stiffness
data.Description: Coefficient relating spiral spring exerted force and corresponding elongation

data.Name: surface tension alternate
data.Description: Surface tension

data.Name: force per volume
data.Description: A measure of force per volume

data.Name: formation stiffness factor
data.Description: Dimensionless estimate of the formation stiffness, i.e., ratio between the applied pressure and the displacement of the formation.

data.Name: fraction
data.Description: Fraction

data.Name: hydrocarbon rock mass fraction
data.Description: Describes the mass of hydrocarbons per rock mass

data.Name: fractional surface area
data.Description: The fraction of a clays specific surface area which participates in hydraulic flow.

data.Name: fracture density
data.Description: Density of fracture occurrence, often measured as a function of linear trace length of fractures observed in a given surface area.

data.Name: free fluid index
data.Description: The proportion of the bulk volume of the formation which is occupied by fluids which are free to flow; commonly abbreviated FFI, measured using nuclear magnetic resonance techniques.

data.Name: free pipe signal
data.Description: Signal value in free (uncemented) pipe; used to calibrate and interpret cement bond measurements

data.Name: frequency
data.Description: The repetition rate of a periodic waveform. The inverse of period.

data.Name: acquisition rate
data.Description: Channel acquisition rate: number of data samples acquired per unit of time

data.Name: band high frequency
data.Description: Upper limit of frequency band (range)

data.Name: band low frequency
data.Description: Lower limit of frequency band (range)

data.Name: baud rate
data.Description: The net speed at which data are transmitted.

data.Name: bit rate
data.Description: The number of bits that may be transported, say via telemetry, per unit time.

data.Name: central frequency
data.Description: Central frequency within power spectrum; average of the low and high frequencies of the band.

data.Name: count rate
data.Description: The number of events per unit time; e.g. the output of a scintillation counters.

data.Name: stroke rate
data.Description: Frequency of the piston (plunger) of a pump usually expressed in number of strokes per minute

data.Name: dominant frequency
data.Description: Predominant frequency within power spectrum.

data.Name: frequency factor
data.Description: The Frequency Factor is the pre-exponential factor of the Arrhenius equation describing the frequency of collisions between reactant molecules

data.Name: gas to liquid ratio rate
data.Description: Gas to liquid ratio rate

data.Name: generation rate per geologic time
data.Description: Describes the generation of hydrocarbons from kerogen in dependency to geologic time

data.Name: liquid to gas ratio rate
data.Description: Liquid to gas ratio rate

data.Name: mass fraction per geologic time
data.Description: The mass per mass versus geologic time. E.g. the generated mass of hydrocarbons per rock mass per million years

data.Name: operations per time
data.Description: Num er of operations conducted in a unit time

data.Name: response frequency
data.Description: Instantaneous frequency at local maximum of reflection intensity

data.Name: shock rate
data.Description: Measure of shocks or vibrations above some threshold per unit of time; used to quantify vibration severity for MWD/LWD tools.

data.Name: vibration frequency
data.Description: Frequency of vibrations

data.Name: downhole axial vibration
data.Description: Along-pipe vibration measured by an MWD/LWD tool

data.Name: downhole lateral vibration
data.Description: Lateral pipe vibration measured by an MWD/LWD tool

data.Name: downhole torsional vibration
data.Description: Torsional pipe vibration measured by an MWD/LWD tool

data.Name: volume rate per volume
data.Description: The volume per volume in geologic time. E.g. The volume of generated hydrocarbons of a volume of source rock in a geologic timeframe

data.Name: frequency interval
data.Description: An octave is a doubling of a frequency.

data.Name: gain
data.Description: An increase in amplitude or power from one point in a system to another, such as between input and output.

data.Name: gamma ray
data.Description: The intensity of natural gamma-ray radiation emitted from formations containing radioactive elements, such as Potassium, Thorium, and Uranium. Measured according to API specifications.

data.Name: gamma ray minus uranium
data.Description: The measurement of the naturally occurring gamma radiation less the radiation attributed to uranium.

data.Name: induced gamma ray
data.Description: Intensity of gamma-ray radiation which has been induced, either chemically or by nuclear activation.

data.Name: max gamma ray
data.Description: Maximum value of Gamma Ray

data.Name: spatial gamma radiation intensity
data.Description: Intensity of gamma radiation represented as a function of a spatial path.

data.Name: spectral gamma radiation intensity
data.Description: Intensity of gamma radiation represented as a function of wavelength.

data.Name: gas d factor
data.Description: In non-Darcy flow, this is the deviation from the expected flow rate

data.Name: gas pseudo-pressure

NameAlias.AliasName: pressure squared per (force time per area)

data.Description: was pressure squared per force time per area

data.Name: geometrical factor
data.Description: A geometry-dependent weighting factor used to characterize how different media in the neighborhood of a sensor participate in the sensor measurement.

data.Name: shape factor
data.Description: A geometrical factor (Ca) characteristic of the reservoir areal drainage shape (e.g. circle or square) and the well location (e.g. centered).

data.Name: geometry
data.Description: The geometry of an object; e.g. the geometry of an Earth formation, a Fault, a Field, a Basin, a Borehole, etc. Usually represented with a Grid, Mesh, Parametric curves, or other complex representations.

data.Name: fracture geometry
data.Description: Characterizes the geometry of a fracture: Planar or Linear.

data.Name: shape
data.Description: A visible makeup characteristic of a particular item or kind of item. Also the spatial form of an item, or a standard or universally recognized spatial form.

data.Name: aspect ratio
data.Description: Ratio of width to length. Also the ratio of vertical to horizontal scales on a graph, or that of the shorter to longer axes for an ellipse or ellipsoid.

data.Name: conicity
data.Description: The solid angle measuring the degree of resemblance of a solid to a cone especially in shape.

data.Name: curvature
data.Description: A measure of the degree to which a path is curved relative to the length of the path along the curve.

data.Name: azimuth turn rate
data.Description: The rate of change of the azimuth of the borehole, normally expressed in degrees per unit of course length

data.Name: dogleg severity
data.Description: The change in wellbore orientation per distance

data.Name: inclination build rate
data.Description: The rate of change in inclination expressed in degrees per unit of course length.

data.Name: dip pattern shape
data.Description: Shape of a dip pattern, e.g. Convex, Concave, etc.

data.Name: dune shape
data.Description: Shape of a Dune type depositional environment, e.g. Dome, Parabolic, etc.

data.Name: eccentricity
data.Description: The ratio of the focus-to-center distance to the length of the semi-major axis of an ellipse.

data.Name: eccentricity squared
data.Description: The square of the ratio of the focus-to-center distance to the length of the semi-major axis of an ellipse.

data.Name: ellipsoid ecc2
data.Description: Ratio derived from semi-major and semi-minor axes to define degree to which ellipsoid shape departs from the spherical. [1 - b**2/a**2]

data.Name: ellipsoid flat
data.Description: Ratio derived from semi-major and semi-minor axes to define degree to which ellipsoid shape departs from the spherical. [(a-b)/a]

data.Name: ellipsoid invflat
data.Description: Ratio derived from semi-major and semi-minor axes to define degree to which ellipsoid shape departs from the spherical. [a/(a-b)]

data.Name: ellipticity
data.Description: The ratio of the major to minor axes of an ellipse.

data.Name: fan shape
data.Description: Shape of a Fan type depositional environment, i.e. Elongated or Crescent.

data.Name: flattening
data.Description: For an ellipse, the difference between the lengths of the major and minor axes divided by length of the major axis, often expressed as its inverse (Inverse_Flattening).

data.Name: inverse flattening
data.Description: Inverse of the flattening of an ellipse.

data.Name: ovality
data.Description: Degree of departure from roundness. Often measured as the ratio of large diameter over small diameter of an ellipse or an ellipsoid body

data.Name: roundness
data.Description: A measure of the degree of how round an object is, such as a contour on a Surface.

data.Name: sphericity
data.Description: A measure of the degree of how spherical an object is, such as an Lens within a subsurface Volume

data.Name: tortuosity
data.Description: A characteristic of permeable media that is the squared ratio of the mean flow path length to the medium length.

data.Name: wellbore shape
data.Description: Type of wellbore trajectory shape; common types are: build and hold, S shaped, vertical, horizontal. In the early stages of well planning, this information, along with some key parameters, are used to generate an approximate well profile - without the requirement for detailed trajectory planning. This information is also of value for wells that have already been drilled because it is difficult to categorize wells by their detailed trajectory.

data.Name: grade
data.Description: A rating of some sort given to an item (e.g., equipment) by some standards organization as the API, the IADC, etc.

data.Name: api grade
data.Description: Grade used by the API (American Petroleum Institute) to qualify material and/or equipment used in the industry, e.g., Tubulars.

data.Name: drill bit grade iadc
data.Description: The IADC, the International Association of Drilling Contractors, grading of a drill bit based on certain criteria; e.g., Bearing Seals, Dull Characteristic, Gauge, etc. grading.

data.Name: iadc grade bearing seals
data.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on condition of bearing seals

data.Name: iadc grade dull
data.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on dullness characteristics

data.Name: iadc grade gauge
data.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on gauge

data.Name: iadc grade inner rows
data.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on condition of inner rows

data.Name: iadc grade location
data.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade - Location

data.Name: iadc grade other
data.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on other characteristics

data.Name: iadc grade outer rows
data.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on condition of outer rows

data.Name: iadc grade reason pulled
data.Description: IADC Drill Bit Grade based on reason for pulling bit.

data.Name: drill bit grade tbg
data.Description: The TBG, Teeth-Bearing-Gauge, grading assigned to a drill bit based on particular criteria. The TBG has 5 fields: Bearing, Broken Teeth, Gauge, Gauge Out of Hole, Tooth Wear.

data.Name: tbg grade bearing
data.Description: TBG Drill Bit Grade based on bearing condition.

data.Name: tbg grade broken teeth
data.Description: TBG Drill Bit Grade based on broken teeth

data.Name: tbg grade gauge
data.Description: TBG Drill Bit Grade based on gauge.

data.Name: tbg grade gauge oh
data.Description: TBG Drill Bit Grade based on gauge out of hole.

data.Name: tbg grade tooth grade
data.Description: TBG Drill Bit Grade based on teeth condition.

data.Name: drill bit grade wear
data.Description: Drill Bit wear grading in percentage.

data.Name: drill pipe grade
data.Description: Drill pipe grade

data.Name: steel grade
data.Description: Grade used to qualify the characteristics of the steel. For tubulars, grade determines the minimum yield strength and thus the burst and collapse pressures and is of importance for the proper choice of slips. The grade can be either custom, i.e. defined by the supplier, e.g. US Steel FS80, Vallourec 110 VS 22, or defined by the API, e.g. C75, J55, N80, E. Number in the API grade means the minimum yield strength in kpsi (N80: 80,000 psi). API grades for Tubing, Casing and Drill pipes can be found in the API specifications 5xx.

data.Name: casing grade
data.Description: Casing pipe grades given to material properties that fall within the tolerances set by API specifications; e.g., J55, K55, H40, etc.

data.Name: gradient
data.Description: The change in the value of a quantity per unit distance in a specified direction.

data.Name: compressional velocity gradient
data.Description: A measure of the change in the compressional velocity of a medium per unit length.

data.Name: drift gradient
data.Description: The change in the borehole drift per length, usually referring to the borehole measured depth.

data.Name: electric field strength
data.Description: The force per unit charge (or voltage gradient).

data.Name: electric potential gradient
data.Description: Electric potential difference per unit of length.

data.Name: first derivative
data.Description: First derivative of a scalar function

data.Name: magnetic flux density gradient
data.Description: A measure of the change in magnetic flux density per unit length.

data.Name: pressure gradient
data.Description: The change in pressure per unit length.

data.Name: fracture pressure gradient
data.Description: Ratio of the Frac Pressure to the true vertical depth. Typical values for a reservoir range from 0.4-0.6 psi/ft for a depleted reservoir to 0.8-1.0 psi/ft for deep high pressure formation.

data.Name: mud pressure gradient
data.Description: The Mud density expressed in pressure gradient. Usually used to compare the mud induced pressure with the pore and frac pressure.

data.Name: overburden gradient
data.Description: The pressure gradient resulting from the pressure of the geology overburden

data.Name: pore pressure gradient
data.Description: The change in pore pressure per unit length.

data.Name: resistance gradient
data.Description: A measure of the change in electric resistance per unit length.

data.Name: rotation gradient
data.Description: A measure of the rotation of an object per unit length; e.g., flowmeter rotation per length of pipe, pipe rotation per unit length (for stuck pipe applications.

data.Name: small rotation per length
data.Description: Angle of rotation per unit of length for small quantities

data.Name: second derivative
data.Description: Gradient of gradient of a scalar function

data.Name: shear velocity gradient
data.Description: A measure of the change in the shear velocity of a medium per unit length.

data.Name: spontaneous potential drift
data.Description: The drift in the measured Spontaneous Potential per depth.

data.Name: stress gradient
data.Description: Change in stress magnitude over distance.

data.Name: thermal gradient
data.Description: The rate of change of temperature with length.

data.Name: geothermal gradient
data.Description: The rate of change of temperature with depth in the Earth. It averages about 30 degC/km at shallow depths.

data.Name: well thermal gradient
data.Description: The rate of change of temperature with measured depth in a well; equivalent to Geothermal_Gradient for a vertical well whose temperature has stabilized.

data.Name: velocity alpha factor
data.Description: Gradient factor a for Faust 6th root velocity function v(z) = a * z**(1/6)

data.Name: velocity beta factor
data.Description: Gradient factor b for Faust 3rd root velocity function. v(z) = b * z**(1/3)

data.Name: velocity gamma factor
data.Description: Gradient factor g for Faust Nth root velocity function v(z) = g * z**(1/n)

data.Name: velocity gradient in depth
data.Description: First derivative of velocity versus depth

data.Name: velocity gradient in time
data.Description: First derivative of velocity versus time.

data.Name: velocity k factor
data.Description: Velocity depth gradient, dv/dz used in some velocity functions like linear velocity : v(z) = v_0 + k*z depth of burial : v(z,z_1) = v_0 + k_1*z_1 + k_2*(z-z_1)

data.Name: wave differential energy
data.Description: The change in attenuation of an acoustic wave (compressional, shear or Stoneley) per unit length.

data.Name: heat capacity
data.Description: The amount of heat required to raise the temperature of a unit volume of a given material by one degree.

data.Name: heat flux
data.Description: The quantity of thermal energy which passes through a cross-sectional area per unit time.

data.Name: heat release rate
data.Description: The quantity of heat released in a material per unit time. Also known as mixing power.

data.Name: heat transfer coefficient
data.Description: Amount of heat transferred per unit time per degree per unit area.

data.Name: hydrogen index
data.Description: The ratio of the number of hydrogen atoms per unit volume of a material to that number in pure water at 75 degF. Neutron logging response depends mainly on hydrogen index.

data.Name: id
data.Description: A system generated number that uniquely identifies an data item (Entity, Property, Representation, ...) within certain system imposed limitations on the uniqueness.

data.Name: identifier
data.Description: A number, label or code given to an object in an attempt to uniquely identify it.

data.Name: activity number
data.Description: External identifier assigned to an activity (e.g. job or proposal number).

data.Name: agency lease number
data.Description: Unique lease number assigned by leasing agency

data.Name: api code
data.Description: Code used by the API (American Petroleum Institute) to identify an industry related entity, e.g., Service Company, Country, another Standard organization, etc.

data.Name: api country code
data.Description: Code used by the API (American Petroleum Institute) to identify sovereign nations, colonies, overseas territories, etc.

data.Name: api well number
data.Description: A unique well identification number as defined in the API (American Petroleum Institute) Bulletin D12A.

data.Name: authorization for expenditure
data.Description: Identifier of granted or candidate request for authorization to spend money, usually for a specified purpose and amount. Abbreviated AFE

data.Name: bha number
data.Description: An identification number assigned to a bottomhole assembly, normally for tracking purposes at the wellsite.

data.Name: bid number
data.Description: Bid number assigned by governing agency

data.Name: bit number
data.Description: An identification number assigned to a drill bit, normally for tracking purposes at the wellsite.

data.Name: box number
data.Description: Number of box in which an item or sample is stored.

data.Name: company lease number
data.Description: Unique lease number assigned by owning company

data.Name: contact symbol
data.Description: Symbol to post on the Feature_Boundary at the intersection point with another Feature_Boundary

data.Name: contract number
data.Description: Identifying string for contractual agreement

data.Name: housing number
data.Description: Identifying number often etched onto the housing.

data.Name: issue number
data.Description: Issue (e.g. Volume,number) of a periodical publication

data.Name: job number
data.Description: Reference number assigned to a job or service

data.Name: nominal number
data.Description: An integer number used to identify an object or an element of an array.

data.Name: object identifier
data.Description: Identifier of the seismic object within the Foreign System

data.Name: offshore block number
data.Description: Identification of the Offshore block where the well is located

data.Name: part number
data.Description: Identifier used for accounting or purchasing purpose to identify an equipment item.

data.Name: pi code
data.Description: Petroleum Information Alpha-Numeric code

data.Name: pi code series
data.Description: Petroleum Information Alpha-Numeric code series. Example 110 for Producing Wells, 400 for Gas Injection Wells.

data.Name: proposal number
data.Description: Customer proposal number

data.Name: purchase number
data.Description: Purchase Order Number

data.Name: range number
data.Description: Jeffersonian Range Number

data.Name: sale number
data.Description: Sale number of lease purchase

data.Name: sample number
data.Description: The number assigned to a formation or fluid sample.

data.Name: sampling bottle number
data.Description: Sample bottle number

data.Name: section number
data.Description: Jeffersonian Section Number

data.Name: serial number
data.Description: The serial number placed on a piece of equipment.

data.Name: logging unit
data.Description: Serial number of the logging unit.

data.Name: sidetrack number
data.Description: A sequential number identifying a particular sidetrack; 0 if no sidetracks have occurred. Used for WITS Channel SKNO.

data.Name: standard document identifier
data.Description: Standard document identifier, such as an ISBN or ISSN number.

data.Name: storage label
data.Description: Label found on any stored item, such as tapes, documents, etc.

data.Name: system identifier
data.Description: Identifier of a computer system.

data.Name: host identifier
data.Description: Identification of a host computer system where, for example, an application is to run.

data.Name: internet address
data.Description: Address by which a particular computer system may be reached over the Internet.

data.Name: x display identifier
data.Description: XServer Id on which application is to display output

data.Name: to conn number
data.Description: Indicates which end or connection number (1 or 2 for tubulars, 3 for a hydraulic T,...) of the "To" equipment in a From_To equipment connection. The description of the "To" connection number is needed in some cases for equipment item which is last in the connection chain. When no ambiguity exists, the From_Conn_Number is the preferred property.

data.Name: tool number
data.Description: Acquisition system tool number

data.Name: township number
data.Description: Jeffersonian Township Number

data.Name: treatment number
data.Description: Internal Dowell treatment number

data.Name: uwi
data.Description: The unique Identifier given to a well or a borehole specified in a given naming system. This identifier can be granted by either an official regulatory commission such as the API 12/14 digits, the Canadian Petroleum Association (CPA) or by any organization (user, customer), described in Well.Naming_System.

data.Name: version
data.Description: Software version number

data.Name: digital file format version
data.Description: Identification of the digital file format version (e.g., 3.0a). Note that this information is often encoded within the file.

data.Name: firmware version
data.Description: Version of the firmware.

data.Name: operating system version
data.Description: Version of computer Operating System

data.Name: illuminance
data.Description: The intensity of light striking a surface.

data.Name: image clipping region
data.Description: Vector of pixel values indicating which portion of an input image is represented in a clipped output; the structure of the vector is [Offset from Top, Offset from Left, Height, Width].

data.Name: impedance
data.Description: The measure of the ability of an object or medium to resist the flow of electric current. Impedance is a complex quantity composed of a real term (Resistance) and an imaginary term (Reactance).

data.Name: reactance
data.Description: The opposition to alternating current flow offered by inductance or capacitance; the quadrature component of impedance.

data.Name: capacitive reactance
data.Description: The component of electrical impedance due to capacitance: Xc = 1 /(2 pi F C), where F is the frequency and C is the capacitance.

data.Name: inductive reactance
data.Description: The component of electrical impedance due to inductance.

data.Name: resistance
data.Description: The resistance of a medium to the flow of electric current; the real component of the complex quantity Impedance.

data.Name: impedance factor
data.Description: Impedance Factor

data.Name: indicator
data.Description: Property which indicates presence of some entity, occurrence or condition, or which quantifies some condition, often as a proportion of some local reference value. Often called _Factor or _Coefficient.

data.Name: casing collar locator
data.Description: Signal from a device which indicates the presence of a casing or tubing collar, used for depth control in logging operations.

data.Name: cement bond index
data.Description: The ratio of acoustic wave attenuation in a zone of interest to that measured in a well-cemented section of casing, used as an indication of the quality of a casing cement job.

data.Name: confidence factor
data.Description: The probability that a given event will occur or that a given data set will contain a specified element.

data.Name: connectedness coefficient
data.Description: A coefficient describing the connectedness of items, such as the connectedness between inclusions (e.g. lenses) in the Earth subsurface formations.

data.Name: correlation coefficient
data.Description: Coefficient of a correlation used to determine the quality of the correlation

data.Name: tie point time quality
data.Description: Measure of the significance of a mis-tie computed on a correlation basis.

data.Name: corrosion indicator
data.Description: Any of several measurements which show that material has been damaged by corrosion.

data.Name: data acquisition mode
data.Description: Software or hardware option whose selection controls some aspect of data acquisition.

data.Name: drainage area shape factor
data.Description: The shape factor for enclosed drainage areas, used to correct pseudosteady-state flow performance behavior of sinks in non-circular drainage regions.

data.Name: expansion factor
data.Description: A factor that accounts for the change in gas density due to pressure changes, as across an orifice.

data.Name: flag
data.Description: An indicator of which of two or more conditions exist, or of which option has been selected. Most flags are binary in nature with a Yes/No possibility.

data.Name: acquisition enable flag
data.Description: Flag indicating whether or not acquisition is enabled for this activity.

data.Name: adjustable choke flag
data.Description: Flag indicating whether this flow period was performed on an adjustable choke, i.e., when set: adjustable choke, not set: fixed choke.

data.Name: bad hole flag
data.Description: Flag indicating that the hole is in poor condition (e.g. oversize or overly rugose)

data.Name: bit bladed flag
data.Description: Flag indicating that the bit is a bladed type (PDC type bit).

data.Name: bored flag
data.Description: Flag to indicate that equipment item has been bored.

data.Name: cementitious flag
data.Description: Flag indicating if the chemical is accounted for as a cement when proportioning by weight of blend. Cementitious chemicals are mostly weight extenders like bentonite.

data.Name: central line x alignment
data.Description: Alignment of central line x-coordinate: 0 if central line is x-axis, 1 if x-axis is east west

data.Name: closure
data.Description: Indicates whether the boundary of a spatial object is Open or Closed?

data.Name: code in catalog
data.Description: Flag to indicate that the Code is available in a Catalog.

data.Name: conn 1 box flag
data.Description: Flag indicating if connection is a box (Y) or a pin (N).

data.Name: conn 2 box flag
data.Description: Flag indicating if connection is a box (Y) or a pin (N).

data.Name: corrosive fluid flag
data.Description: Is the fluid corrosive? (Y/N) Used to apply a wall erosion model to measure the pipe wall thickness.

data.Name: crossflow flag
data.Description: Indicates presence of crossflow

data.Name: data compression flag
data.Description: Flag indicating whether or not downhole data compression is possible with this equipment.

data.Name: data presence flag
data.Description: An indicator which shows that some particular type of data is available.

data.Name: derived inverse flattening
data.Description: Flag indicating that the inverse flattening value of an ellipsoid has been derived from semi-major and semi-minor axis lengths.

data.Name: derived minor axis
data.Description: Flag indicating that the semi-minor axis value of an ellipsoid has been derived from the semi-major axis length and a flattening value.

data.Name: estimation flag
data.Description: Indicates whether the data are an estimation (Y) or not (N)

data.Name: fault control flag
data.Description: Flag marking if a layer is affected by faulting.

data.Name: gas flag
data.Description: Flag indicating presence of gas

data.Name: geologic flag
data.Description: Flag indicating that the object or data pertains to geology or was derived from geologic data.

data.Name: h2s flag
data.Description: Indicates that hydrogen sulfide (H2S) has been detected.

data.Name: h2s service flag
data.Description: Specifies whether equipment is for H2S service or not

data.Name: hierarchical flag
data.Description: Flag indicating that the entities participate in a hierarchy.

data.Name: included
data.Description: A flag indicating whether an object is included or excluded from the spatial extent of a containing object.

data.Name: intrinsic safety flag
data.Description: When set, indicates that the equipment has been certified for use in a hazardous area. Equipment so certified has been examined by a National Certifying Authority and, where necessary, tested and found to comply with the requirement of a standard specification for the appropriate concept.

data.Name: lag usage flag
data.Description: When set, wavelet lag is used.

data.Name: live trace flag
data.Description: Indicator if trace is live or dead.

data.Name: log flag
data.Description: Flag indicating the presence of a log, or that an item or event is to be included in a log.

data.Name: logging cable flag
data.Description: Y/N: tells if there is a wireline cable inside the tubing allowing logging

data.Name: lost time flag
data.Description: Flag indicating whether or not an event caused a delay in operation.

data.Name: low power flag
data.Description: Flag indicating whether or not the tool is operating in low power consumption mode. When the flag is set, the sensor warmup duration is taken into account.

data.Name: mandatory
data.Description: Flag indicating if a relationship is mandatory or optional for the referencing object.

data.Name: manual control flag
data.Description: Flag indicating whether the activity is/was controlled manually by the user (1) or automatically by the system or application (0)

data.Name: memory guard flag
data.Description: Flag indicating whether or not a memory guard (memory saving mechanism which decreases the acquisition rate above 80% memory usage) option was selected.

data.Name: monophasic fluid flag
data.Description: Indicates if the fluid is monophasic

data.Name: monotonic flag
data.Description: Flag indicating that the data increase or decrease monotonically along their index. A monotonic function is one whose value either never increases or never decreases as the independent variable increases.

data.Name: multi intersection flag
data.Description: Flag to indicate that two geometric objects have more than one intersection; for example a wellbore may intersect a geologic feature more than once, due to the geometry of the wellbore path or that of the geologic feature.

data.Name: multi valued flag
data.Description: Boolean indicating if the Horizon has multiple Z values for a single X,Y location.

data.Name: non magnetic flag
data.Description: A flag indicating whether the equipment is made with non magnetic material.

data.Name: optimum flag
data.Description: Indicates whether the activity, process or solution is optimum.

data.Name: ordered flag
data.Description: Flag to indicate whether the members of a set have been ordered.

data.Name: perforation pressure condition
data.Description: Pressure condition in the well at the time of perforating; may be Underbalanced (pressure in formation higher than in borehole) or Overbalanced (pressure in borehole higher than in formation.

data.Name: polarity reversal flag
data.Description: When set, apply reverse polarity.

data.Name: preferred flag
data.Description: An indicator which shows that a particular item is preferred over another, normally as a result of some interpretation or validation process.

data.Name: primary output flag
data.Description: Flag indicating that data constitute a valid primary output (1) or an auxiliary output (0)

data.Name: production history flag
data.Description: Flag indicating whether or not this Flow Period is part of the Production History; i.e., set for Production History, not set for Test History

data.Name: productive flag
data.Description: Indicates whether object or activity is productive. An activity is considered productive if it brings the operation closer to achieving the objective.

data.Name: projection point mode
data.Description: Flag determining number of points used in defining certain projections, 0,1,2

data.Name: projection quadrant
data.Description: Quadrant in which X and Y axes are positive, 1,2,3, or 4

data.Name: read only flag
data.Description: Flag indicating that a record is available for read access only (cannot be updated or deleted).

data.Name: report flag
data.Description: Flag indicating the presence of a report, or that an item or event is to be included in a report.

data.Name: right handed
data.Description: Flag indicating that a 3D axis system is right-handed: a 3D coordinate system is Right_Handed if the direction of rotation from the x axis to the y axis is counter-clockwise when viewed from a positive position on the z axis. For example, if x is East and y is North, a Right_Handed system will have the positive z pointing upward (as increasing elevation). Right_Handed is meaningless for 2D systems.

data.Name: rigid flag
data.Description: Flag indicating that a piece of equipment is rigid.

data.Name: seismic flag
data.Description: Flag indicating that the object or data pertains to seismic techniques or was derived from seismic data.

data.Name: single shot flag
data.Description: If flag is set, it means that the equipment or item can only be used once before rework or replacement.

data.Name: slant rig flag
data.Description: A flag indicating if the rig is slanted.

data.Name: standing oil flag
data.Description: Indicates if there is standing, motionless oil

data.Name: standing water flag
data.Description: Indicates if there is standing, motionless water

data.Name: station inflection
data.Description: Logical flag for each seismic station indicating whether or not it is an inflection point

data.Name: supervised flag
data.Description: Flag indicating whether the activity was supervised (1) or unsupervised (0)

data.Name: terminal mode flag
data.Description: Flag indicating whether or not the setup was filled in terminal mode (e.g. via an HP hand calculator). This affects the interpretation of the Job_Duration parameter.

data.Name: use checkshot flag
data.Description: A processing option indicating whether or not Checkshot survey data should be used for depth-time conversion.

data.Name: user trace selection
data.Description: Good/bad marker

data.Name: validation flag
data.Description: Flag indicating that validation will be or has been performed on the data.

data.Name: vertical lift flow regime flag
data.Description: Flag identifying flow regime flag at some depth

data.Name: welded section flag
data.Description: Y/N : does the section has a weld or not : used as a weak point flag in coiled tubing.

data.Name: interporosity flow coefficient
data.Description: Describes the conductance of flow from matrix to fissures. Usually known as Lambda in reservoir dynamics.

data.Name: non darcy flow coefficient
data.Description: Non-Darcy (turbulence) flow coefficient ("D")

data.Name: processing option
data.Description: An indicator of which of two or more options has been selected for data processing.

data.Name: auto exit
data.Description: Flag indicates module is to be automatically stopped when run in chain

data.Name: auto start
data.Description: Flag indicates module is to be automatically started when run in chain

data.Name: base for spacing
data.Description: A flag that determines which reference along a Borehole will be used to space Boreholes on a Cross Section.

data.Name: gqi admission policy
data.Description: Identifies the Geometry Query Interface (GQI) policy for maintaining the content of a geometric feature as it is edited. The most common value is POINT_SET_PRESERVING, but applications may implement others so the values are not constrained.

data.Name: node locked flag
data.Description: A Y/N flag indicating whether a particular Node is locked and cannot be displaced.

data.Name: smoothing mode
data.Description: Mode to use while smoothing horizon picks (automatic, manual).

data.Name: structural dip removal flag
data.Description: This property specifies whether the effect of structural dipping on a particular geological zone has been removed.

data.Name: quality indicator
data.Description: Property which provides a relative measure of the quality or fitness-for-purpose of data, or of some item, process, or material.

data.Name: acoustic quality indicator
data.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from an acoustic survey.

data.Name: antenna quality factor
data.Description: Antenna Quality Factor (Sensitivity of Tuned Antenna)

data.Name: array induction quality indicator
data.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from an array induction survey.

data.Name: cbl quality indicator
data.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a Cement Bond logging survey.

data.Name: cyclic redundancy check
data.Description: CRC test value for this Calibration Coefficient set.

data.Name: degradation factor
data.Description: Indication of the extent to which the quality of an object or of data has been degraded.

data.Name: degree of confidence
data.Description: The degree of confidence associated with any event or feature related to or detected, for example a geologic feature in/on the Earth (high, low, etc)

data.Name: density quality indicator
data.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a density logging survey.

data.Name: dip quality
data.Description: Induced quality of the dip value based on evaluation of the quality of the measured data. Ranges from 0 (bad) to 20 (good)

data.Name: dip quality cutoff
data.Description: The lowest dip quality taken into account for an interpretation.

data.Name: filter cake thickness quality indicator
data.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data representing mud filter cake thickness.

data.Name: gross cutoff absent fraction
data.Description: Fraction of the summation interval for which data to apply "Initial" cutoff criteria are unavailable; used as a coarse indicator of the reliability of the summation results.

data.Name: net cutoff absent fraction
data.Description: Fraction of the summation interval for which data to apply "Net" cutoff criteria are unavailable; used as a coarse indicator of the reliability of the summation results.

data.Name: net pay cutoff absent fraction
data.Description: Fraction of the summation interval for which data to apply "Net_Pay" cutoff criteria are unavailable (including the fraction for which "Net" or "Net_Reservoir" criteria are unavailable); used as a coarse indicator of the reliability of the summation results.

data.Name: net reservoir cutoff absent fraction
data.Description: Fraction of the summation interval for which data to apply "Net_Reservoir" cutoff criteria are unavailable (including the fraction for which "Net" criteria are unavailable); used as a coarse indicator of the reliability of the summation results.

data.Name: neutron capture cross section quality indicator
data.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a neutron capture cross section survey.
data.Code: neutron capture cross section quality indicator

data.Name: neutron quality indicator
data.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a neutron survey.

data.Name: nmr quality indicator
data.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a nuclear magnetic resonance logging device.

data.Name: photoelectric factor quality indicator
data.Description: Property used to indicate quality or confidence of data from a photoelectric factor survey.

data.Name: pick quality
data.Description: Pick quality measurement.

data.Name: snap quality
data.Description: Indicates whether the values are snapped to a sample or sub-sample

data.Name: tracking quality
data.Description: The acceptable value of the crosscorrelation for continued tracking (0.0 - 1.0).

data.Name: shock level
data.Description: Qualitative indicator of Shock_Rate; used as a real-time indicator of vibration severity for MWD/LWD tools. Also referred to as Shock Risk

data.Name: status
data.Description: An indicator of the state of an entity or process at some moment in time. Also the position or rank in relation to others.

data.Name: agreement status
data.Description: Status of a lease agreement.

data.Name: borehole status
data.Description: A property indicating current status of a Borehole: Producing, Abandoned, etc. Related to the Petroleum Information (PI) codes.

data.Name: contract status
data.Description: Status of a contract.

data.Name: erosion state
data.Description: Describes if the event has been partially, totally, etc. subjected to erosion.

data.Name: hydraulic fracture stage
data.Description: Whether the fracture is considered after closure or at the end of job.

data.Name: lease status
data.Description: Status of a lease.

data.Name: module state
data.Description: Indicates the execution status of a module, such as Running, Aborted, etc.

data.Name: perforation status
data.Description: Not perforated, perforated, plugged or squeezed

data.Name: tool status
data.Description: Indicator of some condition in the operation of a tool.

data.Name: well status
data.Description: A property indicating the operational condition of a well: proposed, active, abandoned, etc.

data.Name: wellbore status
data.Description: A property indicating the operational condition of a wellbore: proposed, active, abandoned, etc.

data.Name: thermal alteration index
data.Description: An indicator of the thermal maturity of organic matter, based on a relationship between color of organic particles and the length and intensity of heat exposure.

data.Name: turbulence coefficient
data.Description: The coefficient that describes the additional pressure drop due to inertial effects for high velocity gas flow.

data.Name: inductance
data.Description: The capability of an electric circuit to induce an electromotive force (emf) within the circuit.

data.Name: integrated mobility
data.Description: The product of thickness and mobility of a permeable medium.

data.Name: interfacial tension
data.Description: The tension between two interfaces; e.g., light and heavy fluid phases, gas-liquid, gas-oil, gas-water. Also called surface tension or surface tensity

data.Name: reciprocal velocity
data.Description: The reciprocal of velocity

data.Name: interval transit time
data.Description: The travel time of a wave over a unit distance, hence the reciprocal of wave velocity.

data.Name: acoustic slowness
data.Description: The transit time interval per unit length of an acoustic wave; inverse of wave velocity. Applies to all types of Delta-T: Compressional, Shear and Stoneley.

data.Name: compressional slowness
data.Description: The time it takes for a compressional wave to traverse a fixed distance; reciprocal of Compressional_Velocity.

data.Name: fluid compressional slowness
data.Description: Acoustic slowness of a fluid; the slowness of the compressional wave.

data.Name: mud compressional slowness
data.Description: Acoustic compressional slowness (Delta-T) of the drilling fluid.

data.Name: matrix compressional slowness
data.Description: Acoustic slowness of a compressional wave in a given material or matrix.

data.Name: low acoustic slowness
data.Description: Acoustic slowness for small quantities

data.Name: rayleigh slowness
data.Description: The acoustic slowness of a Rayleigh wave (type of seismic wave propagated along the free surface of a semi-infinite medium).

data.Name: shear slowness
data.Description: Acoustic slowness of a shear wave (Vs); reciprocal of Shear_Velocity; a shear wave is a type of seismic wave in which the particle motion is perpendicular to the direction of propagation; also called S-wave or secondary wave.

data.Name: matrix shear slowness
data.Description: Acoustic slowness of a shear wave in a given material or matrix.

data.Name: stoneley slowness
data.Description: The acoustic slowness of a Stoneley wave; a Stoneley wave is a type of seismic wave which is propagated along an interface, such as a tube wave in a borehole.

data.Name: electromagnetic propagation time
data.Description: Time per unit length required for an electromagnetic wave to propagate over some interval in some medium like air, water, drilling fluid, etc..

data.Name: matrix electromagnetic propagation time
data.Description: The time it takes for an electromagnetic wave to traverse a fixed distance of a given material or matrix. In this case the material or matrix is a specific, zero porosity rock, e.g. sandstone, limestone or dolomite.

data.Name: inverse penetration rate
data.Description: Inverse of drilling penetration rate.

data.Name: isothermal compressibility
data.Description: Compressibility carried out isothermally

data.Name: key
data.Description: In software, data used to gain access to or to enable some otherwise restricted functionality.

data.Name: lambda rho
data.Description: Product of Lame constant and density, LR

data.Name: lame lambda
data.Description: Lame constant, Lambda

data.Name: length
data.Description: Linear extent of a measured distance or dimension.

data.Name: api range
data.Description: API range characteristic for length of tubular goods

data.Name: axial length
data.Description: The length associated with the longest dimension of an object. This corresponds to the height of a cylinder, or the longest axis of a rectangle.

data.Name: axial spacing
data.Description: The spacing or distance between two locations on an equipment item; for example, between two sensors on a logging tool.

data.Name: bend 1 to bottom conn
data.Description: Length from the first bend to the bottom connection of the tool

data.Name: bend 2 to bottom conn
data.Description: Length from the second bend to the bottom connection of the tool

data.Name: bit drilled depth
data.Description: The distance drilled by the bit

data.Name: blade gauge length
data.Description: Length of the in-gauge portion of the blade.

data.Name: blade height
data.Description: Height of blade at gauge from the body of the equipment, such as a stabilizer.

data.Name: optional blade height
data.Description: Optional height of blade at gauge from the body of the equipment, such as a stabilizer (extended Andergauge); used as a supplement to Blade_Height.

data.Name: blade length
data.Description: Length of blade measured along spiral; used for drill stabilizer blades.

data.Name: blade to conn 2

data.Name: depth
data.Description: The perpendicular measurement downward from a surface. Also, the direct linear measurement from the point of viewing usually from front to back.

data.Name: bit depth
data.Description: Depth of the drillbit

data.Name: bottom depth
data.Description: The deepest depth of a borehole interval, a formation, or any depth indexed representation of a data item.

data.Name: rat hole bottom depth
data.Description: Bottom depth of the section of the borehole running from the tester valve to the effective bottom of the well

data.Name: snap depth window bottom
data.Description: Distance below the picked Z to search for the Tracking Event and Snap_Type when snapping

data.Name: survey bottom depth
data.Description: Deepest depth to which the borehole was surveyed

data.Name: tracking depth window bottom
data.Description: Distance below the picked Z to search for the Event_Type and Snap_Type while tracking

data.Name: casing shoe depth
data.Description: Casing shoe depth

data.Name: circulation loss depth
data.Description: Depth at which circulation is being lost to the formation.

data.Name: corrected depth
data.Description: Depth which can be offset and scaled from the raw depth acquired from a sensor to take into account the position or deformation of the sensor thus the name of corrected.

data.Name: depth of returns
data.Description: The depth from which drilled cuttings or gas are being received

data.Name: fill bottom depth
data.Description: Measured depth of the bottom of the fill. (Fill : unwanted material, formation sand, proppant, gravel pack failure, workover debris ... filling up the wellbore)

data.Name: fill top depth
data.Description: Measured depth of the top of the fill. (Fill : unwanted material, formation sand, proppant, gravel pack failure, workover debris ... filling up the wellbore)

data.Name: flattening depth
data.Description: Depth at which flattening should be calculated based on the flattening feature.

data.Name: flowing condition depth
data.Description: Depth at which bottomhole data were acquired

data.Name: free water level
data.Description: Depth at which the water pressure and oil/gas pressure are equal; the depth at which Pc (capillary pressure) is equal to 0.

data.Name: gas water contact depth
data.Description: Depth at which the gas water contact has been identified in a Reservoir Unit

data.Name: initial reservoir pressure depth
data.Description: Depth reference of initial reservoir pressure

data.Name: landing collar depth
data.Description: Measured depth of the collar on which the cement plugs seat : this data is required to compute the displacement volume of a cementing operation.

data.Name: last static pressure depth
data.Description: Depth at which last reservoir pressure data were recorded

data.Name: map migrated depth
data.Description: Depth obtained through map migration of time surface data

data.Name: max depth
data.Description: Maximum Depth

data.Name: measured depth
data.Description: Depth measured along the borehole path from the working datum.

data.Name: planned depth
data.Description: The planned measured depth at the end of the reporting period, as described on the driller depth log of the planned borehole

data.Name: min depth
data.Description: Minimum Depth of Activity

data.Name: nom cable depth
data.Description: Nominal cable depth, such as that planned for the receiver cable in a marine seismic survey.

data.Name: nom source depth
data.Description: Planned depth for the source

data.Name: oil water contact depth
data.Description: The depth at which oil water contact has been recognized in a Reservoir Unit.

data.Name: packer depth
data.Description: Depth at which the packer is set.

data.Name: penetration depth
data.Description: Depth to which some medium is penetrated, such as by a drill bit or probe, or by fluid invasion. (Not to be used for borehole depth.)

data.Name: plug back total depth
data.Description: Measured Depth of the current bottom of the borehole. It is the physical bottom of the borehole which is plugged either by a cement or by a mechanical plug. The P.B.T.D. can changes in time. It is smaller than the total depth drilled.

data.Name: pond depth
data.Description: For a centrifuge, Position of overflow Port relative to Inner Bowl Wall

data.Name: propped bottom depth
data.Description: Bottom Depth of proppant laden slurry volume during the propagation of an hydraulic fracture considered along the well bore..

data.Name: propped top depth
data.Description: Top Depth of proppant laden slurry during the propagation of an hydraulic fracture considered along the well bore. Often named Slurry height. At fracture closure, Propped_Top_Depth = Fracture_Height.

data.Name: reference depth
data.Description: Depth value used as a reference for other data

data.Name: rock compressibility depth
data.Description: Measured depth for which Rock Compressibility is stated.

data.Name: standard reference datum
data.Description: Depth measured from the Standard Reference Datum

data.Name: start depth
data.Description: Depth at which an activity starts e.g. at the beginning of the Coiled tubing pumping stage, depth of the cleaning tool

data.Name: stop depth
data.Description: Depth at which a particular activity stopped.

data.Name: test depth
data.Description: Depth at which a formation test is performed; normally taken to be measured depth.

data.Name: top depth
data.Description: The top depth of a borehole interval, a formation or any depth indexed representation of an data item.

data.Name: snap depth window top
data.Description: Distance above the picked Z to search for the Tracking Event and Snap_Type when snapping

data.Name: survey top depth
data.Description: Shallowest depth of the survey or suite of surveys.

data.Name: tracking depth window top
data.Description: Distance above the picked Z to search for the Tracking Event and Snap_Type while tracking

data.Name: total depth
data.Description: The total depth, usually of the well borehole.

data.Name: driller total depth
data.Description: The total depth of the well borehole as reported by the drilling contractor.

data.Name: logger total depth
data.Description: The total depth of the well borehole as reported by the logging contractor.

data.Name: trace depth
data.Description: The depth coordinate of a trace

data.Name: treatment bottom depth
data.Description: Depth of the borehole at the moment of the treatment

data.Name: true stratigraphic thickness depth
data.Description: The depth of a point relative to a True Stratigraphic Thickness (TST) Index. Such indices may be local to a particular zone interval, hence their values can only be compared to other values referenced to the same index.

data.Name: bottom true stratigraphic thickness depth
data.Description: True Stratigraphic Thickness Depth of Bottom of Interval

data.Name: top true stratigraphic thickness depth
data.Description: True Stratigraphic Thickness Depth of Top of Interval

data.Name: true vertical depth
data.Description: The true vertical depth from the surface of the Earth to a particular subsurface point.

data.Name: bottom true vertical depth
data.Description: True Vertical Depth of Bottom of Interval

data.Name: seismic vertical depth
data.Description: Vertical Depth from Seismic Reference Datum

data.Name: subsea vertical depth
data.Description: Vertical Depth from Mean Sea Level

data.Name: bottom subsea vertical depth

data.Name: bottom true vertical thickness depth

data.Name: top true vertical thickness depth
data.Description: True Vertical Thickness Depth of Top of Interval

data.Name: water depth

data.Name: weathering depth

data.Name: weathering depth cdp
data.Description: Depth of weathered layer at a CDP.

data.Name: zone start
data.Description: The start depth of a zone, usually along the borehole. This may be the deeper or the shallower end of the zone.

data.Name: zone stop

data.Name: depth offset

data.Name: vertical depth offset

data.Name: api pin conn size

data.Name: bubble size
