data.Name: burner pilot pipe size
data.Description: Standard gas pipe size connection supplied on the pilot inlet equipment

data.Name: core diameter
data.Description: The Diameter of the recovered core.

data.Name: cuttings diameter
data.Description: Average diameter of drill cuttings.

data.Name: differential caliper
data.Description: The difference between the actual borehole diameter and bit size.

data.Name: gas line diameter
data.Description: Diameter of the gas line

data.Name: gas metering line size
data.Description: Line size of gas meter inlet and outlet pipe

data.Name: grain size
data.Description: Average diameter of a mineral grain or set of grains.

data.Name: horizontal size
data.Description: The size of any object as measured horizontally

data.Name: inlet connection size
data.Description: The connection size of the input line to the equipment

data.Name: inside diameter
data.Description: Inside diameter of an entity, such as an item of drillstring equipment

data.Name: bore inside diameter
data.Description: The inside diameter of the equipment bore.

data.Name: borehole diameter
data.Description: The inside diameter of a borehole.

data.Name: caliper
data.Description: Borehole diameter as measured by a logging device: a record of the borehole or the internal diameter of tubular goods.

data.Name: acoustic caliper
data.Description: Borehole diameter as estimated by an acoustic logging device.

data.Name: density caliper
data.Description: Borehole diameter as estimated by a density logging device.

data.Name: electromagnetic caliper
data.Description: Borehole diameter as estimated by an electromagnetic logging device.

data.Name: ultrasonic caliper
data.Description: Borehole diameter as measured by an ultrasonic logging device.

data.Name: washout caliper diff
data.Description: The degree of a borehole ovality beyond which caliper data becomes unreliable due to bad contact with the tool pads.

data.Name: washout caliper ext
data.Description: The extension of a borehole diameter beyond which caliper data becomes unreliable due to bad contact with the tool pads.

data.Name: electrical penetration
data.Description: The apparent borehole diameter as viewed by electrical measurements

data.Name: max borehole diameter
data.Description: Maximum borehole diameter

data.Name: min borehole diameter
data.Description: Minimum borehole diameter

data.Name: nom borehole diameter
data.Description: Nominal inside diameter of a borehole; often referred to a "bit size".

data.Name: casing inside diameter
data.Description: Casing inner diameter

data.Name: choke size
data.Description: Internal diameter of the flow choke(s)

data.Name: conn 1 inside diameter
data.Description: Inside diameter of tool joint/connection 1

data.Name: conn 2 inside diameter
data.Description: Inside diameter of tool joint/connection 2

data.Name: drift diameter
data.Description: Largest diameter of a perfect cylinder of a specified length that can fit into the pipe. Because a pipe is never perfectly cylindrical but slightly oval the drift diameter is always smaller than the quoted inner diameter. The drift diameter is used to know if a given pipe or instrument will run into a pipe.

data.Name: conn 1 drift diameter
data.Description: Drift diameter of tool joint/connection 1

data.Name: conn 2 drift diameter
data.Description: Drift diameter of tool joint/connection 2

data.Name: tube drift diameter
data.Description: Drift diameter of tube or body of equipment item.

data.Name: eff inside diameter
data.Description: Effective inside diameter for stiffness, as used for drilling tools.

data.Name: hole inside diameter
data.Description: The effective inside diameter of a Well; may be of the Borehole, Casing or Tubing.

data.Name: max casing inside diameter
data.Description: Maximum inside diameter of casing for which service or equipment is suitable

data.Name: max manifold choke size
data.Description: Maximum inner diameter of the choke orifice

data.Name: min casing inside diameter
data.Description: Minimum inside diameter of casing for which service or equipment is suitable

data.Name: min inside diameter
data.Description: Minimum inside diameter of an equipment item.

data.Name: nom inside diameter
data.Description: Nominal (approximate, for naming purposes only) inside diameter of an equipment item.

data.Name: tube nom inside diameter
data.Description: Nominal inside diameter of body or actual inside diameter tube (for API spec. drill pipe)

data.Name: outer pipe inside diameter
data.Description: Inside diameter of a pipe in external position within an annulus

data.Name: packer inside diameter
data.Description: Packer internal diameter (Casing_Tubing Packer)

data.Name: pass through diameter
data.Description: Equipment (e.g. drillbit) attribute which specifies the minimum inside diameter of casing through which the equipment will pass.

data.Name: pipe inside diameter
data.Description: Inside diameter of pipe

data.Name: rat hole diameter
data.Description: Diameter of the section of the borehole running from the tester valve to the effective bottom of the well

data.Name: riser internal diameter
data.Description: The internal diameter of the marine riser.

data.Name: valve inside diameter
data.Description: Inside diameter of the valve assembly

data.Name: invasion diameter
data.Description: The diameter to which drilling mud filtrate has invaded porous and permeable rock around the borehole.

data.Name: major axis
data.Description: Length of the major (long) axis of an ellipse.

data.Name: mean particle diameter
data.Description: Average diameter of the particle (e.g. for Gravel pack sand 20/40 mean diameter=0 .025 inc/0.635 mm, 40/60 mean diameter=0.014 inch/0.355mm).

data.Name: minor axis
data.Description: Length of the minor (short) axis of an ellipse.

data.Name: nom diameter
data.Description: Nominal (approximate, for naming purposes only) diameter of an object.

data.Name: nozzle size
data.Description: Diameter of the nozzle(s) used in an equipment item, such as a drill bit

data.Name: oil connection size
data.Description: Standard oil pipe size connection supplied on the equipment inlet

data.Name: oil metering line size
data.Description: Diameter of the oil metering line

data.Name: orifice plate diameter
data.Description: Diameter of orifice plate in gas metering system when a sample is taken

data.Name: outlet connection size
data.Description: The connection size of the output line to the equipment

data.Name: outside diameter
data.Description: Outside diameter of an entity, such as an item of drillstring equipment

data.Name: casing outside diameter
data.Description: Casing outer diameter

data.Name: centralizer outside diameter
data.Description: Centralizer outside diameter

data.Name: conn 1 outside diameter
data.Description: Outside diameter of tool joint/connection 1

data.Name: conn 1 size
data.Description: Size of the top or the first standard tool connection.

data.Name: conn 2 outside diameter
data.Description: Outside diameter of tool joint/connection 2

data.Name: conn 2 size
data.Description: Size of the bottom or second standard tool connection.

data.Name: fishneck diameter
data.Description: Diameter of the fishing neck of an equipment item.

data.Name: inner pipe outside diameter
data.Description: Outer diameter of the inner pipe

data.Name: max outside diameter
data.Description: Maximum outside diameter of an equipment item.

data.Name: nom max outside diameter
data.Description: Nominal maximum outside diameter, such as for a pilot hole.

data.Name: min compress outside diameter
data.Description: Minimum compressed outside diameter, such as for a centralizer.

data.Name: min outside diameter
data.Description: Minimum outside diameter of an equipment item.

data.Name: nom outside diameter
data.Description: Nominal (approximate, for naming purposes only) outside diameter of an equipment item.

data.Name: tube nom outside diameter
data.Description: Nominal outside diameter of body or API nominal outside diameter of tube

data.Name: pipe outside diameter
data.Description: Outside diameter of pipe

data.Name: shank diameter
data.Description: Outer diameter of the equipment shank; for a drill bit, the shank is the portion of the bit body between the threaded connection and the base of the bit leg (for roller cone bits) or bit crown (for fixed cutter bits).

data.Name: wire diameter
data.Description: Diameter of wire, such as that used in a mesh or a slotted liner

data.Name: perforation diameter
data.Description: The diameter of the perforation entrance hole. Often called Entrance Hole Diameter.

data.Name: api entrance hole diameter
data.Description: Entrance hole diameter in an API Section I test

data.Name: pore throat diameter
data.Description: The measured or effective diameter of the aperture which connects pores or void spaces within a rock matrix.

data.Name: port diameter
data.Description: Diameter of each individual port

data.Name: pump liner diameter
data.Description: Diameter of the pump entry line

data.Name: reel core diameter
data.Description: Drum core diameter, such as for a coiled tubing reel

data.Name: screen mesh size
data.Description: Size of the mesh (usually expressed in inches) use to filter particles.

data.Name: solids control cone diameter
data.Description: Largest Inner Diameter of a Cone

data.Name: upset diameter
data.Description: Upset diameter (such as replaceable sleeve stabilizer)

data.Name: water connection size
data.Description: Standard water pipe size connection supplied on the equipment inlet

data.Name: water metering line size
data.Description: Diameter of the water metering line

data.Name: displacement
data.Description: The linear distance which a point or object is displaced with respect to another, usually as the result of some activity or process.

data.Name: fault displacement
data.Description: The measure of the relative movement of the 2 sides of a fault.

data.Name: fault heave
data.Description: Horizontal component of separation or displacement on a fault.

data.Name: geocentric dx
data.Description: X component of the translation of the center of a geodetic datum. One of seven parameters used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

data.Name: geocentric dy
data.Description: Y component of the translation of the center of a geodetic datum. One of seven parameters used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

data.Name: geocentric dz
data.Description: Z component of the translation of the center of a geodetic datum. One of seven parameters used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

data.Name: particle displacement
data.Description: The distance a particle is moved from its equilibrium position, as in ground motion associated with a seismic wave.

data.Name: x displacement
data.Description: Displacement in the X Direction relative to some coordinate system; e.g., the X-Component of the Well departure from the vertical.

data.Name: y displacement
data.Description: Displacement in the Y Direction relative to some coordinate system; e.g., the Y-Component of the Well departure from the vertical.

data.Name: distance
data.Description: Amount of separation between two points, lines, surfaces, or objects measured along the shortest path joining them.

data.Name: eccentering
data.Description: A measure of the amount by which an object is off-center with respect to another; e.g. the displacement between the axis of a logging tool and the borehole axis.

data.Name: etched half length
data.Description: Half Length of formation etched (dissolved) by reaction with acid (Acid fracturing)

data.Name: fishneck length
data.Description: Length of the fishing neck of an equipment item.

data.Name: fracture half length
data.Description: The length of one wing of a fracture, from the bore hole to one of its ends.

data.Name: fracture length
data.Description: The length of one wing of a fracture.

data.Name: frequency filter length
data.Description: Length of frequency filter

data.Name: from offset
data.Description: The distance from the mid-point of the "From" equipment to the bottom of the "To" equipment in a From_To connection.

data.Name: gauge length
data.Description: Length of the in-gauge portion of an equipment item.

data.Name: height
data.Description: The distance from the bottom to the top of something standing upright. Also, the extent of elevation above a level.

data.Name: altitude
data.Description: Height above a reference level, such as mean sea level.

data.Name: block height
data.Description: Position of the blocks above the drill floor reference point

data.Name: capillary transition zone height
data.Description: The vertical interval height that describes the transition between two different fluid phases in a porous media. This transition is caused by changes in saturation dependent capillary forces in equilibrium with gravitational forces.

data.Name: dip height
data.Description: Height of Dip Plane Intersection with Borehole

data.Name: elevation
data.Description: Height of some point above a horizontal reference plane.

data.Name: elevation cdp
data.Description: Surface elevation at a CDP with respect to mean sea level.

data.Name: fluid return elevation
data.Description: Elevation of the drill fluid return line measured from the defined elevation reference datum (normally kelly bushing or rig floor). Note that if the elevation is negative, the return line is below the elevation reference datum.

data.Name: receiver station datum elevation
data.Description: Datum elevation at each station relative to sea level

data.Name: fault throw
data.Description: Length of the vertical displacement of a Fault.

data.Name: fill height
data.Description: Height of unwanted material (formation sand, proppant, gravel pack failure, workover debris ...) filling up the wellbore

data.Name: fluid level
data.Description: The level of fluid in a column or vessel, normally expressed as height above (or below) some reference point.

data.Name: fracture element height
data.Description: Height of fracture element

data.Name: fracture height
data.Description: Height of a fracture.

data.Name: leakoff height
data.Description: Portion of the zone fracturing fluids will leakoff into. It can be an aggregate of a number of geologic formations.

data.Name: perspective height
data.Description: Height of the point of perspective; used in general perspective map projections.

data.Name: rig heave
data.Description: Amplitude of the vertical motion of the rig

data.Name: max rig heave
data.Description: Maximum amplitude of the vertical motion of the rig

data.Name: settled proppant height
data.Description: Height of the settled bank of proppant within a fracture, otherwise named pack height.

data.Name: vertical size
data.Description: The size of any object as measured vertically

data.Name: wave height
data.Description: Average trough-to-peak height of the waves.

data.Name: horizontal well flowing length
data.Description: Total Horizontal Well Flowing Length

data.Name: interval length
data.Description: The length of an interval along a path, such as a Borehole path.

data.Name: averaging interval
data.Description: Length of interval over which data are averaged.

data.Name: depth increment
data.Description: Length of interval which is used as a regular increment to depth-based processing.

data.Name: eou cone depth increment
data.Description: Depth increment of the ellipse of uncertainty cone

data.Name: gap length
data.Description: The length of gap usually detected in some pattern or geological feature. The length is usually an interval length like depth.

data.Name: material addition depth increment
data.Description: The depth increment at which the material addition takes place (e.g., Add 5 sacks of Barite C100 100lb/sack to the drilling fluid each 500 ft)

data.Name: pattern length
data.Description: The length of a pattern, usually pertaining to a dip pattern or a geological feature. The length is usually an interval length like depth.

data.Name: perforation distance
data.Description: Distance from the top of the hydraulic unit to the top of the perforations. For use in the partial penetration model.

data.Name: processing window length
data.Description: Length of processing window

data.Name: processing window length depth
data.Description: Length of processing window in depth domain

data.Name: segment length
data.Description: The length of a borehole segment.

data.Name: spacing x
data.Description: Spacing in X dimension; may be expressed as an absolute spacing with units or as a proportion of some reference X Spacing.

data.Name: spacing y
data.Description: Spacing in Y dimension; may be expressed as an absolute spacing with units or as a proportion of some reference X Spacing.

data.Name: spacing z
data.Description: Spacing in Z dimension; may be expressed as an absolute spacing with units or as a proportion of some reference X Spacing.

data.Name: tracking depth operator length
data.Description: Length of the cross correlation window to use while tracking

data.Name: zone length
data.Description: The length of a zone, usually along the borehole.

data.Name: investigation radius increase
data.Description: Increase of candidate borehole investigation radius

data.Name: length cocked
data.Description: Length of an equipment item such as a mechanical jar in cocked position

data.Name: length compressed
data.Description: Length of an equipment item such as a mechanical jar in compressed position

data.Name: length extended
data.Description: Length of an equipment item such as a mechanical jar in extended position

data.Name: length recovered
data.Description: Length of a sample recovered from some well operation (e.g. Core Sample).

data.Name: liquid radius
data.Description: Liquid radius in the Bowl = Bowl Inner Radius - Pond_Depth

data.Name: major dimension
data.Description: Major (normally longer) dimension of an object; the actual type of measurement depends upon the shape of the object. [Used for Drilling Targets, whose shapes could be Elliptical, Circular, Rectangular...]

data.Name: measure point offset
data.Description: Distance from the Measure Point to the Reference Plane for the assembly or tool; a positive value indicates that the Measure Point is above the Reference Plane.

data.Name: measure reference plane offset
data.Description: Distance from the Measure Reference Plane to the bottom of the Equipment (which is for a tool practically the make-up line of the bottom connection). The Measure Reference Plane allows recording of the location of the sensor measure point in an equipment composition. The measure point is positioned by a length called Measure_Point_Offset, a property of the composition to which the sensor belongs. The Measure_Point_Offset is the distance from the measure reference plane of the part, i.e., sensor or tool, to the measure reference plane of the whole, i.e., tool or tool string.

data.Name: pressure measure point
data.Description: The distance from the bottom of the Equipment to the point where the pressure is measured.

data.Name: temperature measure point
data.Description: The distance from the bottom of the Equipment to the point where the Temperature is measured

data.Name: tool measure point offset
data.Description: Distance from the Measure Point to the Tool Reference Plane (most often the bottom tool make-up plane); a positive value indicates that the Measure Point is above the Reference Plane. [Traditionally stored in Parameter MPOI on LIS/DLIS tapes.]

data.Name: tool string measure point offset
data.Description: Distance from the Measure Point to the Tool String (not just Tool!) Reference Plane; a positive value indicates that the Measure Point is above the Reference Plane. [Traditionally referred to as "tool zero".]

data.Name: migration length
data.Description: Length applied in seismic migration

data.Name: minor dimension
data.Description: Minor (normally shorter) dimension of an object; the actual type of measurement depends upon the shape of the object. [Used for Drilling Targets, whose shapes could be Elliptical, Circular, Rectangular...]

data.Name: neutron diffusion length
data.Description: Average straight-line distance a neutron travels at thermal energy levels before being absorbed by a formation nucleus.

data.Name: neutron slowing down length
data.Description: Average straight-line distance a neutron travels in being slowed from natural source energy to epithermal energy levels by collisions with formation nuclei.

data.Name: next receiver group distance
data.Description: For non-equidistant receiver groups, distance to next group

data.Name: nom length
data.Description: Nominal (approximate, for naming purposes only) length of an equipment item.

data.Name: tube nom length
data.Description: Nominal length of tube of body of equipment item.

data.Name: nom receiver group distance
data.Description: Nominal distance between consecutive receiver groups

data.Name: nom station distance
data.Description: Nominal distance between stations on a seismic line

data.Name: optical wave length
data.Description: Length of Optical Wave

data.Name: perforation length
data.Description: Length of the portion of the perforation which extends from the casing beyond the cement sheath and into the reservoir. It includes the casing thickness and the cement sheath thickness.

data.Name: api total penetration
data.Description: Total penetration in an API Section I test

data.Name: gravel packed perforation length
data.Description: Length of the portion of the perforation which is filled with Gravel Pack material.

data.Name: pitch length
data.Description: Measure of slope using the linear distance between two successive points: on a screw, between threads, measured parallel to the axis; for a propeller or spinner, the theoretical axial displacement corresponding to one revolution.

data.Name: propped half length
data.Description: Half Length of the part of an hydraulic fracture which is filled by proppant laden slurry . It is shorter during fracture propagation than the fracture half_length as the propped slurry follows a gel volume w/o proppant , the "clean" fluid

data.Name: radial length
data.Description: Length measured in a radial direction.

data.Name: radius
data.Description: Radius of an entity with a spherical or cylindrical shape, such as the borehole, an item of drillstring equipment, etc.

data.Name: borehole radius
data.Description: Radius of the open borehole. Normally taken as the radius of the drillbit.

data.Name: curvature radius
data.Description: Radius of the circle whose arc would have a given curvature.

data.Name: gooseneck radius
data.Description: Radius of the gooseneck in a Coil Tubing Unit, along which the tubing is bent; used in the fatigue model

data.Name: differential radius
data.Description: The difference between the actual radius of an object and its average radius; for boreholes, 1/2 bit size may be used instead of the average radius.

data.Name: ellipsoid a
data.Description: Length of the semi-major axis of the reference ellipsoid.

data.Name: ellipsoid b
data.Description: Length of the semi-minor axis of the reference ellipsoid.

data.Name: eou cone surface radius
data.Description: The radius of the ellipse of uncertainty cone at the surface location

data.Name: invasion radius
data.Description: The radius of the "invaded zone", the region in which drilling mud filtrate has invaded porous and permeable rock around the borehole.

data.Name: investigation radius
data.Description: The radius of a circle (or cylinder) which has the primary influence on a measurement; material or objects outside the Investigation_Radius have little or no effect on the measurement.

data.Name: origin rho
data.Description: Radial distance of the origin of a Local Coordinate System, measured with respect to the origin of the "from" coordinate system. Units, if any, are those of the "from" system.

data.Name: receiver line rho
data.Description: Horizontal (x-y) distance from origin of position in a receiver line.

data.Name: true receiver line position rho
data.Description: Horizontal (x-y) distance from origin of true position in a receiver line.

data.Name: receiver orientation rho
data.Description: Horizontal (x-y) distance from origin of downhole receiver.

data.Name: semi major axis
data.Description: Length of semi-major axis of an ellipse; in geodetic work, of a reference ellipsoid.

data.Name: semi minor axis
data.Description: Length of semi-minor axis of an ellipse; in geodetic work, of a reference ellipsoid.

data.Name: source line rho
data.Description: Horizontal (x-y) distance from origin of position in a source line.

data.Name: true source line position rho
data.Description: Horizontal (x-y) distance from origin of true position in a source line.

data.Name: source orientation rho
data.Description: Horizontal (x-y) distance from origin of downhole source.

data.Name: reference point offset
data.Description: Distance from the bottom of the Equipment to the Reference Point. The Reference_Point is the origin of the From_Offset distance for an Equipment mounted in From_Mounting_Location=Outside or Inside. The default position for the Reference point is the bottom end of the Equipment. The Reference point is used in drilling to save repositioning all the sensors mounted inside a tool when the end is remachined. There is just one reference point for any equipment mounted on this To_Equipment.

data.Name: reservoir distance
data.Description: The distance between two features in a reservoir, for use in modeling the reservoir.

data.Name: eff reservoir radius
data.Description: The characteristic radius of a reservoir used to quantify the behavior of a reservoir. This is the radius that a reservoir would have if circular in shape.

data.Name: external drainage radius
data.Description: The characteristic radius to the outer drainage boundary of a field or a reservoir

data.Name: horizontal well standoff
data.Description: Distance from Horizontal Well to bottom of the Hydraulic Unit

data.Name: hydraulic unit top to flowing top
data.Description: Distance from Top of Hydraulic Unit to Top of Flowing Interval
data.Code: hydraulic unit top to flowing top

data.Name: hydraulic unit top to perforation top
data.Description: Distance from Top of Hydraulic Unit to Top of Perforation
data.Code: hydraulic unit top to perforation top

data.Name: interwell distance
data.Description: Inter-well distance for a horizontal interference test

data.Name: rectangle height
data.Description: The height distance between two parallel boundaries in a rectangular reservoir model.

data.Name: rectangle length
data.Description: The length distance between two parallel boundaries in a rectangular reservoir model.

data.Name: rectangle width
data.Description: The width distance between two parallel boundaries in a rectangular reservoir model.

data.Name: well spacing
data.Description: Average distance between two wells, connected or not to regulatory petroleum laws

data.Name: well to boundary distance
data.Description: The distance between the well trajectory and the adjacent reservoir boundary distance.

data.Name: well to fault distance
data.Description: The distance between the sealing fault and the well trajectory.

data.Name: well to fracture element distance
data.Description: Distance from Borehole to start of fracture element

data.Name: running length
data.Description: Sum of all the displacements in one direction (generally downhole) made by a downhole equipment. Used as fatigue indicator or charged item in coil tubing operations.

data.Name: section length
data.Description: Length of one section, such as the nominal length of one section of a streamer.

data.Name: seismic offset
data.Description: The distance between source and receiver or geophone (seismic).

data.Name: critical distance
data.Description: In seismic work, the offset at which the reflection time equals the refraction time.

data.Name: nom near trace offset
data.Description: Nominal in-line offset between the sources and the first receiver group on each cable (for symmetric configurations)

data.Name: receiver offset
data.Description: The distance to a seismic receiver from some other object, such as a wellbore in VSP work.

data.Name: source offset
data.Description: The distance to the seismic source from some other object, such as a wellbore in VSP work.

data.Name: shank length
data.Description: Length of the equipment shank; for a drill bit, it is the distance from the face of the bit connection to the base of the bit leg (for roller cone bits) or bit crown (for fixed cutter bits).

data.Name: spurt
data.Description: (Fracturing) Volume of fluid flowing through a given area of porous media which leaks off during the formation of the filter cake. Spurt loss reduces the fluid volume available for fracture extension. Typical Unit: gal/100ft2.

data.Name: stab to bottom conn 1
data.Description: Length from the mid-point of the first stabilizer to the bottom connection of the tool

data.Name: stab to bottom conn 2
data.Description: Length from the mid-point of the second stabilizer to the bottom connection of the tool

data.Name: stab to bottom conn 3
data.Description: Length from the mid-point of the third stabilizer to the bottom connection of the tool

data.Name: standoff
data.Description: The amount of physical separation between two objects, usually maintained in order to control their interaction.

data.Name: perforation gun standoff
data.Description: Standoff of Perforation Gun

data.Name: sensor standoff
data.Description: The distance from a sensor to the medium being investigated, such as from a logging sonde to the wall of the borehole.

data.Name: streamer length
data.Description: The nominal length of the streamer.

data.Name: stretch
data.Description: The amount of elongation observed in an object as a result of its being placed under tension.

data.Name: stroke length
data.Description: Length of stroke (maximum travel), such as for a pump piston or for hydraulic jars).

data.Name: down stroke
data.Description: Down stroke distance, as used for drilling jars.

data.Name: up stroke
data.Description: Up stroke distance, as used for drilling jars. Maximum stroke travel in shock/cushion sub

data.Name: thickness
data.Description: The smallest of three dimensions {length, width, and thickness}

data.Name: apparent thickness
data.Description: Layer thickness measurement along the borehole, neither corrected for borehole deviation nor for layer dips

data.Name: avg bed thickness
data.Description: Average thickness of a geologic bed.

data.Name: cement sheath thickness
data.Description: Thickness of the cement sheath between casing and borehole wall.

data.Name: completed thickness
data.Description: Thickness of hydraulic unit actually contributing to the production.

data.Name: crushed zone thickness
data.Description: Thickness of the Crushed Zone around perforation

data.Name: damaged zone thickness
data.Description: Thickness of the near-wellbore Damaged Zone, the sandface layer around the wellbore where permeability and mobility are impaired, generally by a damaging material (e.g. completion or drilling fluid).

data.Name: filter cake thickness
data.Description: Filter cake thickness in API test

data.Name: min net thickness
data.Description: It is common in an interbedded reservoir for sands thinner than a certain cutoff thickness (Min_Net_Thickness) to be discarded as non net or non pay in a ResSum type analysis. However, a thick sand may have two closely spaced shale stringers, such that they create the effect of a thin sand separated from thick sands above and below by thin shale beds. In this case, if the shale beds are thinner than a second thickness threshold (Min_Non_Net_Thickness), the thin sand would be counted as net or pay.

data.Name: min non net thickness
data.Description: It is common in an interbedded reservoir for sands thinner than a certain cutoff thickness (Min_Net_Thickness) to be discarded as non net or non pay in a ResSum type analysis. However, a thick sand may have two closely spaced shale stringers, such that they create the effect of a thin sand separated from thick sands above and below by thin shale beds. In this case, if the shale beds are thinner than a second thickness threshold (Min_Non_Net_Thickness), the thin sand would be counted as net or pay.

data.Description: Name of a County or Parish

data.Name: def currency
data.Description: Default Currency used

data.Name: display name
data.Description: A name which is used for display purposes, as opposed to the formal controlled name (Code) which is used for interoperability.

data.Name: drill fluid name
data.Description: Name given to the drill fluid

data.Name: drill structure name
data.Description: Name of the Rig or Drill Structure operating on the well

data.Name: element tag
data.Description: Tag (label) used to reference an Element of a Collection.

data.Name: elevation reference name
data.Description: Name of the local elevation reference, such as "Kelly Bushing".

data.Name: ellipsoid name
data.Description: Name of the ellipsoid to which geodetic coordinates are referenced.

data.Name: field name
data.Description: Name given to a field; may be a company-specific or regulatory name.

data.Name: file name
data.Description: The name of a computer data file.

data.Name: boundary file
data.Description: Name of file containing boundaries

data.Name: documentation file
data.Description: Name of file containing related documentation

data.Name: graphic symbol file name
data.Description: Graphic symbol file specification. [In GeoFrame, this is typically a GPD file, e.g., gpd_lib/stop_symbol.gpd]

data.Name: graphical file
data.Description: Name of file containing related graphical information

data.Name: journal file
data.Description: File that maintains process history, i.e., the chain of actions performed on the object.

data.Name: library doc file
data.Description: Name of file containing documentation for (software) library.

data.Name: map file
data.Description: Name of file containing standard map.

data.Name: remote file
data.Description: Name of file on remote host

data.Name: source file
data.Description: File containing the original description of the object, e.g., TIF file for an image.

data.Name: file system name
data.Description: Name of computer operating system component which deals with data file storage, e.g. NFS (Unix), RMS (VMS).

data.Name: formation name
data.Description: Name given to a geologic formation; may be a local name or an accepted standard.

data.Name: function name
data.Description: Name of a software program function.

data.Name: capillary pressure function
data.Description: Name of the function used to represent capillary pressure.

data.Name: get function name
data.Description: Name of function used to read data.

data.Name: j function
data.Description: Name of the J Function, a function used to normalize capillary pressure to account for differences in permeability, porosity, and fluid systems.

data.Name: put function name
data.Description: Name of function used to write data.

data.Name: relative permeability function
data.Description: Name of the function used to represent relative permeability.

data.Name: geodetic datum name
data.Description: Name of the reference system that describes the position, orientation and scale relationship of the ellipsoid and the earth, such that referenced coordinates are unique.

data.Name: geodetic datum point
data.Description: Name of Origin of Geodetic Datum

data.Name: gpd lithology pattern
data.Description: Name of the GPD pattern used to draw the lithology.

data.Name: graphic symbol name
data.Description: Name assigned to a graphic symbol.

data.Name: input data name
data.Description: Name of the data used as input.

data.Name: language
data.Description: Name of spoken or written language, such as English, Spanish, French, Mandarin, Russian, Chichimeq...

data.Name: def language
data.Description: Default Language used

data.Name: lease name
data.Description: Name of a lease

data.Name: lease suffix
data.Description: Suffix associated with lease (e.g., OCS-G)

data.Name: major component
data.Description: The major component of a composition (e.g. the major component of a chemical product)

data.Name: method
data.Description: Name of method used, such as in acquiring or processing data.

data.Name: model name
data.Description: Name of a model or version of some entity; for equipment, it may coincide with the trade name.

data.Name: object name
data.Description: Name of an Object

data.Name: constraint object
data.Description: Name of Object holding descriptions of the constraints (e.g. String_Enum_Cat)

data.Name: entity object
data.Description: Name of the implementation object of the entity. A table name in a relational implementation.

data.Name: representation object
data.Description: Object instance name where Representation may be found if not specified.

data.Name: unit object
data.Description: Name of Object where Unit may be found if not specified

data.Name: oil compressibility correlation
data.Description: Name of the correlation model (often the author name) used to compute oil compressibility (e.g. Calhoun, Vasquez and Beggs)

data.Name: oil formation volume factor correlation
data.Description: Name of the correlation model (often the author name) used to compute oil formation volume factor (Vasquez_Beggs, Glaso, Standing)

data.Name: operating system name
data.Description: Name of computer Operating System, e.g. Unix, VMS, Windows NT.

data.Name: organization name
data.Description: Name of organization

data.Name: operator name
data.Description: The name of an operator of a well, an equipment, etc.

data.Name: owner name
data.Description: The name of the owner of an item like a piece of equipment.

data.Name: publisher name
data.Description: Name of Organization which published of a document.

data.Name: supplier
data.Description: Supplier name of a Product.

data.Name: outer continental shelf name
data.Description: Name of the submerged land area called the Outer Continental Shelf

data.Name: pattern name
data.Description: Name of a pattern or style, such as a graphic pattern.

data.Name: person name
data.Description: Name of a person

data.Name: author name
data.Description: Author of document

data.Name: client representative
data.Description: Name of the client representative or company man.

data.Name: contractor representative
data.Description: Name of the representative of the Contractor Company

data.Name: loaded by
data.Description: Name of person who loaded data

data.Name: modified by
data.Description: Name of person who modified data

data.Name: prime meridian name
data.Description: Name of the meridian from which longitudes are referenced. Normally the meridian through Greenwich is defined as the prime meridian.

data.Name: product name
data.Description: Official product name.

data.Name: projection zone code
data.Description: UTM Zone of projection.

data.Name: region of interest
data.Description: Geopolitical area of interest

data.Name: rock compressibility correlation
data.Description: Rock Compressibility Correlation (Sandstone, Carbonate)

data.Name: sdm domain name
data.Description: Name of the data domain, as described in the Schlumberger Data Model.

data.Name: section suffix
data.Description: A subsection single letter suffix designation a part of a Section, as used in California, USA

data.Name: short name
data.Description: Informal, usually shortened name given to an object or data item; a nickname.

data.Name: simulation layer name
data.Description: Name given to a layer in a reservoir simulation model.

data.Name: state name
data.Description: Name of a State

data.Name: table name
data.Description: Name of a database Table.

data.Name: element table
data.Description: Table containing an element of a collection.

data.Name: unit quantity table
data.Description: Name of database table where Unit may be found if not otherwise indicated.

data.Name: unit table
data.Description: Name of database table where Unit may be found if not otherwise indicated.

data.Name: value type table
data.Description: Name of database table where value type may be found if not otherwise indicated.

data.Name: title
data.Description: A formal descriptive name, such as for a publication; also used for the role of person in an organization.

data.Name: publication title
data.Description: Title of publication of a document.

data.Name: api reference
data.Description: The name of an API (American Petroleum Institute) reference, e.g., Bulletin D12A.

data.Name: article title
data.Description: Title of article or memo

data.Name: trade name
data.Description: An arbitrarily adopted name that is given by a manufacturer or merchant to an article or service to distinguish it as produced or sold by him and that may be used and protected as a trademark.

data.Name: vertical datum name
data.Description: Name of the permanent Vertical Datum to which the local elevation reference is related. Typical Vertical Datums are "Mean Sea Level" and "Least Astronomic Tide".

data.Name: water viscosity correlation
data.Description: Model used to compute water viscosity

data.Name: well name
data.Description: Name given to a well, quite possibly the legal name. The name may vary as ownership and rights are transferred.

data.Name: zone name
data.Description: Zone Name

data.Name: cross section
data.Description: A measure of the probability that a specific process will take place when a particle intersects a localized phenomenon (typically a nucleus)

data.Name: absorption cross section
data.Description: A measure of the probability that absorption will take place when a particle intersects a localized phenomenon (typically a nucleus)

data.Name: neutron capture cross section
data.Description: The effective area within which a neutron passes in order to be captured by an atomic nucleus. Commonly called Sigma.

data.Name: borehole neutron capture cross section
data.Description: The macroscopic neutron capture cross section, i.e. the effective cross sectional area per unit volume, of the borehole environment; used to correct "Sigma" log measurements for borehole effects.

data.Name: matrix neutron capture cross section
data.Description: The macroscopic capture cross section, i.e. the effective cross-sectional area per unit volume, of the rock matrix for the capture of neutrons.

data.Name: water neutron capture cross section
data.Description: The macroscopic capture cross section, i.e. the effective cross sectional area per unit volume, of water for the capture of neutrons.

data.Name: neutron scatter cross section
data.Description: The macroscopic scattering cross section, i.e. the effective cross sectional area where a neutron will scatter rather than being absorbed by a nucleus.

data.Name: nmr amplitude distribution
data.Description: Distribution of nuclear magnetic resonance amplitudes for different values of transverse relaxation time (T2); normally represented as a waveform of amplitude values indexed by T2 components.

data.Name: nmr diffusion coefficient
data.Description: In nuclear magnetic resonance analysis, the measure of the ability of the molecule containing the polarized proton to diffuse (or move) through a medium.

data.Name: none
data.Description: No property code applies; this is a temporary property type used to flag Parameters and Arrays for which we cannot make a meaningful mapping to any Property.

data.Name: optical density
data.Description: Measure of light absorption by a material: for a given wavelength, Optical Density = -log(Transmittance); generally measured as an absorption spectrum for different wavelengths of light.

data.Name: ordinal number
data.Description: A number used to indicate the position, rank or order of items in a sequence.

data.Name: acquisition file number
data.Description: Acquisition system file number

data.Name: acquisition shot number
data.Description: Acquisition system shot number

data.Name: begin element
data.Description: The number of the first element, usually in an array or along an axis.

data.Name: bob number
data.Description: Bob number. The bob is the inner cylinder of a cylindrical rheometer. Each number corresponds to a different size. Standard bob is #1

data.Name: coil tubing section
data.Description: Number of the Coiled Tubing section used by the CoilLIFE module.

data.Name: dip number
data.Description: An ordinal identifier that characterizes uniquely each dip

data.Name: bottom dip number
data.Description: Number of Dip (in the Dip Set) at the bottom of the Bed

data.Name: top dip number
data.Description: Number of Dip (in the Dip Set) at the top of the Bed

data.Name: end element
data.Description: The number of the last element, usually in an array or along an axis.

data.Name: frame number
data.Description: Multi-source/multi-receiver shot record identifier

data.Name: from conn number
data.Description: Indicates which end (1 or 2 for tubulars, 3 for a hydraulic tee,...) of the "From" equipment is connected to the "To" equipment

data.Name: level number
data.Description: Identifier of a particular level in a sequence; used by GeoFrame as an auxiliary depth identifier.

data.Name: mineral number
data.Description: Index in the cumulative mineral array which are naturally indexed and not indexed by Zone_Number.

data.Name: mixing order
data.Description: Order in which the materials are added together. This order matters e.g. the acid is poured into the water and not the contrary, the water to the flour ...

data.Name: polynomial order
data.Description: Order of term in a polynomial, such as in a multiple regression equation.

data.Name: rank
data.Description: Integer denoting the order of an element in a collection, such as the rank of a Layer participating in a Sequence or Stratigraphic Column.

data.Name: tubular string component rank
data.Description: A rank denoting the order of the element in a string of tubular drilling equipment.

data.Name: rotor number
data.Description: Number of the rotor. (For a cylindrical rheometer, each number corresponds to a different size. Standard Rotor is #1)

data.Name: run number
data.Description: The number (or rank) associated with a particular run of a tool or activity. Use is discouraged due to ambiguity when services are combined or when complete history unavailable; time of data acquisition is more reliable.

data.Name: bha run number
data.Description: Sequence number of the bottomhole assembly (BHA) run.

data.Name: bit run number
data.Description: Sequence number of the bit run.

data.Name: sensor number
data.Description: Sensor number

data.Name: sequence number
data.Description: Number used to identify or index an element in a sequence.

data.Name: copy number
data.Description: Number used to identify an instance of a particular type object within a set.

data.Name: sys copy number
data.Description: Number used to identify an instance of a particular type object within a set; used in conjunction with Copy_Number in GeoFrame.

data.Name: shotsequence number
data.Description: Nominal ordering matching raw receiver sort

data.Name: spring number
data.Description: Spring number of a cylindrical rheometer corresponding to a particular stiffness. Fann 35 spr #1stiffness is 2.2116E-3 Nm/Rad

data.Name: stack number
data.Description: Stack number

data.Name: station number
data.Description: Depth identifier

data.Name: test number
data.Description: The number (or rank) associated with a particular test activity.

data.Name: tko model order
data.Description: Number of arrivals assumed per frequency in Pronys dispersion analysis (TKO)

data.Name: true common depthpoint number
data.Description: CDP Line Number

data.Name: waveform number
data.Description: Waveform number

data.Name: zone number
data.Description: An ordinal identifier that uniquely characterizes each zone

data.Name: orientation
data.Description: The spatial orientation of an object. Usually defined by a vector who origin location is known relative to a coordinate system (e.g., in spherical coordinates, the Vector will be defined by the 3 angles Rho, Theta and Phi)

data.Name: direction
data.Description: The line or course on which something is moving or is aimed to move or along which something is pointing or facing.

data.Name: scal flood direction
data.Description: Direction of fluid flow through the sample in the laboratory (e.g. Horizontal, Downwards, Upwards). Water-oil experiments are almost always horizontal, gas-liquid experiments may be horizontal or vertical. If they are vertical they are done in the gravity stable direction. For example gas flooding an oil filled plug would be downwards, water flooding a gas filled plug would be upwards.

data.Name: local paleo shoreline orient
data.Description: The orientation of a shoreline pertaining to the local paleontology.

data.Name: perforation shot density
data.Description: The perforation density; i.e., the number of shots per unit length.

data.Name: permeability
data.Description: A property of rock (formation) denoting its ability to pass fluids through its interconnected pores.

data.Name: absolute permeability
data.Description: The permeability of porous material when completely saturated with a wetting fluid and without the influence of non-Darcy (turbulence) effects. Also called "intrinsic" permeability.

data.Name: absolute permeability gas
data.Description: The permeability of porous material when completely saturated with gas.

data.Name: absolute permeability oil
data.Description: The permeability of porous material when completely saturated with oil.

data.Name: absolute permeability water
data.Description: The permeability of porous material when completely saturated with water.

data.Name: klinkenberg permeability
data.Description: Empirical permeability measure derived by extrapolating the trend of gas permeability versus inverse pressure to infinite pressure (zero inverse pressure). The result is equivalent to the permeability which would be measured if the sample were 100% saturated with a non-reactive liquid and is sometimes called "liquid permeability" and abbreviated KL (where L is a subscript).

data.Name: crushed zone permeability
data.Description: Permeability of the Crushed Zone around perforation

data.Name: damaged zone permeability
data.Description: Permeability of the near-wellbore Damaged Zone, the sandface layer around the wellbore where permeability and mobility are impaired, generally by a damaging material (e.g. completion or drill mud).

data.Name: directional permeability
data.Description: An oriented permeability within a porous media, expressed either as horizontal (along the bedding plane of the stratum) or vertical (perpendicular to the bedding plane of the stratum), or within a coordinate system.

data.Name: horizontal permeability
data.Description: A permeability oriented horizontally along the bedding plane of the stratum. Usually abbreviated as Kx.

data.Name: permeability axial path
data.Description: Permeability measured along the length of a core cylinder.

data.Name: permeability transverse path
data.Description: Permeability measured in the plane transverse to the length of the core cylinder. This may be represented as a single measurement in the flow plane or as a two component permeability represented as a measurement along an arbitrary diameter and another along an orthogonal path in the same plane.

data.Name: spherical permeability
data.Description: An effective permeability used to combine directional permeabilities, Kx and Ky. Usually abbreviated as Ksph.

data.Name: vertical permeability
data.Description: A permeability oriented vertically perpendicular to the bedding plane of the stratum. Usually abbreviated as Ky.

data.Name: x direction permeability
data.Description: Permeability in X Direction

data.Name: y direction permeability
data.Description: Permeability in Y Direction

data.Name: effective permeability
data.Description: The measure of the capacity of a single fluid to flow through a rock when the pore spaces of the rock are not completely filled or saturated with the fluid.

data.Name: effective permeability gas
data.Description: The measure of the capacity of gas to flow through a rock when the pore spaces of the rock contain other fluids.

data.Name: effective permeability gas sor
data.Description: Effective permeability to gas at residual oil saturation.

data.Name: effective permeability gas swi
data.Description: Effective permeability to gas at initial water saturation.

data.Name: effective permeability gas swr
data.Description: Effective permeability to gas at residual water saturation.

data.Name: effective permeability oil
data.Description: The measure of the capacity of oil to flow through a rock when the pore spaces of the rock contain other fluids.

data.Name: effective permeability oil swi
data.Description: Effective permeability to oil at initial water saturation.

data.Name: effective permeability water
data.Description: The measure of the capacity of water to flow through a rock when the pore spaces of the rock contain other fluids.

data.Name: effective permeability water sor
data.Description: Effective permeability to water at residual oil saturation.

data.Name: geometric mean permeability
data.Description: Mean permeability in horizontal or vertical plane, computed as the square root of the product of the normal directional permeability values (e.g. X-Y or Y-Z) in the plane.

data.Name: horizontal mean permeability
data.Description: Geometric mean permeability in the horizontal plane (X-Y) of the reservoir.

data.Name: vertical mean permeability
data.Description: Geometric mean permeability in the vertical plane (Y-Z) of the reservoir

data.Name: min permeability
data.Description: Minimum value of Permeability

data.Name: net pay permeability
data.Description: Average permeability in the net pay portion of the zone interval (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

data.Name: net reservoir core permeability point match
data.Description: Average permeability in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from core data by point-match method.
data.Code: net reservoir core permeability point match

data.Name: net reservoir log permeability point match
data.Description: Average permeability in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from log data by point-match method.
data.Code: net reservoir log permeability point match

data.Name: net reservoir permeability
data.Description: Average permeability in the net reservoir portion of the zone interval (thickness weighted arithmetic/geometric/harmonic average).

data.Name: nmr permeability
data.Description: Formation permeability as measured with an nuclear magnetic logging device.

data.Name: permeance
data.Description: Prepensity of a material to conduct magnetic flux; inverse of reluctance. Units of inductance but not the same property

data.Name: permittivity
data.Description: The property of a material that enables it to store electrical charge, typically measured in farad/m. Free space has a Permittivity of 8.854E-12 farad/m.

data.Name: photoelectric factor
data.Description: A measure of the probability that scattering due the Photoelectric Effect will occur; often expressed in an approximation unit barns/electron.

data.Name: filter cake photoelectric factor
data.Description: Photoelectric Factor of the filter cake (mudcake); often expressed in an approximation unit barns/electron.

data.Name: matrix photoelectric factor
data.Description: Photoelectric Factor of the matrix (zero-porosity rock) or pure material; often expressed in an approximation unit barns/electron.

data.Name: plane angle
data.Description: The angular displacement between two lines extending from the same point, measured in the plane of the two lines.

data.Name: 1 minute gel test deflection
data.Description: The maximum reading (deflection) taken from a direct-reading viscometer after the fluid has been quiescent for 1 minutes.

data.Name: 10 minute gel test deflection
data.Description: The maximum reading (deflection) taken from a direct-reading viscometer after the fluid has been quiescent for 10 minutes.

data.Name: 10 second gel test deflection
data.Description: The maximum reading (deflection) taken from a direct-reading viscometer after the fluid has been quiescent for 10 seconds.

data.Name: 30 minute gel test deflection
data.Description: The maximum reading (deflection) taken from a direct-reading viscometer after the fluid has been quiescent for 30 minutes.

data.Name: azimuth
data.Description: Horizontal angle measured clockwise from true North. (Also referred to as True Bearing.) Occasionally azimuth will be specified relative to some other reference.

data.Name: axis azimuth
data.Description: Azimuth of the axis, usually pertaining to a depositional environment such as a tidal-flat.

data.Name: borehole failure azimuth
data.Description: The azimuth of the point at which borehole failure starts.

data.Name: central line bearing
data.Description: Azimuth of central line of projection.

data.Name: compass bearing
data.Description: The azimuth of an object with respect to magnetic north.

data.Name: dip azimuth
data.Description: Azimuth of the direction of maximum dip of a surface; dip may be computed in several ways, including from logs, from well-to-well correlation, from gradients on interpreted time or depth surfaces, etc.

data.Name: apparent dip azimuth north
data.Description: In the plane perpendicular to the borehole, viewed from above the tool, angle measured clockwise from the projection of the north direction to the projection of the true dip azimuth.

data.Name: apparent dip azimuth tool
data.Description: In the plane perpendicular to the borehole, viewed from above the tool, angle measured clockwise from logging tool reference direction to the projection of the true dip azimuth.

data.Name: apparent dip azimuth top of hole
data.Description: In the plane perpendicular to the borehole, viewed from above the tool, angle measured clockwise from the top of hole direction to the projection of the true dip azimuth.
data.Code: apparent dip azimuth top of hole

data.Name: relative dip azimuth
data.Description: Azimuth of formation dip relative to structural dip; computed by subtracting structural dip from true dip (dip removal).

data.Name: direction channel to axis
data.Description: Azimuth of the direction to an axis, usually pertaining to a sedimentary channel.

data.Name: direction channel to flow
data.Description: Azimuth of the direction to flow, usually pertaining to a sedimentary channel.

data.Name: direction channel to land
data.Description: Azimuth of the direction to land, usually pertaining to a sedimentary channel.

data.Name: direction current
data.Description: The azimuth of the flow direction that insured transportation an deposition of the sediments.

data.Name: direction downthrown block
data.Description: Azimuth of the direction to the downthrown block in case of faulting in the Earth subsurface.

data.Name: direction overthrust
data.Description: Azimuth of the direction of overthrust in case of faulting in the Earth subsurface.

data.Name: direction to source
data.Description: The direction from which sediments are brought

data.Name: eccentering azimuth
data.Description: Azimuth of the line from the center of an area to an eccentered object.

data.Name: fault strike
data.Description: The azimuth of the strike of a fault.

data.Name: fracture azimuth
data.Description: The azimuth of a fracture usually in an interval of the borehole.

data.Name: fracture orientation
data.Description: The orientation of a fracture relative to north.

data.Name: great circle azimuth
data.Description: The azimuth of a plane represented by a great circle.

data.Name: hole azimuth
data.Description: The angle between a vertical plane tangent to the borehole and north.

data.Name: image origin azimuth
data.Description: The azimuth of a point on an object corresponding to the origin of an image of the object (left side of core image)

data.Name: magnetic declination
data.Description: The horizontal angle measured from a meridian to the direction of magnetic north as determined by a freely suspended magnet. Positive if magnetic North is east of True North.

data.Name: major axis azimuth
data.Description: Major axis Azimuth of the ellipse of uncertainty (related parameter: EOU_MAJOR_AXIS_AZIM)

data.Name: min horizontal stress azimuth
data.Description: The minimum horizontal stress azimuth with respect to true north.

data.Name: polarization azimuth
data.Description: Shear energy polarization azimuth angle measured clockwise from grid north.

data.Name: interval polarization azimuth
data.Description: Estimation of the polarization azimuth angle for a layer.

data.Name: stack polarization azimuth
data.Description: Estimation of the polarization azimuth angle for all layers to the current dept.

data.Name: projection azimuth
data.Description: Azimuth of positive y-axis of projection.

data.Name: projection relative bearing
data.Description: Projection relative bearing

data.Name: raw relative bearing
data.Description: Raw relative bearing

data.Name: rig heading
data.Description: Azimuth of the direction to which the rig is facing.

data.Name: sensor azimuth
data.Description: The azimuth of a sensor on a logging device, used to determine the orientation of the device.

data.Name: small circle azimuth
data.Description: The azimuth of the pole associated with a small circle.

data.Name: thin out azimuth
data.Description: Azimuth of the thin out of a barrier type depositional environment.

data.Name: tool azimuth
data.Description: Angle measured clockwise from North to the horizontal projection of the radius passing through the tool angle reference point. One of Tool_Azimuth or Relative_Bearing must be present

data.Name: trace azimuth
data.Description: The Azimuth coordinate of a trace

data.Name: velocity ellipticity azimuth
data.Description: Fastest direction of elliptic anisotropic velocity (i.e. ellipse major axis) measured clockwise from grid north in degrees.

data.Name: interval velocity ellipticity azimuth
data.Description: Estimation of the velocity ellipticity azimuth angle for a layer

data.Name: stack velocity ellipticity azimuth
data.Description: Estimation of the velocity ellipticity azimuth for all layers to the current depth.

data.Name: vertical section azimuth
data.Description: Angle between the true north and the vertical section plane.

data.Name: wave azimuth
data.Description: Azimuth of the direction from which the waves are coming.

data.Name: wind azimuth
data.Description: Azimuth of the direction from which the wind is blowing.

data.Name: bearing
data.Description: The horizontal angle between the direction to a point and the direction of some reference line, normally measured as a clockwise angle from the reference line.

data.Name: bend 1 angle
data.Description: Angle of first bend in equipment item.

data.Name: max bend 1 angle
data.Description: Maximum first bent angle

data.Name: bend 1 bend 2 angle
data.Description: Angle between the planes defined by the first and second bends in the equipment string.

data.Name: bend 2 angle
data.Description: Angle of second bend in equipment item.

data.Name: max bend 2 angle
data.Description: Maximum second bent angle

data.Name: bend 2 bend 3 angle
data.Description: Angle between the planes defined by the second and third bends in the equipment string.

data.Name: binset skew
data.Description: Angle between Binset axes measured counterclockwise from positive X axis to positive Y axis

data.Name: blade spiral
data.Description: Degree of spiral blade coverage 0, 270, 450, -270. (0-straight blade; Negative-left spiral; Positive-right spiral)

data.Name: bladeface
data.Description: In directional drilling, the angle between a (sensor-bearing) stabilizer blade and a fixed reference, measured in a plane normal to the drillstring. In near-vertical applications, North is the fixed reference (Magnetic_Bladeface); for higher deviation applications, Top of Hole is the reference (Gravity_Bladeface).

data.Name: gravity bladeface
data.Description: In directional drilling, the angle between Top of Hole and a sensor contained in a stabilizer blade; used in hole sections of high deviation. Measurement is from -180 to +180 degrees.

data.Name: magnetic bladeface
data.Description: In directional drilling, the angle between Magnetic North and a sensor contained in a stabilizer blade; Measurement represents an Azimuth, with values from 0 to 360 degrees.

data.Name: critical angle
data.Description: Angle of incidence for which a refracted ray follows the surface of contact between two media of different velocities.

data.Name: declination
data.Description: The angle between the celestial equator and a celestial body, measured along a great circle passing through the celestial poles.

data.Name: deviation
data.Description: Angular departure from some reference direction. When used with wells, it is the angle between the borehole axis and the vertical (also known as the Drift Angle).

data.Name: hole deviation
data.Description: Angle between the borehole axis and the vertical (also known as the Drift Angle and, in the drilling industry, Inclination).

data.Name: bit inclination
data.Description: Inclination of the drillstring as measured as the bit

data.Name: downhole inclination
data.Description: Inclination of the drillstring as measured downhole

data.Name: max hole deviation
data.Description: Maximum deviation value of the wellbore from the vertical

data.Name: tool deviation
data.Description: Angle between the tool axis and the vertical.

data.Name: tool deviation x
data.Description: X-axis component of the angle between the tool axis and the vertical.

data.Name: tool deviation y
data.Description: Y-axis component of the angle between the tool axis and the vertical.

data.Name: dilation angle
data.Description: Angle relating the increase in volumetric strain with stress.

data.Name: dip angle
data.Description: The maximum vertical angle that a surface; e.g. a bedding or fault surface, makes with the horizontal, measured perpendicular to the strike direction of the structure. Dip may be computed in several ways, including from logs, from well-to-well correlation, from gradients on interpreted time or depth surfaces (See Time_Dip and Depth_Dip), etc.

data.Name: apparent dip angle
data.Description: Angle between the dip plane and the plane perpendicular to the borehole

data.Name: crossline dip
data.Description: Angle that a surface, e.g. a bedding or fault surface, makes with the horizontal, measured in the cross-line direction.

data.Name: interval crossline dip
data.Description: Estimation of the crossline dip for a layer.

data.Name: stack crossline dip
data.Description: Estimation of the crossline dip for all layers to the current depth.

data.Name: depth dip
data.Description: Dip computed on a depth surface by measuring the difference in depths between two points compared to the horizontal distance between the points.

data.Name: correlation depth dip
data.Description: Dip of seismic data, similar to Depth_Dip but gradient derived from the seismic data (in depth)

data.Name: feature dip
data.Description: Dip computed on a general feature surface by measuring the difference in attribute values between two points compared to the horizontal distance between the points.

data.Name: great circle dip
data.Description: The dip of the plane represented by a great circle.

data.Name: inline dip
data.Description: Angle that a surface, e.g. a bedding or fault surface, makes with the horizontal, measured in the in-line direction.

data.Name: interval inline dip
data.Description: Estimation of the inline dip for a layer.

data.Name: stack inline dip
data.Description: Estimation of the inline dip for all layers to the current depth.

data.Name: relative dip angle
data.Description: Magnitude of formation dip relative to structural dip; computed by subtracting structural dip from true dip (dip removal).

data.Name: small circle dip
data.Description: The angle of the pole associated with a small circle.

data.Name: time dip
data.Description: Dip computed on a time surface by measuring the difference in seismic times between two points compared to the horizontal distance between the points.

data.Name: correlation time dip
data.Description: Dip of seismic data, similar to Time_Dip but gradient derived from the seismic data in time)

data.Name: eccentering azimuth offset
data.Description: Offset in azimuth due to eccentering; used to convert azimuth values with respect to an eccentered position into azimuth values relative to center.

data.Name: failure arc
data.Description: The portion of the borehole circumference that has failed, expressed as the angle subtended by the arc length of the failure.

data.Name: fault hade
data.Description: The angle that a fault plane makes with the vertical.

data.Name: flex joint angle
data.Description: Angle between riser and blowout preventer at the flex joint.

data.Name: friction angle
data.Description: Angle relating the increase in shear strength with compressive strength.

data.Name: great circle axis
data.Description: The pole to a plane represented by a great circle.

data.Name: grid convergence angle
data.Description: Angle to be used in converting azimuths between true north and grid north or the Y axis of the cartographic projection. [Geoshare convention: True Azimuth = Grid Azimuth + Grid_Convergence_Angle]

data.Name: incident angle
data.Description: The angle which the raypath of an incident ray makes with the perpendicular to the interface. In an isotropic medium, it is the same as the angle that a wavefront makes with the interface.

data.Name: inclination
data.Description: The vertical angle between a line and the horizontal; has historically been used in the drilling industry to mean the angle between the borehole path and vertical (the term Hole_Deviation is preferred for this concept).

data.Name: magnetic inclination
data.Description: The vertical angle measured between the horizontal plane and the direction of magnetic north as determined by a freely suspended magnet. Sometimes known as magnetic dip. Positive values if the direction to magnetic north is below the horizon.

data.Name: max inclination
data.Description: Maximum inclination of sensor

data.Name: receiver orientation phi
data.Description: Vertical angle of downhole receiver, measured from the x-y plane.

data.Name: screen angle
data.Description: Angle of the screen, with respect to horizontal

data.Name: source orientation phi
data.Description: Vertical angle of downhole source, measured from the x-y plane.

data.Name: vertical rotation
data.Description: Vertical inclination of the ellipses of uncertainties relative to the wellbore at the associated survey point.

data.Name: interfault angle
data.Description: The smallest angle between two intersecting sealing faults in a wedge well test model.

data.Name: latitude
data.Description: The angle between the axis of the Earth and a tangent to the ellipsoid which approximates the shape of the Earth.

data.Name: base latitude
data.Description: Latitude value used as the basis or starting point, such as in a multiple regression computation.

data.Name: central line pt1 latitude
data.Description: Latitude of first point on central line of projection.

data.Name: central line pt2 latitude
data.Description: Latitude of second point on central line of projection.

data.Name: geodetic datum point latitude
data.Description: Latitude of Origin of Geodetic Datum

data.Name: northing latitude
data.Description: Latitude of Northing reference point.

data.Name: origin latitude
data.Description: The latitude of the point of origin of an orthogonal grid constructed on a map projection. Frequently this is a projection standard parallel, but can be any defined latitude.

data.Name: scale factor latitude
data.Description: Latitude at which scale factor is exact.

data.Name: std parallel
data.Description: Latitude of parallel along which scale is true.

data.Name: std parallel 1
data.Description: First line of latitude along which scale is true, for map projections using two standard parallels; this parallel is NEAREST to the EQUATOR.

data.Name: std parallel 2
data.Description: Second line of latitude along which scale is true, for map projections using two standard parallels; this parallel is NEAREST to the POLE.

data.Name: true scale latitude
data.Description: Latitude at which scale is true, as with a standard parallel.

data.Name: longitude
data.Description: Angle measured about the spheroid (or ellipsoid) axis from a local prime meridian to the meridian through the point. A positive value denotes East.

data.Name: base longitude
data.Description: Longitude value used as the basis or starting point, such as in a multiple regression computation.

data.Name: central line pt1 longitude
data.Description: Longitude of first point on central line of projection.

data.Name: central line pt2 longitude
data.Description: Longitude of second point on central line of projection.

data.Name: central meridian
data.Description: The meridian on a graticule that is the axis of symmetry for the geometric properties of the graticule displayed on a map projection.

data.Name: eastern meridian
data.Description: The meridian on a graticule that is the eastern extreme on a map projection.

data.Name: geodetic datum point longitude
data.Description: Longitude of Origin of Geodetic Datum

data.Name: longitude reference 1
data.Description: Latitude of first reference point in projection definition.

data.Name: longitude reference 2
data.Description: Latitude of second reference point in projection definition.

data.Name: northing longitude
data.Description: Longitude of Northing reference point.

data.Name: origin longitude
data.Description: The longitude of the point of origin of an orthogonal grid constructed on a map projection. Frequently this is the central meridian, but can be any defined longitude

data.Name: prime meridian greenwich offset
data.Description: Longitude of the prime meridian referenced from the meridian through Greenwich. Positive denotes east of Greenwich. Example: PARIS PANTHEON meridian in France is at longitude 2.337229 degrees.

data.Name: principal meridian
data.Description: Principal Meridian of Jeffersonian_Parcel

data.Name: scale factor longitude
data.Description: Longitude at which scale factor is exact.

data.Name: max bend angle
data.Description: Maximum bend angle range available, as in a bent sub.

data.Name: multi comp compressional angle
data.Description: The angle between the vector perpendicular to the wave front, and the amplitude vector of the seismic defined by the X,Y and Z components. Seabed compressional velocity used.

data.Name: multi comp shear angle
data.Description: The angle between the vector perpendicular to the wave front and the amplitude vector of the seismic defined by the X,Y and Z components. Seabed shear velocity used.

data.Name: p wave angle
data.Description: P-wave angle

data.Name: phase shift
data.Description: The difference in phase between two phase measurements; the result of adding or subtracting from a phase measurement.

data.Name: electromagnetic phase shift
data.Description: Difference in phase of two electromagnetic waves.

data.Name: mis tie phase correction
data.Description: Phase correction to apply to line to compensate for differences in Tie_Point_Phase_Shift

data.Name: tie point phase shift
data.Description: Phase difference between traces of seismic lines at a tie point.

data.Name: reflection angle
data.Description: The angle which the raypath of a reflected ray makes with the perpendicular to the interface. At the "reflection point" it is equal to the Incident_Angle for pressure-pressure or shear-shear reflections.

data.Name: relative bearing
data.Description: Angle measured clockwise from top of hole to tool angular reference point in the plane perpendicular to the tool axis, viewed from above the tool.

data.Name: rheometer deviation
data.Description: Vector of deviation angles of the rheometer related to the vector of given Angular Velocity

data.Name: riser angle
data.Description: Angle of the marine riser with the vertical.

data.Name: rotation
data.Description: The angular displacement of a rotating body or figure.

data.Name: geocentric rx
data.Description: Rotation of the geocentric Cartesian coordinate system about its X axis. One of seven parameters used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

data.Name: geocentric ry
data.Description: Rotation of the geocentric Cartesian coordinate system about its Y axis. One of seven parameters used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

data.Name: geocentric rz
data.Description: Rotation of the geocentric Cartesian coordinate system about its Z axis. One of seven parameters used in the Bursa-Wolf transformation.

data.Name: rotation 1
data.Description: Value of first rotation, as indicated by the first token in ROTATION_SENSE, used in transforming a coordinate system into a new (local) coordinate system.

data.Name: rotation 2
data.Description: Value of second rotation, as indicated by the second token in ROTATION_SENSE, used in transforming a coordinate system into a new (local) coordinate system.

data.Name: rotation 3
data.Description: Value of third rotation, as indicated by the third token in ROTATION_SENSE, used in transforming a coordinate system into a new (local) coordinate system.

data.Name: s wave angle
data.Description: S-wave angle

data.Name: slant rig angle
data.Description: Slant rig angle

data.Name: source angle
data.Description: Source angle

data.Name: survey bearing
data.Description: The horizontal angle of an object, measured as a departure from some datum direction, such as North or South. Representations typically indicate the datum and the direction of measurement, such as [N 26.46(deg) W].

data.Name: theta angle
data.Description: The horizontal angle measured counterclockwise from the x-axis.

data.Name: receiver line theta
data.Description: Horizontal angle of position in a receiver line, measured counter-clockwise from x-axis.

data.Name: true receiver line position theta
data.Description: Horizontal angle of true position in a receiver line, measured counter-clockwise from x-axis.

data.Name: receiver orientation theta
data.Description: Horizontal angle of downhole receiver, measured counter-clockwise from x-axis.

data.Name: source line theta
data.Description: Horizontal angle of position in a source line, measured counter-clockwise from x-axis.

data.Name: true source line position theta
data.Description: Horizontal angle of true position in a source line, measured counter-clockwise from x-axis.

data.Name: source orientation theta
data.Description: Horizontal angle of downhole source, measured counter-clockwise from x-axis.

data.Name: toolface
data.Description: In directional drilling, the angle between a reference direction on the drill string and a fixed reference, measured in a plane normal to the drillstring. In near-vertical applications, North is the fixed reference (Magnetic_Toolface); for higher deviation applications, Top of Hole is the reference (Gravity_Toolface).

data.Name: gravity toolface
