data.Description: In directional drilling, the angle between Top of Hole and a reference direction on the drill string (e.g. Y-Axis accelerometer); used in hole sections of high deviation. Measurement is from -180 to +180 degrees.

data.Name: magnetic toolface
data.Description: In directional drilling, the angle between North and a reference direction on the drill string (e.g. Y-Axis accelerometer); used in hole sections of low deviation. Measurement represents an Azimuth, with values from 0 to 360 degrees.

data.Name: well to fault angle
data.Description: The angle between the well and either sealing fault in a wedge well test model.

data.Name: wellbore tortuosity amplitude angle
data.Description: Amplitude translated as an inclination of the sinusoidal function fitting the survey station points and simulating a real well path

data.Name: wetting contact angle
data.Description: Angle between a fluid droplet and a solid surface at the point of contact; the lower the angle (measured inside the droplet), the greater the adhesion and thus the greater the wettability of the solid to that fluid.

data.Name: zenith angle
data.Description: Angle from an upward-pointing vertical line, measured in a vertical plane. A horizontal line has a zenith angle of 90 degrees

data.Name: anisotropic axis 1 crossline direction
data.Description: Angle of first (or only) anisotropic symmetry axis, relative to vertical, measured in the cross-line direction. Axis 1 on its own defines the rotational symmetry axis for transverse isotropy. If accompanied by Axis 2, they together define the symmetry planes for orthorhombic anisotropy.

data.Name: interval anisotropic axis 1 crossline direction
data.Description: Estimation of the anisotropic axis 1 crossline direction for a layer.

data.Name: stack anisotropic axis 1 crossline direction
data.Description: Estimation of the anisotropic axis 1 crossline direction for all layers to the current depth.

data.Name: anisotropic axis 1 inline direction
data.Description: Angle of first (or only) anisotropic symmetry axis, relative to vertical, measured in the in-line direction. Axis 1 on its own defines the rotational symmetry axis for transverse isotropy. If accompanied by Axis 2, they together define the symmetry planes for orthorhombic anisotropy.

data.Name: interval anisotropic axis 1 inline direction
data.Description: Estimation of the anisotropic axis 1 inline direction for a layer.

data.Name: stack anisotropic axis 1 inline direction
data.Description: Estimation of the anisotropic axis 1 inline direction for all layers to the current depth.

data.Name: anisotropic axis 2 crossline direction
data.Description: Angle of second anisotropic symmetry axis, relative to vertical, measured in the cross-line direction. Taken together with Axis 1, Axis 2 is used to define the symmetry planes for orthorhombic anisotropy.

data.Name: interval anisotropic axis 2 crossline direction
data.Description: Estimation of the anisotropic axis 2 crossline direction for a layer.

data.Name: stack anisotropic axis 2 crossline direction
data.Description: Estimation of the anisotropic axis 2 crossline direction for all layers to the current depth.

data.Name: anisotropic axis 2 inline direction
data.Description: Angle of second anisotropic symmetry axis, relative to vertical, measured in the in-line direction. Taken together with Axis 1, Axis 2 is used to define the symmetry planes for orthorhombic anisotropy.

data.Name: interval anisotropic axis 2 inline direction
data.Description: Estimation of the anisotropic axis 2 inline direction for a layer.

data.Name: stack anisotropic axis 2 inline direction
data.Description: Estimation of the anisotropic axis 2 inline direction for all layers to the current depth.

data.Name: potential difference per power drop
data.Description: Change in voltage drop per change in power

data.Name: power
data.Description: The time rate at which work is done or energy emitted or transferred.

data.Name: electromagnetic power
data.Description: The rate at which electromagnetic energy is emitted or transferred.

data.Name: energy rate
data.Description: Energy per unit time

data.Name: heat flow rate
data.Description: Heat flow per unit time

data.Name: hydraulic power
data.Description: Power produced or available from a system due to fluid flow, such as for pumps and turbines.

data.Name: cement unit power
data.Description: Cementing unit input horse power

data.Name: max hydraulic power
data.Description: Maximum hydraulic power (Flowrate x pressure) of a fluid. Often referred to Hydraulic horse power

data.Name: mud pump power
data.Description: Mud pump input horse power.

data.Name: nom hydraulic power
data.Description: Hydraulic (Flowrate x pressure) power that the equipment can sustain over a long period of time, as opposed to maximum working pressure which is the peak maximum

data.Name: optical power
data.Description: The rate at which optical energy is emitted or transferred.

data.Name: power per volume
data.Description: Power per volume

data.Name: heat source
data.Description: Describes the heat generation related to radiogenic decay in a rock

data.Name: pressure
data.Description: The force or thrust exerted over a surface divided by its area; e.g., hydrostatic, flow, pump, etc. May be gauge or absolute.

data.Name: abandon pressure
data.Description: The pressure at which a reservoir was or is expected to be abandoned.

data.Name: activation pressure
data.Description: Pressure at which recording should begin

data.Name: air supply pressure
data.Description: Air supply pressure; for a burner, the pressure required to achieve effective atomization

data.Name: annulus pressure
data.Description: Pressure of the fluid in the annulus. The annulus is the region outside the subject pipe, such as the region between drill pipe and the formation, or between casing and formation, or between tubing and casing.

data.Name: downhole annulus pressure
data.Description: The pressure in the annulus as measured by an MWD/LWD tool

data.Name: avg pressure
data.Description: Pressure averaged on a given time.

data.Name: avg reservoir pressure
data.Description: The average pressure (somewhere in the reservoir) between the borehole pressure and external boundary pressure.

data.Name: back pressure drop
data.Description: Constant pressure drop on a flowline used mainly to approximate any kind of restriction, choke, nozzle ...

data.Name: barometric pressure
data.Description: The pressure of the atmosphere (relative to vacuum) as measured by a barometer

data.Name: bottomhole pressure
data.Description: The pressure at the bottom of a borehole generally associated with the pore pressure of the formation open to the well.

data.Name: bottomhole circulating pressure
data.Description: The pressure at the bottom of a borehole during circulation of any fluid.

data.Name: bottomhole flowing pressure
data.Description: Flowing pressure inside the wellbore at midpoint of the completed interval. Res. Eng. Pwf

data.Name: bottomhole shutin pressure
data.Description: The pressure at the bottom of a borehole with the well shut in.

data.Name: drawdown pressure
data.Description: The difference in shut in and flowing bottomhole pressures, at a constant rate of fluid production.

data.Name: critical drawdown pressure
data.Description: The upper limit of drawdown pressure that can be applied to a completion system without causing damage to the system (such as erosion to a gravel pack completion system).

data.Name: breakdown pressure
data.Description: The pressure required to create a hydraulic fracture in an unfractured formation; it is greater than fracture closure pressure except in rare cases, such as very low fracture toughness and very large horizontal stress anisotropy.

data.Name: bubble point pressure
data.Description: The pressure at reservoir temperature at which gas in solution in crude oil comes out of solution as free gas.

data.Name: buildup pressure
data.Description: Pressure recorded in the borehole at downhole conditions during a pressure buildup test.

data.Name: burst pressure
data.Description: Burst Pressure.

data.Name: capillary pressure
data.Description: The difference in pressure between two phases, air fluid, gas fluid or between two fluids, measured at points of the interconnected phases.

data.Name: cement unit discharge pressure
data.Description: Cementing unit maximum discharge pressure

data.Name: circulating line pressure
data.Description: Pressure observed at circulating line/BOP

data.Name: circulating pressure
data.Description: Fluid pressure under circulating conditions.

data.Name: collapse pressure
data.Description: Collapse Pressure.

data.Name: compression pressure
data.Description: The pressure applied to compress a body or material, as opposed to that applied by tension.

data.Name: critical pressure
data.Description: The pressure needed to condense a vapor at its critical temperature. Applies to pure components; for mixtures use Pseudocritical_Pressure.

data.Name: dry gas critical pressure
data.Description: The pressure needed to condense a dry gas at its critical temperature (Dry gas = free gas without condensate)

data.Name: pseudocritical pressure
data.Description: The pressure needed to condense the vapor of a gas mixture at its pseudocritical temperature. Analogous to Critical_Pressure for pure components.

data.Name: wet gas critical pressure
data.Description: The pressure needed to condense a wet gas at its critical temperature (Wet gas : mixture of free gas plus condensate)

data.Name: dew point pressure
data.Description: The pressure at which a liquid phase condenses from a vaporous fluid in equilibrium at a given temperature.

data.Name: differential pressure
data.Description: The difference between the pressures of two systems, or between the pressures measured at different points in a system.

data.Name: gas differential pressure
data.Description: Gas differential pressure across the orifice plate when a sample is taken

data.Name: max differential pressure
data.Description: Maximum Differential Pressure

data.Name: dimensionless changing storage pressure
data.Description: Dimensionless changing wellbore storage pressure ("CphiD")

data.Name: downhole mud pressure
data.Description: The pressure inside a downhole MWD/LWD tool

data.Name: downstream coil pressure
data.Description: Coil working pressure downstream of the choke box

data.Name: downstream orifice gas pressure
data.Description: Pressure of gas separator gas line downstream of orifice plate when a sample is taken

data.Name: elastic limit
data.Description: The greatest stress that can be applied to a body without causing permanent deformation.

data.Name: elastic modulus
data.Description: The stress-strain properties of isotropic materials which obeys Hooke's law, for small formations, are specified by elastic moduli.

data.Name: bulk modulus
data.Description: The stress-strain ratio under simple hydrostatic pressure. k = Delta-P / (Delta V / V), where Delta-P, -V denote the change in Pressure and Volume.

data.Name: frame bulk modulus
data.Description: The bulk modulus of the solid frame of the rock. The solid frame of the rock includes the porosity but not the content of the pore spaces.

data.Name: shear modulus
data.Description: The stress-strain ratio for simple shear. Also called rigidity modulus or Lame's constant.

data.Name: frame shear modulus
data.Description: The shear modulus of the solid frame of the rock. The solid frame of the rock includes the porosity but not the content of the pore spaces.

data.Name: young modulus
data.Description: The stress-strain ratio when a body is pulled or compressed.

data.Name: engine oil pressure
data.Description: Pressure of the lubrication oil

data.Name: equipment test pressure
data.Description: Recommended pressure the equipment is tested when inspected or certified

data.Name: external boundary pressure
data.Description: The pressure existing at the external boundary of the drainage area of the well.

data.Name: extrapolated pressure
data.Description: Extrapolated pressure from infinite-acting analysis

data.Name: extrapolated pressure sph
data.Description: Extrapolated pressure from spherical flow analysis

data.Name: fann test pressure
data.Description: The pressure at which the Fann test was performed.

data.Name: final transfer pressure
data.Description: Final pressure of shipping bottle

data.Name: flowing pressure
data.Description: The pressure of the flowing well measured at the intake point in the borehole.

data.Name: fracture closure pressure
data.Description: Magnitude of the stress required to open a preexisting fracture. Assumed to be equal to the least principal stress which acts perpendicular to the face of the fracture, trying to keep it closed. Above it, the fracture is open, closed below.

data.Name: fracture pressure
data.Description: Fluid pressure in the wellbore required to undergo hydraulic fracturing.

data.Name: gauge pressure
data.Description: Pressure above one atmosphere.

data.Name: hydraulic drive pressure
data.Description: Pressure of the hydraulic fluid delivered to an Hydraulic motor

data.Name: hydrostatic pressure
data.Description: Pressure due to the weight of a column of liquid (formation water, drilling mud, etc.) extending from the depth of interest to the liquid level.

data.Name: liquid head pressure
data.Description: Pressure, represented as the height of a column of dense fluid that can be supported by the pressure.

data.Name: initial reservoir pressure
data.Description: Initial reservoir pressure, before any production or injection occurs, normally abbreviated Pi; sometimes taken as the pressure at the external boundary of the drainage area.

data.Name: inlet pressure
data.Description: Pressure at the inlet of an equipment item.

data.Name: kick pressure
data.Description: Pressure measurement used for kick detection.

data.Name: kill line pressure
data.Description: Pressure observed at kill line/BOP.

data.Name: last static reservoir pressure
data.Description: Last reservoir pressure recorded

data.Name: litho pressure
data.Description: The pressure produced by the weight of overlying rock. Also called Abnormal pressure.

data.Name: max allowable pressure
data.Description: Maximum allowable pressure for the equipment

data.Name: max allowable surface pressure
data.Description: Maximum allowable mud surface pressure in annulus (drill-pipe x casing) to be used during well control operations so as not to exceed the FIT/LOT equivalent mud weight.

data.Name: max gooseneck pressure
data.Description: Maximum pressure observed during a Coil Tubing job at the goose neck

data.Name: max operating pressure
data.Description: Maximum pressure which an equipment can withstand without permanent damage at standard temperature.

data.Name: max outer vessel pressure
data.Description: Maximum working pressure of the outer equipment

data.Name: max pressure
data.Description: Maximum pressure

data.Name: max surge pressure
data.Description: Maximum pressure to which this Equipment can be exposed for a short time without permanent damage; the Equipment will again perform to specifications when the pressure is reduced below the maximum working pressure.

data.Name: max water pressure
data.Description: Maximum water pressure

data.Name: mud pump discharge pressure
data.Description: Mud pump maximum discharge pressure

data.Name: net fracturing pressure
data.Description: Hydraulic pressure exerted on a formation during a fracturing job (fracture pressure) minus Closure Pressure.

data.Name: one hour pressure
data.Description: Pressure measured 1 hour after start of test.

data.Name: output pressure
data.Description: Pressure at the output of an equipment item.

data.Name: overbalance pressure
data.Description: The difference between formation pressure and the pressure of the fluid in the borehole.

data.Name: overburden pressure
data.Description: The pressure exerted on the matrix of a porous media by the weight of overlying strata.

data.Name: pad pressure
data.Description: The pressure with which the pad of a logging or testing device is applied to the formation or other interface.

data.Name: pore pressure
data.Description: The pressure of the fluid contained in the pore volume.

data.Name: pressure digit
data.Description: Element of a representation for pressure data in which each digit in the decimal pressure (1's, 10's, 100's, etc. )is stored as a separate unitless digit. This method is obsolete, but the property is needed for mapping historical data.

data.Name: pressure loss
data.Description: The difference between input and output pressure, usually due to friction.

data.Name: nom pressure loss
data.Description: The nominal pressure loss in a piece of equipment, such as a Drill_Motor or an MWD_Tool.

data.Name: pressure sensor drift
data.Description: Pressure difference over time in the gauge output with constant input conditions

data.Name: pressure sensor resolution
data.Description: The minimum significant pressure change that can be detected above the noise. This is measured as the standard deviation of the differences between two successive measurements.

data.Name: reel inlet pressure
data.Description: Pressure at the inlet of a coiled tubing reel.

data.Name: reference pressure
data.Description: Reference Pressure, as for a PVT computation

data.Name: sandface flowing pressure
data.Description: The pressure in the formation immediately prior to entering any completion pressure drops.

data.Name: separator pressure
data.Description: Pressure of the separator when a sample is taken

data.Name: standard pressure
data.Description: Pressure considered to be "standard", for rates and volumes reported to be measured at Standard Conditions.

data.Name: standpipe pressure
data.Description: Mud pressure at the stand pipe manifold, just before the flexhose connecting to the swivel.

data.Name: static potential
data.Description: Static (built up) pressure of a hydraulic unit, converted to pressure potential at a reference datum depth.

data.Name: static pressure
data.Description: Static (non-flowing) Pressure

data.Name: strength
data.Description: A measure of the ability of a body to resist applied force.

data.Name: compressive strength
data.Description: The degree of resistance of a material to force acting along one of the axes in a manner tending to crush it.

data.Name: formation compressive strength
data.Description: The compressive strength of an earth formation.

data.Name: fracture toughness
data.Description: Measure of the rock resistance to crack propagation (Hydraulic Fracturing). Must not be confused with tensile strength. Obtained by compressing a slice of core with a central hole. Expressed as Pressure times square root of length.

data.Name: fundamental strength
data.Description: The stress a material is able to withstand under a given set of conditions (temperature, pressure, solution, etc.) without deforming continuously.

data.Name: rock embedment strength
data.Description: Force required to push a 1/8 inch diameter sphere 1/16 in into the rock. (Lab test). Value ranges from 5 to 20 kpsi for chalk, 40 to 100 kpsi for sandstones, 50 to 200 for Dolomites.

data.Name: tensile strength
data.Description: The maximum tensile stress a material can tolerate without splitting

data.Name: test pressure
data.Description: Recommended pressure at which the equipment is tested when inspected or certified

data.Name: transient final pressure
data.Description: Pressure at Transient End Time (pend)

data.Name: transient initial pressure
data.Description: Pressure at start of Transient

data.Name: upstream coil pressure
data.Description: Coil working pressure upstream of the choke box

data.Name: vertical lift pressure
data.Description: Computed pressure at some depth in tubing

data.Name: wellhead flowing pressure
data.Description: Pressure at the Wellhead with well flowing

data.Name: wellhead pressure
data.Description: The producing or shutin pressure at the top of the well before any surface pressure drops.

data.Name: wellhead shutin pressure
data.Description: Static wellhead pressure during test

data.Name: working pressure
data.Description: Pressure at which an equipment item normally operates

data.Name: choke working pressure
data.Description: Working pressure of the choke box which allow for the well fluid flow to be controlled by varying the flow cross-sectional area

data.Name: max working pressure
data.Description: Recommended maximum pressure at which equipment can be used

data.Name: yield strength
data.Description: Unit stress which will produce a small amount of deformation generally equal to a strain of 0.2%. This value is a little greater than the Elastic limit. It is often supplied by the manufacturer of the material.

data.Name: pressure per flowrate
data.Description: Pressure Per Flowrate

data.Name: pressure per liquid flowrate
data.Description: Pressure per flowrate for liquids

data.Name: pressure per flowrate squared
data.Description: Pressure per flowrate per flowrate

data.Name: pressure rate
data.Description: A measure of the rate at which pressure varies per time; e.g., slider pressure correction.

data.Name: pressure squared
data.Description: Pressure squared

data.Name: pressure time per volume
data.Description: Pressure time per volume

data.Name: priority
data.Description: Superiority in rank, position, or privilege

data.Name: probability
data.Description: The likelihood that a given event will occur, expressed as the ratio of the number of occurrences of the specified event to the total number of events.

data.Name: fracture plausibility
data.Description: Estimate of the likelihood that a given rock body is fractured.

data.Name: gas probability
data.Description: The probability that gas is present in the formation.

data.Name: occurrence probability
data.Description: The probability that an item (element, mineral, ..) occur within a particular environment under certain conditions.

data.Name: oil probability
data.Description: The probability that oil is present in the formation.

data.Name: productivity index
data.Description: Ratio of flow rate to pressure drop. For oil wells, PI is normally expressed in barrels per day per psi decline in bottomhole flowing pressure.

data.Name: gas productivity index
data.Description: Ratio of gas flow rate to pressure drop.

data.Name: liquid productivity index
data.Description: Ratio of liquid flow rate to pressure drop.

data.Name: reservoir liquid productivity index
data.Description: Ratio of reservoir fluid flow rate to pressure drop.

data.Name: proppant areal distribution
data.Description: Mass of proppant per fracture area (hydraulic fracturing)

data.Name: quality factor
data.Description: Factor which quantitatively characterizes the acoustic attenuation of a medium.

data.Name: radiance
data.Description: Radiance is the amount of electromagnetic radiation (radiant intensity) which falls on a specific projected area.

data.Name: radiant intensity
data.Description: Cumulative quantity of electromagnetic radiation emitted, reflected, transmitted or received, per unit solid angle

data.Name: radioactivity
data.Description: The measure of intensity of radiation from a material relative to a standard level of intensity.

data.Name: ratio
data.Description: The value of one item divided by the value of another item.

data.Name: acoustic impedance ratio
data.Description: Ratio of the acoustic impedance of two adjacent beds or intervals

data.Name: amplitude ratio
data.Description: Ratio of two amplitude values.

data.Name: area per area
data.Description: Area per area

data.Name: calibration ratio
data.Description: Ratio of measurement during logging to measurement at calibration

data.Name: capillary number
data.Description: The ratio of capillary to viscous forces on fluids in a porous media.

data.Name: carbon oxygen ratio
data.Description: Ratio of relative abundance of Carbon to that of Oxygen; important for hydrocarbon detection and saturation determination because it is independent of salinity.

data.Name: compressional shear velocity ratio
data.Description: Ratio of velocity of Compressional wave (Vp) to that of Shear wave (Vs).

data.Name: avg compressional shear velocity ratio
data.Description: Time average of compressional-shear velocity ratio from top to reflector.

data.Name: interval compressional shear velocity ratio
data.Description: Value of compressional-shear velocity ratio in interval

data.Name: conductivity contrast
data.Description: Conductivity ratio between geological objects

data.Name: conductive inclusion contrast
data.Description: Conductivity contrast between conductive inclusions and the surrounding rock

data.Name: inter bed contrast
data.Description: Conductivity ratio between adjacent beds

data.Name: resistive inclusion contrast
data.Description: Conductivity contrast between resistive inclusions and the surrounding rock

data.Name: downtime ratio
data.Description: Non-operational time of an equipment with respect to total time in location

data.Name: dry weight fraction
data.Description: The ratio of the dry weight of a component of a system to the total dry weight of the system.

data.Name: albite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of albite to total dry weight

data.Name: aluminum dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of aluminum to total dry weight

data.Name: anhydrite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of anhydrite to total dry weight

data.Name: ankerite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of ankerite to total dry weight

data.Name: anorthite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of anorthite to total dry weight

data.Name: barium dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of barium to total dry weight

data.Name: calcite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of calcite to total dry weight

data.Name: calcium dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of calcium to total dry weight

data.Name: carbon dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of carbon to total dry weight

data.Name: chlorine dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of chlorine to total dry weight

data.Name: chlorite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of chlorite to total dry weight

data.Name: chromium dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of chromium to total dry weight

data.Name: clay dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of clay to total dry weight

data.Name: coal dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of coal to total dry weight

data.Name: cobalt dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of cobalt to total dry weight

data.Name: copper dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of copper to total dry weight

data.Name: dolomite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of dolomite to total dry weight

data.Name: evaporite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of evaporite to total dry weight

data.Name: gadolinium dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of gadolinium to total dry weight

data.Name: hydrogen dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of hydrogen to total dry weight

data.Name: illite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of illite to total dry weight

data.Name: iron dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of iron to total dry weight

data.Name: kaolinite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of kaolinite to total dry weight

data.Name: lead dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of lead to total dry weight

data.Name: magnesium dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of magnesium to total dry weight

data.Name: manganese dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of manganese to total dry weight

data.Name: molybdenum dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of molybdenum to total dry weight

data.Name: montmorillonite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of montmorillonite to total dry weight

data.Name: nahcolite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of nahcolite to total dry weight

data.Name: nickel dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of nickel to total dry weight

data.Name: nitrogen dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of nitrogen to total dry weight

data.Name: orthoclase dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of orthoclase to total dry weight

data.Name: phosphorus dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of phosphorus to total dry weight

data.Name: potassium dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of potassium to total dry weight

data.Name: pyrite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of pyrite to total dry weight

data.Name: qfm dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of quartz + feldspar + mica to total dry weight.

data.Name: quartz dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of quartz to total dry weight

data.Name: rhodochrosite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of rhodochrosite to total dry weight

data.Name: siderite dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of siderite to total dry weight

data.Name: silicon dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of silicon to total dry weight

data.Name: sodium dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of sodium to total dry weight

data.Name: sulfur dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of sulfur to total dry weight

data.Name: thorium dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of thorium to total dry weight

data.Name: titanium dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of titanium to total dry weight

data.Name: uranium dry weight fraction
data.Description: Ratio of dry weight of uranium to total dry weight

data.Name: effective length thickness ratio
data.Description: A measure of the tendency of a permeable stratum to exhibit vertical equilibrium of flowing fluids, defined as: (length / height) * SQRT(kv/kh), where length is the characteristic length of the flow path and height is the gross or net height.

data.Name: efficiency
data.Description: The ratio of the useful energy delivered by a dynamic system to the energy supplied to it.

data.Name: hgs removal efficiency
data.Description: Ratio of mass rate of HGS (high Gravity Solid) discarded through the underflow of a piece of SCE (Solids Control Equipment) to the mass rate of HGS fed into it

data.Name: lgs removal efficiency
data.Description: Ratio of the mass rate of LGS (low gravity solid) in the underflow of a piece of SCE (Solids Control Equipment) to the mass rate of LGS fed into it

data.Name: energy half z
data.Description: Characterization of relative distribution of energy in a layer, computed as the fractional displacement (depth or time) into an interval (layer, bed) where half of the energy is above, half below.

data.Name: energy half depth
data.Description: Depth, within a specified interval, at which half the energy of the interval occurs

data.Name: eou cone growth ratio
data.Description: Ratio of the ellipse of uncertainty cone radius increase per depth increment

data.Name: epithermal neutron near far ratio
data.Description: Ratio of the count rate of the near detector to that of the far detector in an epithermal neutron logging device

data.Name: equilibration ratio
data.Description: The equilibrium vaporization ratio, or ratio of the mole fraction of a fluid system component in the vapor phase divided by the mole fraction of the same component in the liquid phase.

data.Name: fault transmissibility
data.Description: Ratio of fault transmissibility to formation transmissibility.

data.Name: fluid permeability factor
data.Description: Fraction of the fracture permeability retained at in-situ conditions after taking into account the damage due to fluid residue, function of the breaker, gel concentration and temperature at closure. Has the same effect as Proppant_Permeability_Factor.

data.Name: force per force
data.Description: Ratio of two forces

data.Name: formation resistivity factor
data.Description: Ratio of the resistivity of water-saturated rock to that of the water solution contained in the rock. Also called Formation Resistivity Factor and abbreviated "F".

data.Name: fraction above depth point
data.Description: Unitless fraction of an image that is displayed above the depth associated with the image.

data.Name: fracture normal weakness
data.Description: The ratio of normal compliance of the fracture to the total normal compliance of the fractured rock. It indicates how much of the total compliance of the fractured rock is due to the fractures. See Compliance.

data.Name: fracture shear weakness
data.Description: The ratio of shear compliance of the fracture to the total shear compliance of the fractured rock. It indicates how much of the total compliance of the fractured rock is due to the fractures. See Compliance.

data.Name: friction coefficient
data.Description: Ratio of the frictional (tangential) force to the contact (normal) force between two objects or materials in contact.

data.Name: casing rotation friction coefficient
data.Description: Friction coefficient due to rotation between casing and other surface (e.g. drill string).

data.Name: casing sliding friction coefficient
data.Description: Friction coefficient due to sliding between casing and other surface (e.g. drill string), when only sliding motion is present

data.Name: casing translation friction coefficient
data.Description: Linear component of the friction coefficient between casing and drill string during an helical movement, e.g., reaming mode

data.Name: coulomb friction coefficient
data.Description: Ratio of contact and friction forces between 2 materials in dry friction conditions i.e. without lubrication (Coulomb law)

data.Name: pickup friction coefficient
data.Description: Friction coefficient between a string and the borehole when pulling out of the hole

data.Name: slackoff friction coefficient
data.Description: Friction coefficient between a string and the pipe when running into the hole

data.Name: hole rotation friction coefficient
data.Description: Friction coefficient between open hole and drill string in rotation

data.Name: hole sliding friction coefficient
data.Description: Friction coefficient between open hole and drill string in sliding (translation only) operating mode

data.Name: hole translation friction coefficient
data.Description: Vertical component of the Friction coefficient between open hole and drill string during an helical movement, e.g., reaming mode

data.Name: gas sorption storativity ratio
data.Description: Ratio of the stored gas in the kerogen (solid hydrocarbon) to the total gas stored in the system

data.Name: initial final wellbore storage ratio
data.Description: Ratio of early-time (initial) to final wellbore storage factor ("Ca/C")

data.Name: isotope ratio
data.Description: The isotope ratio is a value that puts into relation a measured isotope quantity versus another isotope of the same component and compares it to a standard

data.Name: kerogen adsorption
data.Description: Describes the adsorption of hydrocarbon compounds on kerogen

data.Name: layer storativity ratio
data.Description: Ratio of layer storativity to total storativity ("omegaj")

data.Name: length per length
data.Description: Ratio of two lengths

data.Name: litho gross thickness ratio
data.Description: Ratio of Litho_Thickness to Gross_Thickness of a reservoir summation interval.

data.Name: map scale
data.Description: The ratio of a distance measured on a map to the actual distance. It is normally expressed as a unitless ratio (e.g. 1:1000), or as the product of a unitless ratio and the ratio of two units (e.g. 1 in = 5 mile, or .2 in/mi).

data.Name: mass fraction
data.Description: The ratio of the mass of a component to the total mass.

data.Name: memory usage
data.Description: Ratio of memory used to total memory.

data.Name: mobility ratio
data.Description: Ratio of the mobility of one system or layer (permeability divided by viscosity) to that of another system or layer.

data.Name: net gross thickness ratio
data.Description: Ratio of Net_Thickness to Gross_Thickness

data.Name: net pay gross thickness ratio
data.Description: Ratio of Net_Pay_Thickness to Gross_Thickness

data.Name: net reservoir gross thickness ratio
data.Description: Ratio of Net_Reservoir_Thickness to Gross_Thickness

data.Name: noise to signal ratio
data.Description: The ratio of noise amplitude to signal amplitude, usually expressed in dB. Note: the inverse, Signal_To_Noise_Ratio, is preferred and should be used whenever possible.

data.Name: open fraction
data.Description: Fraction to which the equipment is open, e.g., 50% open

data.Name: peak peak amplitude ratio
data.Description: Ratio of amplitudes of two peaks.

data.Name: peak trough amplitude ratio
data.Description: Ratio of amplitudes of peak and trough.

data.Name: permeability thickness ratio
data.Description: Ratio of component permeability-thickness to total system permeability-thickness [kh(i) / kh(total)], usually known as Kappa in reservoir dynamics work.

data.Name: poisson ratio
data.Description: Ratio of the transverse contraction of a body to its longitudinal extension when stretched. Typical values in minerals are from 0.15 to 0.3 (Carbonates:0.15, Sandstones:0.2, Shales:0.25).

data.Name: polarity ratio
data.Description: Ratio of number of positive samples to total number of samples. Equivalent to Threshold_Ratio where threshold is zero.

data.Name: porosity length ratio
data.Description: The ratio of the sum of layer porosity thicknesses to total system porosity thicknesses for a layered porous media.

data.Name: productivity ratio
data.Description: Productivity ratio (actual productivity index divided by ideal (zero skin) productivity index)

data.Name: proportion
data.Description: The ratio of one part of an amount to the whole, with respect to quantity or magnitude.

data.Name: agreement interest
data.Description: Percentage of interest held by one of the potentially many organizations holding a lease agreement.

data.Name: conductive bed proportion
data.Description: Percentage of rock occupied by conductive beds within a given depth interval

data.Name: inclusion proportion
data.Description: Percentage of rocks occupied by inclusions within a given depth interval

data.Name: conductive inclusion proportion
data.Description: Percentage of rock occupied by conductive inclusions within a given depth interval

data.Name: resistive inclusion proportion
data.Description: Percentage of rock occupied by resistive inclusions within a given depth interval

data.Name: ownership amount
data.Description: Lessor percentage ownership

data.Name: proppant permeability factor
data.Description: Fraction of proppant permeability retained in the in-situ fracture condition, and due to mechanical damage excluding any damage due to fluid residue. Has the same effect than Fluid_Permeability_Factor.

data.Name: q ratio
data.Description: Quality factor for compressional waves. The ratio of 2*pi times the peak compressional wave energy to the energy dissipated in a cycle.

data.Name: avg q ratio
data.Description: Average (harmonic mean) value of the compressional wave quality factor.

data.Name: interval q ratio
data.Description: Interval value of the compressional wave quality factor.

data.Name: qs ratio
data.Description: Quality factor for shear waves. The ratio of 2*pi times the peak shear wave energy to the energy dissipated in a cycle.

data.Name: avg qs ratio
data.Description: Average (harmonic mean) value of the shear wave quality factor.

data.Name: interval qs ratio
data.Description: Interval value of the shear wave quality factor.

data.Name: recovery ratio
data.Description: Ratio of amount of sample or material recovered to total amount recoverable.

data.Name: reduced temperature
data.Description: The temperature of a fluid divided by the critical temperature of the fluid.

data.Name: reflection coefficient
data.Description: Ratio of the displacement amplitude of a reflected wave to that of the incident wave. Also called Reflectivity.

data.Name: elastic impedance reflectivity
data.Description: Reflectivity due to changes in elastic impedance

data.Name: compressional impedance reflectivity
data.Description: Reflectivity due to changes in compressional impedance

data.Name: shear impedance reflectivity
data.Description: Reflectivity due to changes in shear impedance

data.Name: lambda rho reflectivity
data.Description: Reflectivity computer from lambda rho

data.Name: mu rho reflectivity
data.Description: Reflectivity computed from mu rho

data.Name: reflection coefficient threshold
data.Description: Minimum reflection coefficient when processing the multiple reflections

data.Name: surface reflection coefficient
data.Description: Reflection coefficient for the case when the multiples are reflecting from the free surface

data.Name: relative time
data.Description: Ratio of two times

data.Name: relaxation time ratio
data.Description: In nuclear magnetic resonance logging, the ratio of longitudinal to transverse relaxation time; used to determine polarization correction.

data.Name: resistivity index
data.Description: The ratio of the resistivity of a formation to the resistivity it would have if 100% saturated with formation water (Rt/Ro).

data.Name: reynolds number
data.Description: The ratio of inertial force to viscous force for viscous fluid flow.

data.Name: rock eval
data.Description: Ratio of generated rock eval components per rock mass or organic content of a sample used to characterize source rocks

data.Name: sediment and water
data.Description: Measure of impurities which are contained in oil produced from a well, as described in ASTM Standard Test D96-82. Traditionally called Basic Sediment and Water.

data.Name: shear compressional slowness ratio
data.Description: Ratio of shear slowness (Shear_Slowness) to compressional slowness (Compressional_Slowness).

data.Name: shear compressional velocity ratio
data.Description: Ratio of velocity of Shear wave (Vs) to that of Compressional wave (Vp).

data.Name: avg shear compressional velocity ratio
data.Description: Time average of shear-compressional velocity ratio from top to reflector.

data.Name: interval shear compressional velocity ratio
data.Description: Value of shear-compressional velocity ratio in interval

data.Name: signal to noise ratio
data.Description: The ratio of signal amplitude to noise amplitude, usually expressed in dB.

data.Name: storativity ratio
data.Description: Ratio of component storativity to total system storativity. Usually known as Omega in reservoir dynamics.

data.Name: fissure storativity ratio
data.Description: Ratio of fissure storativity to total system storativity. Usually known as Omega in reservoir dynamics.

data.Name: inner outer storativity ratio
data.Description: Radially composite system storativity ratio [inner/outer bank]

data.Name: storativity thickness ratio
data.Description: Ratio of component storativity-thickness to total system storativity-thickness [phi*Ct*h(i) / phi*Ct*h(total)].

data.Name: thermal neutron near far ratio
data.Description: Ratio of the count rate of the near detector to that of the far detector in a thermal neutron logging device

data.Name: thorium potassium ratio
data.Description: Ratio of concentration of Thorium to that of Potassium.

data.Name: thorium uranium ratio
data.Description: Ratio of concentration of Thorium to that of Uranium.

data.Name: threshold ratio
data.Description: Relative measure of trace value attribute; ratio of number of samples with values greater than threshold to total number of samples.

data.Name: transmission coefficient
data.Description: Ratio of the amplitude of a transmitted wave to that of the incident wave; may be greater than 1.

data.Name: trough peak amplitude ratio
data.Description: Ratio of amplitudes of peak and trough.

data.Name: trough trough amplitude ratio
data.Description: Ratio of amplitudes of two troughs.

data.Name: uranium potassium ratio
data.Description: Ratio of concentration of Uranium to that of Potassium.

data.Name: velocity ellipticity flattening
data.Description: Degree of velocity elliptical anisotropy, in the range 0 (isotropic) to 1, defined as the ratio of the difference between the major and minor axes to the major axis of the velocity ellipse.

data.Name: interval velocity ellipticity flattening
data.Description: Estimation of the velocity ellipticity flattening for a layer.

data.Name: stack velocity ellipticity flattening
data.Description: Estimation of the velocity ellipticity flattening for all layers to the current depth.

data.Name: vert hor ratio
data.Description: The ratio of some property measured vertically to that of the same property measured horizontally; several such property types are used to characterize formation anisotropy.

data.Name: vert hor permeability ratio
data.Description: The ratio of vertical to horizontal permeability in a permeable medium.

data.Name: flow capacity
data.Description: The characteristic of a layer in a permeable system that describes the fraction of greater permeability-thicknesses for a layer with respect to the system permeability-thickness.

data.Name: sample gas oil ratio
data.Description: Ratio of gas flowrate to oil flowrate when a sample is taken

data.Name: holdup index
data.Description: Unitless quantity proportional to holdup within a given borehole environment. Holdup indices are comparable only when the borehole and casing sizes are the same.

data.Name: api neutron
data.Description: The Neutron calibration measurement determined using the API test pit. This quantity is associated with the natural formation hydrogen concentration.

data.Name: storage capacity
data.Description: The ratio of the sum of layer porosity thicknesses to total system porosity thicknesses for layered porous media.

data.Name: reciprocal area
data.Description: was per area

data.Name: reciprocal electric potential difference
data.Description: was per electric potential

data.Name: reciprocal force
data.Description: was per force

data.Name: reciprocal length
data.Description: was per length

data.Name: reciprocal mass
data.Description: was per mass

data.Name: reciprocal time
data.Description: was operations per time

data.Name: reciprocal volume
data.Description: was per volume

data.Name: recorder scanning rate
data.Description: Scanning rate at which gauge records data

data.Name: reflection intensity
data.Description: Rate of flow of wave energy through a unit area perpendicular to the direction of wave travel; for a seismic wave, intensity is proportional to the square of the amplitude of displacement or velocity.

data.Name: relative reflection intensity
data.Description: Measure of energy reflected from a surface relative to the energy reflected under specific, standard conditions.

data.Name: refractive index
data.Description: The ratio of the velocity of light in a vacuum to that in the medium in question.

data.Name: regularization factor
data.Description: Factor used in T2 inversion (nuclear magnetic resonance logging) to ensure the continuity of the T2 distribution as a function of the signal to noise ratio.

data.Name: reluctance
data.Description: The resistance of a medium to a magnetic field; the magnetic equivalent of electric impedance

data.Name: remaining life
data.Description: Remaining relative life predicted by the CoilLIFE model expressed as a percentage

data.Name: remarks
data.Description: Any type of remarks added to an entity instance.

data.Name: resistivity
data.Description: The property of a material which resists the flow of electrical current. The ratio of electric-field intensity to current density. The reciprocal of conductivity.

data.Name: array resistivity
data.Description: Formation resistivity as measured by a device capable of taking measurements of at various combinations of resolution, depth of investigation and/or in different azimuthal directions.

data.Name: array induction resistivity
data.Description: Array Resistivity measurement using induction logging principles.

data.Name: array laterolog resistivity
data.Description: Array Resistivity measurement using laterolog (or guard log) resistivity logging principles.

data.Name: bound water resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity of water bound to clay in the formations.

data.Name: clay resistivity
data.Description: The Resistivity of clay, usually referring to that measured in the Earth formations.

data.Name: deep resistivity
data.Description: The resistivity which represents a measurement made several feet into the formation; generally considered a measurement of the undisturbed formation.

data.Name: deep induction resistivity
data.Description: The resistivity, measured by an induction log, which represents a measurement made several feet into the formation; generally considered a measurement of the undisturbed formation.

data.Name: deep lateral resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity measurement using a "lateral" electrode arrangement with a "deep" investigation radius (several feet into the formation).

data.Name: deep laterolog resistivity
data.Description: The resistivity, measured by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, which represents a measurement made several feet into the formation; generally considered a measurement of the undisturbed formation.

data.Name: dielectric resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity measurement which has been compensated for the dielectric constant of the formation..

data.Name: electromagnetic propagation resistivity
data.Description: Formation resistivity as measured by the attenuation or phase shift of a high frequency electromagnetic wave; the frequency range for these measurements is higher than that of induction measurements, typically hundreds of KHz to several MHz, and over 1 GHz in the case of the Schlumberger EPT tool.

data.Name: attenuation resistivity
data.Description: Formation resistivity as measured by the attenuation of a high frequency (hundreds of KHz to several MHz) electromagnetic wave; these measurements are typically deeper than measurements based on phase shift, but their vertical resolution is less sharp and they often cannot be used reliably in high-resistivity formations.

data.Name: phase shift resistivity
data.Description: Formation resistivity as measured by the phase shift of a high frequency electromagnetic wave (hundreds of KHz to several MHz, 1.1 GHz in the case of Schlumberger's EPT tool); these measurements are typically sharp (good vertical resolution) and have good dynamic range, but their depth of investigation is less than that of measurements based on attenuation.

data.Name: filter cake resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity of Mud Filter Cake

data.Name: fluid resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity of a fluid.

data.Name: flushed zone resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity of the formation flushed zone (that portion of the formation in which the movable fluids are considered to have been completely replaced by mud filtrate during drilling).

data.Name: formation resistivity
data.Description: True Formation Resistivity

data.Name: horizontal formation resistivity
data.Description: Formation resistivity measured parallel to layering. (for "Transverse-Isotropic (TI)" rock"

data.Name: vertical formation resistivity
data.Description: Formation resistivity measured perpendicular to layering. (for "Transverse-Isotropic (TI)" rock

data.Name: formation resistivity sw100
data.Description: Resistivity of formation, assuming 100% water-saturated.

data.Name: invasion annulus resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity of the invasion annulus, a region of the formation lying between the flushed zone and the undisturbed formation, and filled with interstitial water displaced from the flushed zone.)

data.Name: medium resistivity
data.Description: The resistivity which represents a measurement made approximately two to three feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contain fluids which are a mixture of mud filtrate, connate water and possibly hydrocarbons.

data.Name: medium induction resistivity
data.Description: The resistivity, made by an induction log, which represents a measurement made approximately two to three feet into the formation.

data.Name: medium lateral resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity measurement using a "lateral" electrode arrangement with a "medium" investigation radius (~a foot or two into the formation).

data.Name: medium laterolog resistivity
data.Description: The resistivity, measured by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, which represents a measurement made approximately two to three feet into the formation.

data.Name: micro resistivity
data.Description: A measurement of the resistivity of the formation within the first few inches of the borehole wall.

data.Name: micro cylindrically focused resistivity
data.Description: A measurement of the resistivity of the formation, by a cylindrically focused tool, within the first few inches of the borehole wall.

data.Name: micro inverse resistivity
data.Description: Micro Resistivity measurement using an "inverse" lateral electrode arrangement; traditionally combined with Micro Normal Resistivity in a Microlog survey for identifying permeable beds.

data.Name: micro lateral resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity measurement using a "lateral" electrode arrangement with a very shallow investigation radius (1-2 inches into the formation).

data.Name: micro laterolog resistivity
data.Description: A measurement of the resistivity of the formation, by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, within the first few inches of the borehole wall.

data.Name: micro normal resistivity
data.Description: Micro Resistivity measurement using a "normal" electrode arrangement; traditionally combined with Micro Inverse Resistivity in a Microlog survey for identifying permeable beds.

data.Name: micro spherically focused resistivity
data.Description: A measurement of the resistivity of the formation, by a spherically focused tool, within the first few inches of the borehole wall.

data.Name: mineral resistivity
data.Description: Mineral Resistivity

data.Name: mud filtrate resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity of mud filtrate

data.Name: apparent mud filtrate resistivity
data.Description: Apparent resistivity of the mud filtrate, generally from log measurements of the "flushed zone".

data.Name: mud resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity of Drilling Fluid, also known as mud.

data.Name: bottomhole mud resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity of the mud at Bottomhole Conditions

data.Name: mud resistivity in
data.Description: The electrical resistivity of mud going into the hole, usually measured in the active circulating pit

data.Name: mud resistivity out
data.Description: The electrical resistivity of mud coming out of the hole, usually measured in the ditch before the shale shakers

data.Name: profile resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity profile measurement, used primarily for pattern recognition; may or may not be calibrated.

data.Name: relative apparent resistivity
data.Description: The ratio of apparent resistivity to the true resistivity of a portion of a reservoir model (like a two-layer model).

data.Name: shallow resistivity
data.Description: The resistivity which represents a measurement made approximately one to two feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contains fluids which are comprised primarily of mud filtrate.

data.Name: shallow induction resistivity
data.Description: The resistivity, measured by an induction log, which represents a measurement made approximately one to two feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contains fluids which are comprised primarily of mud filtrate.

data.Name: shallow lateral resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity measurement using a "lateral" electrode arrangement with a "shallow" investigation radius (several inches into the formation).

data.Name: shallow laterolog resistivity
data.Description: The resistivity, measured by a laterolog (or guard log) resistivity device, which represents a measurement made approximately one to two feet into the formation; generally considered to measure the formation where it contains fluids which are comprised primarily of mud filtrate.

data.Name: shallow normal resistivity
data.Description: Shallow Resistivity measurement using a "normal" electrode arrangement.

data.Name: spherically focused resistivity
data.Description: The resistivity, measured by a spherically focused log, which represents the resistivity approximately one to two feet into the formation.

data.Name: water resistivity
data.Description: Resistivity of connate (formation) water

data.Name: apparent water resistivity
data.Description: Apparent resistivity of connate (formation) water, generally from logs; such estimates require correction before they can be used quantitatively.

data.Name: resistivity k factor
data.Description: K Factor, a function of the geometry of the electrode or sensor array of a resistivity measurement device.

data.Name: response equation
data.Description: Sensor response equation

data.Name: safety factor
data.Description: Amount by which some operating condition could be exceeded before reaching the theoretical operational limit, to allow for uncertainty in the actual upper limit. For upper limits, Operating Condition X (1 + Safety Factor) = Upper Limit.

data.Name: fracture pressure safety factor
data.Description: Amount by which borehole pressure should remain below fracture pressure, to allow for uncertainty in fracture pressure estimation.

data.Name: pore pressure safety factor
data.Description: Amount by which borehole pressure should normally exceed pore pressure, to allow for uncertainty in pore pressure estimation.

data.Name: volume safety factor
data.Description: Volume in excess of what has been calculated for the job. Used to account for loss or safety margin

data.Name: weight safety factor
data.Description: Weight in excess of what has been calculated for the job. Used to account for loss or safety margin

data.Name: sample interval
data.Description: Index interval between sequential data samples; see also Depth_Increment and Time_Increment (Sampling_Period)

data.Name: saturation
data.Description: The fraction or percentage of the pore volume occupied by a specific fluid; e.g., oil, gas, water.

data.Name: bound water saturation
data.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a formation contains bound water.

data.Name: flushed zone bound water saturation
data.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a flushed zone around the borehole contains bound water.

data.Name: critical saturation
data.Description: The value of saturation of a specific fluid phase at which the fluid will first begin to flow as saturation is increased.

data.Name: critical gas saturation
data.Description: The value of gas saturation at which gas will begin to flow, as gas saturation is increased.

data.Name: critical oil saturation
data.Description: The value of oil saturation at which oil will begin to flow, as oil saturation is increased.

data.Name: critical water saturation
data.Description: The highest water saturation a hydrocarbon-producing rock can maintain before water will begin to flow.

data.Name: flushed zone fluid saturation
data.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a flushed zone around the borehole contains fluid.

data.Name: flushed zone hydrocarbon saturation
data.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a flushed zone around the borehole contains hydrocarbons.

data.Name: flushed zone obmf saturation
data.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a flushed zone around the borehole contains oil based mud filtrate.

data.Name: flushed zone water saturation
data.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a flushed zone around the borehole contains water.

data.Name: net pay flushed zone water saturation
data.Description: Average flushed zone water saturation in the net pay portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).
data.Code: net pay flushed zone water saturation

data.Name: net reservoir flushed zone water saturation
data.Description: Average flushed zone water saturation in the net reservoir portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).
data.Code: net reservoir flushed zone water saturation

data.Name: gas saturation
data.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a formation contains gas.

data.Name: gas saturation at breakthrough
data.Description: Gas saturation at the breakthrough point. In Special Core Analysis, breakthrough is the appearance of the injected fluid at the outlet face of the rock sample.

data.Name: gas saturation min so 3phase
data.Description: The gas saturation at minimum oil saturation in a three phase system. (SCAL SGM)

data.Name: initial gas saturation
data.Description: Gas Saturation at the beginning of the test, experiment or production.

data.Name: hydrocarbon saturation
data.Description: The fraction of pore volume filled with hydrocarbons.

data.Name: irreducible water saturation
data.Description: The fraction of the pore volume occupied by water in a reservoir at maximum hydrocarbon saturation, such that it cannot be further reduced.

data.Name: liquid saturation
data.Description: The fraction of the total pore volume in a formation or rock sample occupied by liquid.

data.Name: mercury saturation
data.Description: The fraction of the total pore volume in a rock sample occupied by mercury (special core analysis)

data.Name: oil saturation
data.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a formation contains oil.

data.Name: initial oil saturation
data.Description: Oil Saturation at the beginning of the test, experiment or production.

data.Name: min oil saturation 3phase
data.Description: Minimum oil saturation in a 3 phase system. (SCAL SORM)

data.Name: residual gas saturation
data.Description: The fraction or percentage of gas remaining following production from the reservoir.

data.Name: residual hydrocarbon saturation
data.Description: The fraction or percentage of hydrocarbons remaining following the production of hydrocarbons from the reservoir.

data.Name: residual oil saturation
data.Description: The fraction or percentage of oil remaining following the liberation of gases from the reservoir.

data.Name: residual water saturation
data.Description: The fraction or percentage of water remaining at maximum hydrocarbon saturation, as measured in core analysis. It differs from Irreducible_Water_Saturation because of filtrate invasion and gas expansion from the core being brought to the surface.

data.Name: water saturation
data.Description: The extent to which the pore space in a formation contains water.

data.Name: initial water saturation
data.Description: Water Saturation at the beginning of the test, experiment or production.

data.Name: max water saturation
data.Description: Maximum value of Water Saturation

data.Name: net pay water saturation
data.Description: Average water saturation in the net pay portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

data.Name: net reservoir core water saturation point match
data.Description: Average water saturation in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from core data by point-match method.
data.Code: net reservoir core water saturation point match

data.Name: net reservoir log water saturation point match
data.Description: Average water saturation in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from log data by point-match method.
data.Code: net reservoir log water saturation point match

data.Name: net reservoir water saturation
data.Description: Average water saturation in the net reservoir portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

data.Name: water saturation at breakthrough
data.Description: Water saturation at the breakthrough point. In Special Core Analysis, breakthrough is the appearance of the injected fluid at the outlet face of the rock sample.

data.Name: water saturation at breakthrough ff
data.Description: Water saturation at the breakthrough point, calculated from fractional flow curve (SCAL SwBkFF). In Special Core Analysis, breakthrough is the appearance of the injected fluid at the outlet face of the rock sample.

data.Name: water saturation min so 3phase
data.Description: The water saturation at minimum oil saturation in a three phase system. (SCAL SWM)

data.Name: second moment of area
data.Description: A geometrical property of an area which reflects how its points are distributed with regard to an arbitrary axis

data.Name: skin factor
data.Description: The term that accounts for additional pressure drops in the immediate vicinity of a well in well performance calculations. A positive skin indicates damaged conditions, negative indicates stimulated conditions.

data.Name: completion skin
data.Description: Skin effect due the completion of the producing interval. It does not include the effect of partially completed interval (plugged perf or bad localization), but it does include Gravel Pack skin.

data.Name: deviation skin
data.Description: The skin effect caused by the well trajectory not being perpendicular to the bedding plane.

data.Name: formation damage skin
data.Description: The skin effect caused by mechanical or chemical formation damage such as invasion of drilling fluids, migration of fine material, wettability change, scale deposit or bacteria. The annular volume damaged is called the Damaged Zone.

data.Name: fracture face skin
data.Description: The skin along the face of the fracture (natural or hydraulic).

data.Name: matrix block skin
data.Description: Matrix to natural fracture skin factor in a naturally fractured system.

data.Name: mechanical skin
data.Description: Sum of Completion_Skin, Formation_Damage_Skin including anything limiting the flow across the completed interval. Does not include Partial_Completion_Skin.

data.Name: non darcy skin
data.Description: The skin effect resulting from turbulent flow conditions within the reservoir or the completion. This is the only skin which is flowrate dependent.

data.Name: partial completion skin
data.Description: The skin effect caused by flow convergence due to not completing the entire flowing thickness. Does not include the skin due to the completion itself.

data.Name: total skin
data.Description: The sum of all formation, completion, deviation, geometric and fluid flow skin factors. It can be a function of the flowrate if a Non-Darcy skin effect is present.

data.Name: vertical geometric skin
data.Description: In a horizontal well, skin effect due to the limited entry in the vertical direction.

data.Name: slew rate
data.Description: Highest rate of change in signal level which a device can produce; also the rate at which a device reacts to commands. In the latter case, the data are normally represented in units of time.

data.Name: solid angle
data.Description: A measure of the field of view from some specific vantage point occupied by an object.

data.Name: solubility
data.Description: A measure of the amount of one substance (the solute) which will dissolve in a given amount of another (the solvent).

data.Name: gas water solubility
data.Description: Measure of the degree to which a gas is soluble in water, often designated Rs Water

data.Name: rock solubility in acid
data.Description: Amount of rock, normally expressed as a percentage by weight soluble in a given acid

data.Name: rock solubility in hcl
data.Description: Amount of rock, normally expressed as a percentage by weight soluble in HCl

data.Name: rock solubility in rma
data.Description: Amount of rock, normally expressed as a percentage by weight soluble in Mud Acid (standard mixture of 12 % HCl and 3% HF)

data.Name: source
data.Description: The source of an entity instance, usually a user name or an application (or activity) instance.

data.Name: dip detection source
data.Description: The source of information used to detect dips (e.g., Seismic data, Structural analysis, Dipmeter log data, etc.)

data.Name: fault detection source
data.Description: The source of the data used to detect faults (e.g., Seismic data, Structural analysis, Dipmeter log data, etc.)

data.Name: fluid sample origin
data.Description: General location from which a fluid sample was taken (test line, mud pit)

data.Name: interpretation origin
data.Description: Specify where interpretation was performed on data.

data.Name: magnetic declination source
data.Description: Name of a declination survey, a vendor of declination data, a reference book, or a person supplying the value.

data.Name: sparse 2d data
data.Description: A data set of sparse location data in 2-space, where none or up to n Properties may be represented at each location. Example: X_Coordinate,Y_Coordinate,Porosity,Density.

data.Name: sparse 3d data
data.Description: A data set of sparse location data in 3-space, where none or up to n Properties may be represented at each location. Example: X_Coordinate,Y_Coordinate,Z_Coordinate,Velocity.

data.Name: specific heat
data.Description: The amount of heat in calories required to raise the temperature of 1 gram of substance by 1 degree Celsius.

data.Name: specific heat capacity
data.Description: Heat capacity per unit of mass

data.Name: specific surface area
data.Description: The characteristic of a porous media which is the internal surface area of the medium per unit volume.

data.Name: specific surface area per mass
data.Description: The characteristic of a porous media which is the internal surface area of the medium per unit mass.

data.Name: specific surface area per volume
data.Description: The characteristic of a porous media which is the internal surface area of the medium per unit volume.

data.Name: specific volume
data.Description: A measure of the volume distribution of a gas or liquid per unit mass.

data.Name: gas volume per mass
data.Description: Gas volume required to make a unit mass; the reciprocal of density

data.Name: coal gas volume per mass
data.Description: Volume of gas production per mass in coal, for example the Langmuir volume constant.

data.Name: spectral fluorescence intensity
data.Description: Intensity of light emitted by a material represented as a function of emitted light wavelength and wavelength of the excitation beam, typically an ultraviolet light source.

data.Name: spring stiffness
data.Description: Coefficient relating spiral spring exerted force and corresponding elongation

data.Name: station residual static
data.Description: Residual static information (time) for each station

data.Name: statistical property
data.Description: A property of statistical nature, e.g. Standard Deviation, Average or Mean, Median, etc.

data.Name: accuracy
data.Description: The extent to which a measurement approaches the true value of a quantity; usually expressed as a fraction of the true value or, for instrumentation, full scale.

data.Name: pressure accuracy
data.Description: The maximum difference, over the calibrated range, between pressure applied to the gauge, with a reference standard, and the pressure measured by the gauge.

data.Name: temperature accuracy
data.Description: The maximum difference, over the calibrated range, between temperature applied to the gauge, with a reference standard, and the temperature measured by the gauge.

data.Name: transit time accuracy
data.Description: The accuracy attached to the transit time measurement or computation.

data.Name: chi square
data.Description: Statistical test of data distribution, used to measure goodness of fit of the data to some distribution model.

data.Name: covariance
data.Description: A measure of the common variance between two quantities; a non-normalized crosscorrelation function.

data.Name: error
data.Description: The deviation of a measurement from the true value; usually expressed as an absolute quantity rather than as a fraction; the unit quantity is determined by that of the data.

data.Name: azimuth error
data.Description: Plus or minus azimuth error of sensor

data.Name: feedback loop deviation
data.Description: Departure (error) from the exact setting of a feedback loop

data.Name: inclination error
data.Description: Plus or minus inclination error of sensor

data.Name: nmr fitting error
data.Description: Error in NMR window sum or raw echo fitting.

data.Name: sonde error
data.Description: An unwanted portion of the total conductivity measurement of an induction logging instrument, generated by imperfections in the coils in the sonde. It is measured during surface calibration and then cancelled during the survey operation.

data.Name: error band
data.Description: Tolerance range within which the measurement should remain; the sum of the positive and negative tolerances. May be scaled in measurement units or expressed as a proportion of the instrument rating.

data.Name: kurtosis
data.Description: A measure of the sharpness of a population distribution. If X10, X25, X75 and X90 are the values for which 10, 25, 75, and 90 percent of the population is smaller, respectively, then kurtosis = (X75 - X25) / 2(X90 - X10).

data.Name: amplitude kurtosis
data.Description: Kurtosis of seismic amplitude (normalized).

data.Name: model fit error
data.Description: Generic property for a measure of how well the actual data fit a model of the expected values and/or distribution of data. Standard measures include Standard Deviation, Variance, Chi-Square.

data.Name: normalized quantity
data.Description: Normalized property derived by a statistical algorithm normalizing between 0. and 1. the original values of some numerical data; the original data Property code and normalization range may be documented in Remarks.

data.Name: precision
data.Description: The repeatability of an instrument measured by the mean deviation of a set of measurements from the average value; the unit quantity is determined by that of the data.

data.Name: standard deviation
data.Description: Statistical standard deviation from the mean value for some data; normally abbreviated a lowercase sigma; the unit quantity is determined by that of the data.

data.Name: amplitude standard deviation
data.Description: Standard deviation of seismic amplitude.

data.Name: statistical skewness
data.Description: A statistical measure of asymmetry in a distribution.

data.Name: amplitude skewness
data.Description: Skewness of seismic amplitude (normalized).

data.Name: tolerance
data.Description: Allowable uncertainty or deviation from a standard; the unit quantity is determined by that of the data value.

data.Name: minus tolerance
data.Description: Amount of negative tolerance on a measurement value; the unit quantity is determined by that of data value.

data.Name: plus tolerance
data.Description: Amount of positive tolerance on a measurement value; the unit quantity is determined by that of data value.

data.Name: uncertainty
data.Description: Precision with which a measurement is known; often implies a 50-50 chance that any one of a series of measurements will fall within a given range; the unit quantity is determined by that of data value. Uncertainty is not necessarily related to Accuracy.

data.Name: length uncertainty
data.Description: Uncertainty of a Length measurement.

data.Name: uncertainty radius
data.Description: Magnitude of uncertainty for a measurement being represented as a position in 2D or 3D coordinate space, such as a geographical position.

data.Name: variance
data.Description: A measure of the width of the probability distribution for a single random variable; the square of standard deviation.

data.Name: stiffness
data.Description: The ratio of stress acting in a specified direction to the strain in a specified direction. Stiffness is a tensor of rank 4, but is expressible as a 6x6 matrix, the inverse of the compliance matrix.

data.Name: storativity
data.Description: Product of Porosity and Total Compressibility for a reservoir hydraulic unit.

data.Name: fracture storativity
data.Description: Fracture Storativity (Porosity * Total Compressibility product) of a finite conductivity vertical fracture ("(phi*Ct)f")

data.Name: storativity thickness
data.Description: The product of the Storativity of a layer and its thickness [phi*Ct*h].

data.Name: interwell storativity thickness
data.Description: Inter-well Storativity-Thickness [phi*Ct*h] for a horizontal interference test.

data.Name: total storativity thickness
data.Description: Sum of the Storativity_Thickness values of all layers in the model.

data.Name: strain
data.Description: Measure of the change in dimensions or shape caused by stress, generally expressed as a unitless ratio of the change of length per unit of initial length. If not otherwise specified, strain is taken to be "normal" (in the same direction as the stress).

data.Name: shear strain
data.Description: Shear component of the change in dimensions caused by stress, generally expressed as a unitless ratio.

data.Name: stress
data.Description: Force acting per unit area in a material resisting the stretching, compression or shear induced by external forces; fully characterized by a Stress_Tensor.

data.Name: eff formation stress
data.Description: Effective Stress of completed interval

data.Name: min in situ stress
data.Description: Formation minimum principal stress, the smallest of the 3 components of the diagonal stress tensor (fractures will propagate perpendicular to its direction). Can be defaulted to Frac Gradient x TVD. Can be output from DataFRAC treatment.

data.Name: shear stress
data.Description: Shear force (shear: strain that causes contiguous parts of a body to slide relatively to each other in a direction parallel to their plane of contact) per area unit of surface

data.Name: 1 minute gel strength
data.Description: Shear Stress required to break a gel fluid previously allowed to remain at rest for 1 minute.

data.Name: 10 minute gel strength
data.Description: Shear Stress required to break a gel fluid previously allowed to remain at rest for 10 minutes.

data.Name: 10 second gel strength
data.Description: Shear Stress required to break a gel fluid previously allowed to remain at rest for 10 seconds.

data.Name: 30 minute gel strength
data.Description: Shear Stress required to break a gel fluid previously allowed to remain at rest for 30 minutes.

data.Name: yield stress
data.Description: Resistance to initial flow; the stress required to start fluid movement. Specifically, shear stress at 0 shear rate for Bingham Plastic (BP) rheological model, otherwise named Bingham yield value or yield point. BP fluid remains static until applied forces build up to the point where it starts to move. See Plastic_Viscosity.

data.Name: api yield stress
