data.Description: Resistance to initial flow; the stress required to start fluid movement. When using the direct-indicating viscometer, it is found by subtracting plastic viscosity (API_Plastic_Viscosity) from the 300-rpm reading of a Fann35 rheometer.

data.Name: casson yield stress
data.Description: Resistance to initial flow; the stress required to start fluid movement. The Casson model equation is: SQRT(Shear_Stress) = SQRT(Yield_Stress) + SQRT(Plastic_Viscosity X Shear_Rate)

data.Name: stress tensor
data.Description: A second rank tensor whose components are the stresses exerted across surfaces perpendicular to the coordinate directions.

data.Name: von mises stress
data.Description: Normalized sum of the square of the differences of principal stresses applied to a material, e.g. for coiled tubing hoop, bending and radial. See Von_Mises_To_Yield_Ratio.

data.Name: stretch coefficient
data.Description: The amount of stretch per unit force applied.

data.Name: surface area
data.Description: Measure of the two-dimensional extent of the surface of some object.

data.Name: conductive inclusion size
data.Description: Average area of conductive inclusions as seen at the borehole wall

data.Name: cross section area
data.Description: The cross-sectional area of an object; e.g., area of perforation in a cased borehole.

data.Name: pipe cross sectional area
data.Description: Cross sectional area of a pipe

data.Name: drainage area
data.Description: The drainage area of a reservoir.

data.Name: gross area
data.Description: Gross area of a region such as that of a lease parcel or covered by a lease agreement.

data.Name: resistive inclusion size
data.Description: Average area of resistive inclusions as seen at the borehole wall

data.Name: total flow area
data.Description: Total cross-sectional area through which fluid can flow.

data.Name: synthetic seismic section
data.Description: An artificial seismic section produced by collecting artificially-generated traces (such as a Synthetic_Seismogram from log-derived Reflectivity) or by extracting data from an actual seismic section.

data.Name: synthetic seismogram
data.Description: An artificial seismic reflection record produced by assuming a particular wavelet and model. Commonly, a one dimensional synthetic seismogram is generated by convolving a typical seismic wavelet with log-derived Reflectivity.

data.Name: tape density
data.Description: Tape density, usually expressed in bits per inch.

data.Name: temperature
data.Description: The degree of hotness or coldness measured on a definite scale

data.Name: activation temperature
data.Description: Temperature at which recording should begin

data.Name: boiling point
data.Description: The temperature at which fractions of a liquid boil.

data.Name: bottomhole temperature
data.Description: The temperature at the bottom of a borehole occurring at the time of the activity being performed on the well.

data.Name: bottomhole circulating temperature
data.Description: The bottom hole temperature reached when circulating. Due to the cooling effect of the drill fluid, BHCT is below the BHST.

data.Name: bottomhole flowing temperature
data.Description: Temperature at the bottom of the well while flowing.

data.Name: bottomhole static temperature
data.Description: The bottom hole equilibrium temperature (when circulation is stopped)

data.Name: bubble point temperature
data.Description: The temperature at reservoir conditions at which gas in solution in crude oil comes out of solution as free gas.

data.Name: coolant temperature
data.Description: Temperature of the cooling fluid

data.Name: critical temperature
data.Description: The highest temperature at which a fluid can exist as a liquid and above which its vapor cannot be liquefied regardless of the amount of pressure. Applies to pure components; for mixtures use Pseudocritical_Temperature.

data.Name: dry gas critical temperature
data.Description: The highest temperature at which a gas can exist as a liquid and above which its vapor cannot be liquefied regardless of the amount of pressure (Dry gas = free gas without condensate)

data.Name: pseudocritical temperature
data.Description: The highest temperature at which a fluid can exist as a liquid and above which its vapor cannot be liquefied regardless of the amount of pressure. Used for mixtures, analogous to Critical_Temperature for pure components.

data.Name: wet gas critical temperature
data.Description: The highest temperature at which the gas can exist as a liquid and above which its vapor cannot be liquefied regardless of the amount of pressure (Wet gas - mixture of free gas plus condensate)

data.Name: differential temperature
data.Description: The difference in temperature between two objects or materials.

data.Name: engine oil temperature
data.Description: Engine lubrication Oil Temperature

data.Name: fann test temperature
data.Description: The temperature at which the Fann test was performed.

data.Name: final transfer temperature
data.Description: Final temperature of shipping bottle

data.Name: fluid temperature
data.Description: The temperature of a fluid (sample) under certain conditions.

data.Name: borehole temperature
data.Description: Temperature of the material in the borehole.

data.Name: annulus temperature
data.Description: Temperature of the fluid in the annulus. The annulus is the region outside the subject pipe, such as the region between drill pipe and the formation, or between casing and formation, or between tubing and casing.

data.Name: mud temperature
data.Description: The temperature of a mud or drilling fluid (sample) under certain conditions.

data.Name: mud temperature in
data.Description: The temperature of mud going into the hole, usually measured in the active circulating pit

data.Name: mud temperature out
data.Description: The temperature of mud coming out of the hole, usually measured in the ditch before the shale shakers

data.Name: oil temperature
data.Description: The temperature of oil under certain conditions.

data.Name: formation temperature
data.Description: Temperature of the (earth) formations.

data.Name: gel temperature
data.Description: Temperature of gelled fluid (fracturing gel, gelled acid ...)

data.Name: hydraulic drive temperature
data.Description: Temperature of the hydraulic fluid delivered to an Hydraulic motor

data.Name: initial reservoir pressure temperature
data.Description: Temperature taken when initial reservoir pressure recorded

data.Name: max operating temperature
data.Description: Maximum operating temperature for an equipment item.

data.Name: max storage temperature
data.Description: Maximum Storage Temperature

data.Name: max surge temperature
data.Description: Maximum Temperature to which this Equipment can be exposed for a short time without permanent damage; the Equipment will again perform to specifications when the Temperature is reduced below the maximum working temperature.

data.Name: max temperature
data.Description: Maximum temperature

data.Name: max temperature reached
data.Description: Maximum temperature reached by the system, sensor or equipment

data.Name: min storage temperature
data.Description: Minimum Storage Temperature

data.Name: orifice meter gas temperature
data.Description: Temperature of gas at orifice meter line when a sample is taken

data.Name: sensor temperature
data.Description: Temperature of a specific sensor.

data.Name: separator temperature
data.Description: Temperature of the separator when a sample is taken

data.Name: standard temperature
data.Description: Temperature considered to be "standard", for rates and volumes reported to be measured at Standard Conditions.

data.Name: surface temperature
data.Description: Temperature above ground. Temperature of the atmosphere.

data.Name: temperature in
data.Description: The temperature of the input material.

data.Name: temperature out
data.Description: The temperature of the output material

data.Name: temperature sensor resolution
data.Description: The minimum significant temperature change that can be detected above the noise. This is measured as the standard deviation of the differences between two successive measurements.

data.Name: tool temperature
data.Description: Internal temperature of the logging tool

data.Name: vertical lift temperature
data.Description: Computed temperature at some depth in tubing

data.Name: wellhead flowing temperature
data.Description: Temperature at the Wellhead with well flowing

data.Name: wellhead temperature
data.Description: The temperature at the wellhead occurring at the time of the activity being performed on the well.

data.Name: windchill temperature
data.Description: A measure of the combined chilling effect of wind and low temperature on living things, also named chill factor, e.g., according to US weather service table, an air temperature of 30 degF with a 10 mi/h corresponds to a "wind-chill" of 22 degF.

data.Name: working temperature
data.Description: Temperature at which an equipment item normally operates

data.Name: max working temperature
data.Description: Recommended maximum temperature at which equipment can be used

data.Name: min working temperature
data.Description: Recommended minimum temperature at which equipment can be used

data.Name: temperature rate
data.Description: A measure of the rate at which temperature varies per time

data.Name: thermal conductance
data.Description: The quantity of heat that passes in a unit time through a plate of particular area and thickness when its opposite faces differ in temperature by one kelvin

data.Name: thermal conductivity
data.Description: Heat flux or thermal energy per unit length and temperature. The capacity of a body to conduct or pass thermal energy. The capacity of a material to conduct or pass thermal energy.

data.Name: rock thermal conductivity
data.Description: Thermal conductivity of rock

data.Name: thermal expansion
data.Description: The change in size of a material due to a change in temperature at a constant pressure.

data.Name: linear thermal expansion
data.Description: The change in length of a material due to a change in temperature at a constant pressure.

data.Name: coefficient of linear thermal expansion
data.Description: Expansion of the length of an object with a unit increase in temperature

data.Name: volumetric coefficient of thermal expansion
data.Description: Expansion of the volume of an object with a unit increase in temperature

data.Name: thermal insulance
data.Description: Resistance of a material to heat flow over a unit area

data.Name: thermal resistance
data.Description: Resistance of a material to heat flow

data.Name: thermal transmissibility
data.Description: Thermal transmissibility, thermal conductivity multiplied by length

data.Name: thermal conduction transmissibility
data.Description: Thermal conduction transmissibility is a property measuring the transmissibility of heat between adjacent objects via conduction, as opposed to convection or mass transfer

data.Name: third party certification
data.Description: Certification by third party for the sampling bottle

data.Name: throughput
data.Description: A measure of the mass produced, say from some facility, per unit time.

data.Name: time
data.Description: 1) The measured or measurable period during which an action, process, or condition exists or continues. 2) The point or period when something occurs. 3) A fixed moment or hour for something to happen, begin, or end. 4) A historical period.

data.Name: absolute time
data.Description: A time value which is intended to fix an event in time, such as a geological time, a date, or the start time of a process.

data.Name: begin time
data.Description: Time at which a process began

data.Name: date
data.Description: The date, usually expressed in the format of the DBMS; e.g., Oracle date format is dd-mm-yy.

data.Name: abandon time
data.Description: The time that a reservoir was or is anticipated to be abandoned.

data.Name: award date
data.Description: Date lease awarded

data.Name: calibration date
data.Description: Date of calibration for the equipment; time may also be included.

data.Name: completion date
data.Description: Date that the activities that created the wellbore were completed and the wellbore was available to produce gas or oil, or for other intended service (e.g. gas storage, geothermal, etc.). Common completion activities include running and cementing the "production string" of casing, perforating the casing and cement sheath, installing the production string (tubing, packers, etc.) and the wellhead, etc.

data.Name: core date
data.Description: Date on which the core was recovered.

data.Name: create date
data.Description: Date of creation of a data item in the database.

data.Name: effective date
data.Description: The date on which a contract becomes effective or put in force.

data.Name: end date
data.Description: The date/time of the end of an activity.

data.Name: event date
data.Description: The date of an event.

data.Name: execution date
data.Description: The date that a contract is executed, usually the date of signing of the last signatory

data.Name: expiration date
data.Description: Expiration date of a legal document or an item.

data.Name: expiry date
data.Description: The date at which a contract terminates or is no longer in force. If the expiry date is amended, this is the amended date.

data.Name: original expiry date
data.Description: The original date that the contract was to terminate. If the contract is extended, this date does not change.

data.Name: grading date
data.Description: Date on which the grading of equipment condition or state took place.

data.Name: in service date
data.Description: The date on which an equipment item or product was placed in service.

data.Name: initial reservoir pressure date
data.Description: Date when initial reservoir pressure data were recorded

data.Name: last calibration date
data.Description: Date when a sensor was last calibrated

data.Name: load date
data.Description: Date data was loaded

data.Name: magnetic declination date
data.Description: Effective date and time at which the magnetic declination value has become valid.

data.Name: model year
data.Description: The year or full date of a model usually of an equipment item.

data.Name: modify date
data.Description: Date of modification of a data item in the database.

data.Name: publication date
data.Description: Date of publication of a document.

data.Name: report date
data.Description: Date (time) when report was completed or issued.

data.Name: sale date
data.Description: Date of lease purchase

data.Name: service date
data.Description: The date on which a service was performed.

data.Name: spud date
data.Description: The date a spud attempt was performed on a well

data.Name: start date
data.Description: The date/time a particular activity started.

data.Name: sampling start time
data.Description: Starting date/time of surface sampling

data.Name: static pressure date
data.Description: Date when Static Pressure data were recorded

data.Name: stop date
data.Description: The date a particular activity stopped.

data.Name: termination date
data.Description: The date on which a lease, an organization, or any legal or organizational entity was terminated.

data.Name: test date
data.Description: The date at which a particular test activity was conducted.

data.Name: total depth date
data.Description: The date/time at which the drilling reached total depth.

data.Name: end time
data.Description: Time at which a process ended

data.Name: sampling end time
data.Description: End date/time of surface sampling

data.Name: sensor end time
data.Description: End time (tend) as observed by downhole or surface sensors, measured as elapsed time since the Time Reference.

data.Name: transient end time
data.Description: End time (tend) of the Transient

data.Name: window end time
data.Description: End time of the processing window.

data.Name: geologic age
data.Description: The geochronologic age of an item or event, such as an earth layer. This is usually the average age in millions of years (Ma).

data.Name: end age
data.Description: The latest (numerically smallest) geologic or geochronologic age associated with an event or item, such as an earth layer, a fossil or pollen type.

data.Name: start age
data.Description: The earliest (numerically largest) geologic or geochronologic age associated with an event or item, such as an earth layer, a fossil or pollen type.

data.Name: reference time
data.Description: Reference Date and Time For Elapsed Time

data.Name: production history reference time
data.Description: Reference Date and Time for Production History

data.Name: start time
data.Description: The time a certain activity or sub-activity started. Use Start_Age for geochronological time.

data.Name: power supply start time
data.Description: Actual date and time at which the recorder was powered on.

data.Name: scheduled start time
data.Description: Scheduled start time for an activity

data.Name: sensor start time
data.Description: Start time (t0) as observed by downhole or surface sensors, measured as elapsed time since the Time Reference.

data.Name: transient start time
data.Description: Start time (t0) of the Transient

data.Name: window start time
data.Description: Start time of the processing window.

data.Name: stop time
data.Description: The time a certain activity or sub-activity stopped.

data.Name: time stamp
data.Description: A time value which is associated with some event to fix its occurrence in time; often expressed as an elapsed time from recent reference time.

data.Name: simulation time
data.Description: Simulation time

data.Name: thermal neutron decay time
data.Description: The time for the neutron population to fall to 1/e (37%) of its original value. Commonly called Tau, it is inversely related to Neutron_Capture_Cross_Section

data.Name: time constant
data.Description: Exponential decay time constant, also known as mean lifetime, tau and inverse of decay constant (lambda)

data.Name: time interval
data.Description: A time value which is intended to indicate the duration of a process or event.

data.Name: acoustic travel time
data.Description: The elapsed time required for an acoustic wave to travel from one point to another.

data.Name: integrated slowness
data.Description: Total acoustic travel time over a wellbore interval as computed by integrating acoustic slowness from a sonic log (Compressional_Slowness) over the interval.

data.Name: one way time
data.Description: The time required for an acoustic wave to travel directly from one point to another; used to distinguish from Two_Way_Time.

data.Name: two way time
data.Description: The time required for an acoustic wave to travel from its source to a reflector and return to a receiver.

data.Name: bottom two way time
data.Description: Depth of Bottom of Interval in Two Way Time

data.Name: map modeled time
data.Description: Two-way time obtained through map modeling of depth surface data

data.Name: time interpretation
data.Description: Generic interpretation on seismic traveltime sections

data.Name: migrated time interpretation
data.Description: Seismic travel time interpretation based on migrated sections; typically represented as a grid.

data.Name: stacked time interpretation
data.Description: Seismic traveltime interpretation based on stacked seismic sections

data.Name: top two way time
data.Description: Depth of Top of Interval in Two Way Time

data.Name: acquisition break time
data.Description: Acquisition system break time

data.Name: acquisition shot time
data.Description: Acquisition system shot time

data.Name: aperture time
data.Description: The time interval which contains the data used in a calculation, usually specified as the start and end times for the aperture.

data.Name: battery life
data.Description: Battery Life

data.Name: cumulative equivalent time
data.Description: Cumulative Equivalent Operating Time, called Cumulative Time Usage or CTU.

data.Name: current equivalent time
data.Description: Computed equivalent operating time based on the time spent at a given temperature and the maximum working temperature. If all the time is spent at maximum working temperature, then the equivalent time is equal to the operating time.

data.Name: delay time
data.Description: The time difference by which one event lags another. In refraction seismic work, the additional time required to traverse a raypath over the time which would be required to traverse the horizontal component at the highest velocity encountered on the raypath.

data.Name: max delay time
data.Description: Maximum Delay Time

data.Name: min delay time
data.Description: Minimum Delay Time

data.Name: time after bit
data.Description: In MWD/LWD logging, the time delay between the drill bit and a sensor reaching a given point in the wellbore.

data.Name: density time after bit
data.Description: In MWD/LWD logging, the time delay between the drill bit and a density sensor reaching a given point in the wellbore.

data.Name: gamma ray time after bit
data.Description: In MWD/LWD logging, the time delay between the drill bit and a gamma ray sensor reaching a given point in the wellbore.

data.Name: neutron time after bit
data.Description: In MWD/LWD logging, the time delay between the drill bit and a neutron sensor reaching a given point in the wellbore.

data.Name: resistivity time after bit
data.Description: In MWD/LWD logging, the time delay between the drill bit and a resistivity sensor reaching a given point in the wellbore.

data.Name: sonic time after bit
data.Description: In MWD/LWD logging, the time delay between the drill bit and a sonic sensor reaching a given point in the wellbore.

data.Name: toolface time after bit
data.Description: In MWD/LWD logging, the time delay between the drill bit and the point at which the toolface measurement is taken reaching a given point in the wellbore.

data.Name: downtime
data.Description: Time during which equipment is not operational condition or is otherwise unavailable.

data.Name: drift time
data.Description: The difference between actual acoustic travel time to a subsurface point (as measured in a check shot survey) and the integrated acoustic slowness from sonic logging data.

data.Name: duration
data.Description: Elapsed time from the start to the finish of a process or activity.

data.Name: session duration
data.Description: Elapsed time from the start to the finish of a recording or processing session.

data.Name: term
data.Description: Term of an agreement. Usually in years

data.Name: warmup duration
data.Description: Duration between power-on time and acquisition start time.

data.Name: event time
data.Description: Time of an event, such as a pick time from a waveform, expressed as the elapsed time from a chosen "zero" time.

data.Name: event time 0
data.Description: Event Time 0

data.Name: event time 1
data.Description: Event Time 1

data.Name: event time 2
data.Description: Event Time 2

data.Name: event time 3
data.Description: Event Time 3

data.Name: event time 4
data.Description: Event Time 4

data.Name: fracture closure time
data.Description: Time required by a hydraulic fracture to close. Can be derived from a Nolte plot (pressure vs. time). The more fluid that fluid leaks off into the formation, the faster the fracture closes.

data.Name: ideal sample shift 0
data.Description: Fractional sample shift associated with ideal position 0

data.Name: ideal sample shift 1
data.Description: Fractional sample shift associated with ideal position 1

data.Name: ideal sample shift 2
data.Description: Fractional sample shift associated with ideal position 2

data.Name: idle time
data.Description: Period of time during which equipment is idle. Complement of Operating_Time.

data.Name: intermediate time level
data.Description: Seismic line dependent adjustment to achieve a continuous, line independent reference surface

data.Name: interval time
data.Description: The time difference between two reflection events. It may vary due to velocity changes in different media, or changes in thickness of strata, or changes following erosion or structural deformation.

data.Name: max extreme time
data.Description: Maximum time at extreme conditions

data.Name: min scan time
data.Description: Scan Time corresponding to the fastest scanning rate supported by the Equipment

data.Name: mis tie phase time equivalent
data.Description: Equivalent time correction corresponding to the phase corrections. Assumes a specified dominant frequency.

data.Name: mis tie static time correction
data.Description: Constant time correction to apply to a seismic line to compensate for time differences.

data.Name: mis tie variable time correction
data.Description: Time correction applicable to each trace on a seismic line.

data.Name: normal moveout
data.Description: The additional time required for energy to travel from a source to a flat reflecting bed and back to a geophone at some distance from the source point compared to the time to return to a geophone at the source point.

data.Name: operating time
data.Description: Period of time which is spent operating, either for a single operation or for a series of operations. Complement of Idle_Time.

data.Name: bit drilled time
data.Description: The accumulated on-bottom, drilling time since the bit started drilling

data.Name: bit operating time
data.Description: Operating time of the bit over the reporting period.

data.Name: drilling time
data.Description: Elapsed time during which drilling has taken place.

data.Name: engine total time
data.Description: Time spent by an engine in operating condition since the last overhaul.

data.Name: expected life
data.Description: Expected operating time of the equipment, generally defined as operating time of the first failure for 95% of the equipment

data.Name: jar operating time
data.Description: Operating time of the jar over the reporting period.

data.Name: lwd operating time
data.Description: Operating time of the logging-while-drilling (LWD) equipment over the reporting period.

data.Name: motor operating time
data.Description: Operating time of the motor over the reporting period.

data.Name: mwd operating time
data.Description: Operating time of the MWD equipment over the reporting period.

data.Name: pumping time
data.Description: Elapsed time during which pumping has taken place.

data.Name: relative pumping time
data.Description: Time it takes to pump fluid into the fracture

data.Name: payout period
data.Description: The time in which all costs of leasing, exploring, drilling and operating have been recovered from production of a well or wells as defined by contractual agreement

data.Name: peak peak delta time
data.Description: Time difference between two peaks.

data.Name: peak trough delta time
data.Description: Time difference between peak and trough.

data.Name: period
data.Description: The time T for one cycle of a periodic function. The time for a wave crest to traverse a distance equal to one wavelength. The reciprocal of Frequency.

data.Name: processing window length time
data.Description: Length of window in time domain

data.Name: ramping duration
data.Description: Time duration of the ramp tapering the time window

data.Name: receiver event first arrival
data.Description: Time of arrival of first break for each receiver event

data.Name: receiver station time
data.Description: Time of first measurement for each station since the Origin_Time stored in Seis_Survey_Area

data.Name: recorder delay time
data.Description: Delay time between instrument power-on time and when recording begins

data.Name: reduced traveltime
data.Description: Difference between observed refraction traveltime and the traveltime which would have been observed if only one head-wave velocity had been involved.

data.Name: relaxation time
data.Description: In nuclear magnetic resonance measurements, the time constant related to the rate at which nuclei realign to the static magnetic field after disturbance by a radio frequency pulse.

data.Name: longitudinal relaxation time
data.Description: Longitudinal, or spin-lattice, relaxation time constant for alignment rate of nuclei to static magnetic field; normally abbreviated by symbol T1.

data.Name: transverse relaxation time
data.Description: Transverse, or spin-spin, relaxation time constant for transverse magnetization decay rate of nuclei; normally abbreviated by symbol T2.

data.Name: sampling duration
data.Description: Duration of data sampling or recording.

data.Name: sampling period
data.Description: Time interval between the recording of two sequential data samples.

data.Name: sliding window duration
data.Description: Duration (length) in time of the sliding window used for processing.

data.Name: snap window bottom
data.Description: Interval below the picked Z to search for the Tracking Event and Snap_Type when snapping

data.Name: snap window top
data.Description: Interval above the picked Z to search for the Tracking Event and Snap_Type when snapping

data.Name: stable elapsed time
data.Description: Time elapsed since production conditions were stable

data.Name: tie point total time correction
data.Description: Total amount of mis-tie correction to apply. Evaluated at line ties.

data.Name: time increment
data.Description: Time increment between samples indexed by time.

data.Name: time of first data
data.Description: Listening time until first detection

data.Name: time system offset wrt standard time
data.Description: Time zone correction (defined to fractions of an hour) to be added to vehicle system time to correct to standard time. (GMT, UTC,...)
data.Code: time system offset wrt standard time

data.Name: tracking operator length
data.Description: Length (time or depth interval) of the crosscorrelation window to use while tracking

data.Name: tracking window bottom
data.Description: Interval below the picked Z to search for the Tracking Event and Snap_Type while tracking

data.Name: tracking window top
data.Description: Interval above the picked Z to search for the Tracking Event and Snap_Type while tracking

data.Name: transfer duration
data.Description: Duration of sampling operation

data.Name: transit time
data.Description: Time required for a wave to travel from one point to another.

data.Name: acquisition transit time
data.Description: Acquisition system transit time

data.Name: integrated transit time
data.Description: Acoustic transit time computed by integrating acoustic slowness measurements (from a sonic log) over a depth interval.

data.Name: time pick
data.Description: Acoustic transit time (normally a two-way time) from seismic reference datum to the well marker, as picked from a seismic section.

data.Name: transit time ampmod
data.Description: Transit time estimated from processing

data.Name: transit time initial
data.Description: Initial transit time

data.Name: transit time nmo
data.Description: Normal moveout transit time

data.Name: transit time nominal
data.Description: Nominal transit time

data.Name: transit time qfactor
data.Description: Transit time q-factor

data.Name: transit time sensor
data.Description: Transit time taken from tool sensor

data.Name: transit time shear
data.Description: Shear wave transit time

data.Name: transit time slope
data.Description: Transit time slope

data.Name: transit time srd
data.Description: Transit time with respect to seismic reference datum

data.Name: trough peak delta time
data.Description: Time difference between trough and peak

data.Name: trough trough delta time
data.Description: Time difference between two troughs

data.Name: vertical time thickness
data.Description: Vertical time difference between layers.

data.Name: wave period
data.Description: Average elapsed time between the passing of two wave peaks.

data.Name: time per volume
data.Description: Amount of time for a given volume

data.Name: tool control
data.Description: Property that controls the state or operation of a tool.

data.Name: torque
data.Description: Something that produces rotation or torsion and whose effectiveness is measured by the product of the force and the perpendicular distance from the line of action of the force to the axis of rotation.

data.Name: breakout torque
data.Description: Torque required to break out a pipe or casing connection

data.Name: downhole torque
data.Description: Downhole torque, as applied to the drill string

data.Name: downhole bending moment
data.Description: The bending force measured by an MWD/LWD tool

data.Name: drillstring drive torque
data.Description: Torque applied to the drillstring, measured at the rotary table or top-drive.

data.Name: makeup torque
data.Description: Torque required to make up a pipe or casing connection

data.Name: surface torque
data.Description: Rotary torque as measured at the surface

data.Name: torsional yield
data.Description: Maximum torque which can be applied to an object without causing permanent deformation.

data.Name: conn torsional yield
data.Description: Maximum torque which can be applied to the joint/connection/thread without causing permanent deformation.

data.Name: tube torsional yield
data.Description: Maximum torque which can be applied to the tube or body without causing permanent deformation.

data.Name: trajectory
data.Description: A description of the path that some activity or object makes as it traverses a medium.

data.Name: ccp trajectory
data.Description: List linking shots and receivers to Common Conversion Points (CCP) in depth. Defines the trajectory in shot-offset domain to stack along to image a point in depth.

data.Name: turbidity
data.Description: Measure of the degree to which light traversing a medium is scattered; for water, the scattering is due to particulate material and/or soluble colored compounds. Turbidity is most commonly measured in Nephelometric Turbidity Units (NTU).

data.Name: type
data.Description: The type of any item. Applies to all items in all domains.

data.Name: accident type
data.Description: Type of Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental accident such as Fluid Spill, Kick While Drilling, Kick While Tripping, ...

data.Name: acquisition type
data.Description: Type or mode of data acquisition

data.Name: activity type
data.Description: The type of an Activity performed on a Well, a Region, or an Earth subsurface component, e.g. Drilling, Seismic, Logging, etc.

data.Name: allowed position
data.Description: Allowed position of an equipment item with respect to the assembly in which it operates.

data.Name: api pin conn type
data.Description: API pin connection type

data.Name: arc type
data.Description: The type of Arc objects which bound surface regions of the Earth, e.g. State Boundary, River, etc.

data.Name: availability
data.Description: An indicator of the degree to which data, a product or a service is available for use; used to classify E and P data in order to support filtering of non-essential data from output.

data.Name: azimuth reference type
data.Description: Type of geographical object used as reference for azimuth measurements: by default, azimuths are referred to True North.

data.Name: baselap type
data.Description: The type of a Baselap in the Earth subsurface, whether it is an Onlap or a Downlap

data.Name: battery type
data.Description: Recorder battery type

data.Name: bearing type
data.Description: Type of bearing, such as sealed or mud lubricated

data.Name: bed character
data.Description: The Characteristic given to a Bed or layer (e.g. has sealing characteristic or is probable source rock.)

data.Name: bed set type
data.Description: The type of bed grouping

data.Name: bed type
data.Description: The general physical and structural character or pattern of beds and their contacts within a rock mass; e.g., cross-bedding and graded bedding; homogenous, wave ripples, planar cross beds.

data.Name: bioturbation type
data.Description: The type of Bioturbation: the mixing of sediments by burrowing organisms.

data.Name: bit profile
data.Description: Profile of the bit (PDC type bit)

data.Name: boat type
data.Description: Supply boat, tanker, dynamic positioning vehicle etc.

data.Name: bottomhole end type
data.Description: Indicates what limits the total depth (plug back, borehole bottom, bridge plug, sump packer ...)

data.Name: boundary type
data.Description: The type of a Boundary in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Facies Boundary, Sequence Boundary, etc.

data.Name: bulk addition mode
data.Description: Describes how the bulk material was added to the mixture.

data.Name: burner type
data.Description: Type of burner

data.Name: business associate job title
data.Description: The assignment of an administrative job title to a business associate in the context of a business association

data.Name: business line
data.Description: Group of activities or services gathered by some commonalities

data.Name: business region type
data.Description: The type of a Business defined region of the Earth surface, e.g. Field, Lease, Concession, etc.

data.Name: cable type
data.Description: Type of cable.

data.Name: calibrator type
data.Description: Type of device used to calibrate the sensor or tool.

data.Name: casing type
data.Description: Type of casing or tubing used, such as riser, conductor, intermediate, liner, surface, tubing, production, etc.

data.Name: cement additive type
data.Description: Type of additive(s) used to change the properties of the cement.

data.Name: cement retarder type
data.Description: Type of material used to retard the setting of the cement.

data.Name: cement type
data.Description: Type of cement

data.Name: cement unit type
data.Description: Cementing unit type

data.Name: centralizer test type
data.Description: The type of a Centralizer Test used to test a centralizer, usually during any well operation.

data.Name: centralizer type
data.Description: The type of a Centralizer used to center a casing, a tubular, or a logging tool in the center or near the center of the borehole, aligned with the borehole axis.

data.Name: chemical function
data.Description: Primary purpose of a chemical e.g. Corrosion_Inhibitor, Gelling_Agent, Retarder, Emulsifier, ...

data.Name: chemical product type
data.Description: The type of a Chemical Product used in various types of activities, usually those provided by Dowell-Schlumberger

data.Name: chemistry type
data.Description: Type of chemical system.

data.Name: choke manifold type
data.Description: Type of choke manifold

data.Name: classification
data.Description: Systematic arrangement in groups or categories according to established criteria.

data.Name: classification group code
data.Description: Associates class definitions into one family: Generic, Unsupervised, Pore_Fluid, Lithologic, Seismostratigraphic, Texture, User_Defined_Mix, User_Defined_No_Mix.

data.Name: classification method type
data.Description: The type of method used for classification: e.g. Statistical, Artificial Neural Net, or Clustering.

data.Name: classification scope
data.Description: Per Method expects a maximum of one parameter instance per classification activity. Per Class expects a maximum of as many parameter instances as classes were involved in the classification activity.

data.Name: company type
data.Description: The type of a Company, e.g. E and P, Service, Contractor, Vendor, etc.

data.Name: completion type
data.Description: Type of well completion.

data.Name: confidentiality level
data.Description: Describes the confidentiality of the information related to the well, e.g., Tight (operator only), Sensitive (some restriction), Public

data.Name: conn 1 type
data.Description: Type of the top or the first standard tool connection.

data.Name: conn 2 type
data.Description: Type of the bottom or second standard tool connection.

data.Name: connector type
data.Description: Type of casing or tubing connector according to that particular thread manufacturer; e.g., 8 RD STandC, 8 RD LTandC, Buttress, Hydril F J-P, Atbrad FL-3S, etc.

data.Name: constraint type
data.Description: Type of constraint. Examples include UNCONSTRAINED, STRING_ENUM, INTEGER_ENUM, INTEGER_RANGE, FLOAT_RANGE, DATE_RANGE, ENTITY_CLASS, CATALOG_ATTR, etc.

data.Name: construct
data.Description: Construct specifies how instances of the given Value Domain are assembled into a single Value. Together Value Domain and Construct are used to derive Value_Type. Construct can be null (for a single value), L (for List), V (for Vector) , LL (List of Lists) , VL, PL, etc.

data.Name: contact throw sense
data.Description: Specify whether contact corresponds to upthrown or downthrown portion of fault.

data.Name: contact type
data.Description: The type of contact or interface between Earth subsurface regions

data.Name: core type
data.Description: Identifies the type of core sample, such as Main, Plug, Slab, Sidewall, etc.

data.Name: coring method
data.Description: The type of method used to acquire a core sample; e.g. Rotary Conventional, Rotary Sponge, Sidewall Mechanical, etc.

data.Name: cost charge type
data.Description: Indicates whether the cost allocation is valid for the start (Start), end (End) of activity or at a given date (User)

data.Name: cs trans type
data.Description: The type of Transformation used between 2 coordinate systems, e.g. Molodensky, Affine 2D, etc.

data.Name: cultural feature type
data.Description: The type of cultural feature that is to be found on a map

data.Name: cushion type
data.Description: Type of fluid in the test string prior to initial open of the well.

data.Name: cutter type
data.Description: Type of cutters, as used in drilling reamers (such as Type T, F, or B)

data.Name: data direction
data.Description: Direction of data flow, e.g. Input, Output or both.

data.Name: data focus type
data.Description: Indicates how the entity set to be used as the starting point of a query is formed.

data.Name: data reduction type
data.Description: Method used for data reduction, e.g. Linear decimation, Logarithmic, etc.

data.Name: def display type
data.Description: Default type of display used for a data object, such as an Array.

data.Name: depositional environment type
data.Description: The type of deposition that has created a particular Earth environment, e.g. Reef, Beachrock, Pointbar, etc.

data.Name: derivative model
data.Description: Derivative Model used in evaluating this Transient, e.g., Backward, Central, or Forward.

data.Name: derivative type
data.Description: Type of derivative used in evaluating this transient.

data.Name: diff pressure gauge type
data.Description: Sensor used to acquire gas differential pressure across orifice plate

data.Name: dip pattern type
data.Description: The type of pattern created by the earth dipping planes, e.g. Green, Red, Blue, etc.

data.Name: dip type
data.Description: The type of dipping associated with subsurface planes; e.g., CrossBedding, Fault, Fracture, BedBoundary, etc.

data.Name: dip classification
data.Description: Classification information for the dips as dip color (RGB), shape, or type

data.Name: dip valid zone type
data.Description: This property specifies whether the zone where the dips were computed corresponded to a Blank zone with no dips, a Mirror Image zone, or a borehole Washout zone.

data.Name: discontinuity type
data.Description: The type of discontinuity: a detectable interruption in the material which may or may not have undesirable connotations (e.g. crack, lap, seam, pit, lamination, etc.)

data.Name: bottom discontinuity type
data.Description: Type of Discontinuity forming the bottom boundary.

data.Name: top discontinuity type
data.Description: Type of Discontinuity forming the top boundary

data.Name: dosing mode
data.Description: The way an additive is measured e.g. By Weight Of Cement, BOW, gl/sk ....

data.Name: drill bit type
data.Description: Generic type of the drill bit, such as Roller Cone or PDC.

data.Name: drill collar type
data.Description: Generic type of drill collar, such as spiral, normal, slip and elevator

data.Name: drill downhole tool type
data.Description: Generic type of downhole drilling tool.

data.Name: drill hole opener reamer type
data.Description: Generic type of tool i.e. standard, bull nose hole opener, underreamer, LHO (Large Hole Opener with rollers),roller reamer, 3-Point Roller Reamer, 6-Point Roller Reamer

data.Name: drill jar shock type
data.Description: Generic type such as hydraulic jar, mechanical jar, shock sub

data.Name: drill motor type
data.Description: Generic type of the Motor or Turbine used during a drilling activity.

data.Name: drill pipe type
data.Description: Generic drill pipe type such as Normal Grade, Heavy Weight, Hevi-Wate, or Thick Wall

data.Name: drill slot cluster type
data.Description: Generic type of drill slot cluster such as template and pad

data.Name: drill stabilizer type
data.Description: Generic stabilizer type such as Welded Blade, Integral Blade, Replaceable Sleeve, Clamp-on, Rubber Sleeve, Rockback, RWP (replaceable wear pad)

data.Name: drill structure type
data.Description: Generic type of drilling structure such as land rig, barge rig, submersible rig, jack-up rig, semisubmersible rig, drillships, structure rig

data.Name: drill sub type
data.Description: Type of sub - bent, bent orienting, cross-over, bitsaver, kelly-saver, extension, UBHO (Universal Bottom Hole Orienting), float, saver, lift, pressure release, etc

data.Name: dst gauge type
data.Description: Type of DST Gauge Adapter

data.Name: east west line
data.Description: Indicates whether the East or West boundary line of the survey area has been used as a reference for East_West_Distance values.

data.Name: equipment type
data.Description: The type or class of an equipment used for some activity, e.g. Sensor, Drill Bit, Turbine, etc.

data.Name: event class
data.Description: Event classification by type

data.Name: event subclass
data.Description: Event classification by Subclass

data.Name: existence kind
data.Description: Classification of the lifecycle state of an entity: actual, planned, predicted, etc.

data.Name: facies boundary type
data.Description: The type of a Facies Boundary in the Earth subsurface

data.Name: facies type
data.Description: The type of a Facies in the Earth subsurface

data.Name: fault character
data.Description: The characterization of a Fault in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Sealing, Non Sealing, Constant Pressure, etc.

data.Name: fault distortion type
data.Description: The type of distortion associated with a fault plane, e.g. Rollover, Drag, etc.

data.Name: fault type
data.Description: The type of a Fault in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Normal, Hinge, Reverse, Dextral, etc.

data.Name: faulting time wrt sedimentation
data.Description: Time of faulting with respect to the sedimentation process, e.g. Post Deposition, Post Compaction, etc.

data.Name: faulting time wrt tilt
data.Description: Time of faulting with respect to tectonic events which tilted the bed, e.g. Anterior, Posterior

data.Name: feature intersection type
data.Description: Defines how a Wellbore intersects with a Geologic Feature

data.Name: file type
data.Description: Generic property for computer file types.

data.Name: firing head type
data.Description: Type of TCP Equipment: firing head, debris sub, shock absorber, etc.

data.Name: flow direction
data.Description: Indicates the flowing mode of a well completion; typically Injector or Producer.

data.Name: flow direction setup
data.Description: Indicates the wellbore flow direction for which an equipment item has been configured.

data.Name: flow head type
data.Description: Type of flow head

data.Name: flow regime
data.Description: The flow condition of a multiphase process stream; e.g. slug, mist, or stratified flow.

data.Name: flow type
data.Description: The type of flow of a fluid, e.g. Laminar, Pivot, etc.

data.Name: fluid contact type
data.Description: The type of fluid contact between Earth subsurface regions or volumes, e.g. Oil Water Contact, Gas Water Contact, etc.

data.Name: fluid marker type
data.Description: The type of a fluid marker depending on the fluid type occupying either side of the surface intersecting the borehole (e.g. Gas above Oil, Oil above Water, etc.)

data.Name: fluid phase
data.Description: The phase of a fluid (gas or liquid)

data.Name: fluid return outlet
data.Description: Location of drilling fluid outlet of the circulating system. It is normally on the rig floor at the level of mud pit. In some offshore cases (conductor) it can be on the sea bed.

data.Name: fluid type
data.Description: The type of fluid. Usually associated with a formation, a reservoir, borehole, etc.

data.Name: base fluid type
data.Description: The type of the base fluid usually used in chemical mixing, such Oil or Water.

data.Name: coring fluid type
data.Description: The type of fluid that was in the borehole at the time the coring operation was in progress; e.g. water, brine, oil, mud, etc.

data.Name: displaced fluid type
data.Description: Type of fluid displaced by the injection of another fluid.

data.Name: drill fluid type
data.Description: Generic type of the fluid used during a drilling activity; e.g., chemical gel mud, crude oil, caustic (high ph), gypsum mud, native mud, air, salt water, etc.

data.Name: flowing fluid type
data.Description: Type of fluid flowing into or out of a well completion: Condensate, Oil, Gas, etc.

data.Name: injected fluid type
data.Description: Type of fluid injected.

data.Name: lower fluid type
data.Description: The type of fluid found in the layer below a reference surface (e.g. Water in layer below a Fluid Contact in a Reservoir.)

data.Name: transfer fluid type
data.Description: Liquid displaced away during sampling

data.Name: upper fluid type
data.Description: The type of fluid found in the layer above a reference surface (e.g. Water in layer above a Fluid Contact in a Reservoir,)

data.Name: well treatment fluid type
data.Description: Type of Fluid used in Well Treatment operation

data.Name: fold type
data.Description: Type of fold (e.g., Rollover)

data.Name: foreign system
data.Description: Type of seismic system: Charisma, IESX

data.Name: format
data.Description: General plan of organization or arrangement, such as for a computer data file or for the presentation of data.

data.Name: date format
data.Description: Specification of how date information will be formatted.

data.Name: digital encoding
data.Description: Identification of how data are encoded digitally; e.g. ASCII, Binary, etc.

data.Name: digital file format
data.Description: The type of file structure in which the depiction rendering is encoded; e.g. PostScript, ANSI text, GIFF, JPG, Maker Interchange Format (MIF), SGML, HTML.

data.Name: display name format
data.Description: Specification of how the name of a data item will be displayed to the user.

data.Name: formation system type
data.Description: Formation system assigned by the client

data.Name: fossil type
data.Description: Type of fossil (animal or plant remnant from past geological ages, preserved in the earth's crust)

data.Name: fracture condition
data.Description: Characterizes the condition of the fracture with respect to its void space; e.g. Open, Closed, Vuggy, etc.

data.Name: fracture element distribution type
data.Description: Type of spatial variation (linear or elliptical) of fracture height, width and conductivity

data.Name: fracture origin
data.Description: Characterizes the origin of a fracture i.e. natural (inherent) or induced.

data.Name: fracture type
data.Description: Type of formation fracture.

data.Name: gas description type
data.Description: Type of data describing the gas: complete hydrocarbon composition, impurities (H2S, CO2,N2) or gas gravity.

data.Name: gas gravimeter type
data.Description: Type of instrument used to measure gas gravity

data.Name: gas line pressure gauge type
data.Description: Gauge used to measure gas meter pressure

data.Name: gas line temperature gauge type
data.Description: Gauge used to measure gas meter temperature

data.Name: gas meter type
data.Description: Type of meter used to measure gas flowrate

data.Name: gas pressure axis type
data.Description: One of the pressure transformations used in Gas Well Interpretation

data.Name: geologic age type
data.Description: Type of geologic age unit; e.g., Era, Period, Epoch, Age.

data.Name: geological influence type
data.Description: The type of geological influence that dominates some feature such as a sedimentary channel, e.g. Wave dominated, Delta dominated, etc.

data.Name: geophone type
data.Description: Type of geophone, used to detect particle motion associated with the passage of a seismic wave.

data.Name: geopolitical region type
data.Description: The type of a geopolitical region, e.g. Nation, State, County, Province, Community, etc.

data.Name: granulometric sequence type
data.Description: This property specifies whether the granules making up a Earth subsurface sequence are coarsening up or fining up.

data.Name: h2s service type
data.Description: Type of H2S corrosion service capability, e.g., Proof or Resistant

data.Name: heater type
data.Description: Heater type

data.Name: hemisphere
data.Description: Code of the earth hemisphere (Northern or Southern) in which this projection is located.

data.Name: hole condition type
data.Description: The type of a borehole condition.

data.Name: horizon tracking event
data.Description: Type of waveform event identified by the Horizon (crossing +/-, crossing -/+, peak, trough)

data.Name: horizon type
data.Description: The type of a Horizon in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Seismic or Geological

data.Name: hydraulic model type
data.Description: Type of Flow Behavior for the Hydraulic Unit, including the Inner Boundary Type + Reservoir Behavior Type + Outer Boundary Type

data.Name: hydrophone type
data.Description: Type of geophone, used to detect pressure changes associated with the passage of a seismic wave.

data.Name: iadc code
data.Description: International Association of Drilling Contractor Code, used for drill bits.

data.Name: inclusion type
data.Description: The type of inclusions in a rock e.g. pebble, nodules, etc.

data.Name: index type
data.Description: Type of index for indexed data, such as Measured Depth (MD), True Vertical Depth (TVD), etc.

data.Name: inertial flow coefficient correlation type
data.Description: Inertial Flow Coefficient Correlation (e.g. Saucier, Firoozabadi, etc. )

data.Name: injection point
data.Description: Indicates where a fluid is injected in the main flow e.g. Low Pressure Discharge...

data.Name: inner boundary condition type
data.Description: Description of the inner boundary condition for a well test model.

data.Name: interruption type
data.Description: The type of interruption in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Missing Section, Repeat Section, etc.

data.Name: ipr fluid flow model type
data.Description: Type of Inflow Performance Behavior for the Hydraulic Unit (Darcy, Forcheimer, Vogel, Cheng)

data.Name: line style
data.Description: Line drawing style, such as pattern of dots and dashes.

data.Name: line thickness
data.Description: Line drawing width or thickness

data.Name: line type
data.Description: The type of an Earth curvilinear object, e.g. the line along the intersection of 2 subsurface horizons.

data.Name: litho type
data.Description: The classification of lithology in a stratified environment, e.g. Carbonate, Shale, Sand, etc.

data.Name: lower surface relation
data.Description: The type of relationship between a surface and the ones below (e.g. the surfaces below a Horizon are eroded).

data.Name: material phase
data.Description: The physical state or phase of a material, such as Liquid or Solid.

data.Name: material type
data.Description: The type or class of materials both naturally occurring or used in some activity, e.g. Hydrocarbon, Mineral, Rock, Steel, Proppant, etc.

data.Name: blade material
data.Description: Material used in the blade, such as steel, aluminum or plastic. This material represents material of sleeve structure in sleeve type stabilizers and is the same as the body material in integral stabilizers.

data.Name: memory type
data.Description: Memory Type, e.g., EEPROM, RAM ...

data.Name: merge strategy
data.Description: Strategy for merging data, such as into a waveform gather.

data.Name: method type
data.Description: The type of method used in an analysis activity in the lab or other type of activities at the wellsite. For example: chemical treatment methods.

data.Name: anti collision method
data.Description: Method used for calculating the proximity: 0 - Normal; 1 - Horizontal; 2 - Least Distance

data.Name: blocking method type
data.Description: Blocking method

data.Name: classification method code
data.Description: Classification method used in this activity.

data.Name: computation type
data.Description: Computation method used in the generation of data.

data.Name: eou computation method
data.Description: Method used for calculating the ellipse of uncertainty: 0 - Wolfe and de Wardt; 1 - Conic

data.Name: interpolation method
data.Description: Interpolation method used in the generation of data.

data.Name: preparation method
data.Description: Method by which an item or sample has been prepared for subsequent operations or analysis.

data.Name: core preparation method
data.Description: Method by which a core sample has been prepared for analysis.

data.Name: preservation method
data.Description: Method by which an item or sample, such as a core sample, has been preserved.

data.Name: core preservation method
data.Description: Method by which a core sample has been preserved.

data.Name: ramping method
data.Description: Method to ramp (tapering) the time window, e.g., Hamming, Hanning...

data.Name: stacking method type
data.Description: Stacking method (e.g. median, average, auto, manual)

data.Name: tvd computation method
data.Description: Method of defining the wellbore trajectory based upon directional survey data; includes curve fitting to the survey points and extrapolating beyond them.

data.Name: mineral class
data.Description: The classification of a mineral.

data.Name: mineral group
data.Description: The group to which a mineral belongs.

data.Name: mineral type
data.Description: The type of a mineral.

data.Name: mixture type
data.Description: Qualifier to determine if a component is a pure chemical or a mixture of other chemicals.

data.Name: morpho type
data.Description: The classification of rocks from their internal morphology i.e., lamination thickness, inclusion size, etc.

data.Name: mud pump monitoring purpose
data.Description: The purpose of the mud pump monitoring. It can be either for well control or monitoring the pump parameters at working conditions.

data.Name: mud pump type
data.Description: The type of pump used to pump drilling fluid or mud, usually into the borehole during drilling operations.

data.Name: mud type
data.Description: Type of mud used

data.Name: naming system
data.Description: Name of the system which controls the valid or legal names of entities. For example, there are numerous system for naming wells: API 12 digit, CPA, Tobin

data.Name: neighborhood
data.Description: A topological property indicating whether a spatial object lies to the "left" or to the "right" of a neighboring object whose orientation sense has been specified.

data.Name: node type
data.Description: The type of (topological) Node, as used in the Region submodel.

data.Name: north south line
data.Description: Indicates whether the North or South boundary line of the survey area has been used as a reference for North_South_Distance values.

data.Name: occurrence order
data.Description: The order of occurrence of a particular item.

data.Name: oil gravimeter type
data.Description: Type of instrument used to measure oil specific gravity

data.Name: oil line temperature gauge type
data.Description: Type of gauge used to measure oil line temperature of separator

data.Name: oil rate meter type
data.Description: Type of liquid meter used to measure oil rate

data.Name: oil viscosity correlation
data.Description: Model used to compute oil viscosity

data.Name: operating mode
data.Description: Operating mode of an equipment

data.Name: organization role
data.Description: Role of organization (e.g. Business Associate)

data.Name: outer boundary condition type
data.Description: Description of the outer boundary condition for a well test model.

data.Name: packaging type
data.Description: Type of Packaging or container used for products, such as Drum, Sack, Bulk, Pieces, Pallets

data.Name: packer motion type
data.Description: Internal tubular (e.g. tubing) motion allowed by the packer during an increase in pressure. Choices: Free (Packer does not restrain motion), Limited (tubular is free to shorten but not lengthen) and No Motion.

data.Name: packer type
data.Description: Type of packer; supplier type like Dowell Model 21. No simple type description available but the supplier identification.

data.Name: partial completion model
data.Description: Model used to compute the Partial Completion apparent skin effect

data.Name: perforation charge type
data.Description: Type of explosive charge used in a perforating gun.

data.Name: perforation gun phase
data.Description: Phasing of the perforating gun for the given perforated interval. Standard phasings include Inline (0 deg), Spiral (45, 60, 90, 120, 180 deg), Tangential(90-270 deg).

data.Name: perforation gun position
data.Description: The position of the perforating gun relative to the tubing/casing in the borehole. Options include: Positioned (usu. Through-Tubing guns), Not Positioned (usu. Casing guns), Centralized.

data.Name: perforation gun type
data.Description: The type of perforating gun used to shoot the given interval of the tubing (or casing) in the borehole. Examples are: 3-3/8" 6 SPF, 3-3/8" HJ HI-TEMP, 4" HJ II, etc.

data.Name: perforation type
data.Description: The method used to open the production in the borehole. Examples are: Bullet, Jet, Combination, Open Hole, etc.

data.Name: personnel role
data.Description: Role of the personnel counted in Personnel_Count; these may be implemented as lists.

data.Name: plane type
data.Description: The type of a plane in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Bed Plane, Fault Plane, Fracture Plane, etc.

data.Name: platform type
data.Description: The type of a platform.

data.Name: play type
data.Description: A type or code assigned to a lease. Play codes can be internal to company and are usually based upon geographic boundaries or geologic trends.

data.Name: point type
data.Description: The type of an Earth zero-dimensional object such as a marker.

data.Name: porosity type
data.Description: The porosity type usually of a core sample or in either a carbonate or clastic rock formation (e.g. Intercrystal, Breccia, Vuggy, etc.),

data.Name: pressure drop correlation
data.Description: Pressure drop correlation (e.g., Dun-Ros, Cullender, )

data.Name: pressure drop correlation type
data.Description: Pressure drop correlation (e.g., Dun-Ros, Cullender, etc. )

data.Name: pressure operation type
data.Description: Type of pressure-operated mechanism. Certain tools are be operated by either tubing or annulus pressure. These tools frequently contain a rupture disk or break plug and are single-shot.

data.Name: pressure point setup
data.Description: Identifies the location of the fluid whose pressure is being recorded.

data.Name: production history type
data.Description: Type of production/Injection data set : Previous_Flow_History (Production), Injection, Previous_Flow_History (Production), Simulated_Behavior (Test), Actual_Field (Flow)

data.Name: projection class
data.Description: Base projection type (e.g. TM for UTM_1)

data.Name: projection cs type
data.Description: The type of a Projection coordinate system, e.g. Lambert, UTM, State Plane, etc.

data.Name: pumping schedule type
data.Description: Type of pumping schedule i.e. as measured, design, alternate...

data.Name: range type
data.Description: Specification whether the value range is inclusive[], exclusive (), or mixed: [) or (].

data.Name: recorder type
data.Description: Recorder type

data.Name: related sample type
data.Description: Type of related samples taken in the recombination set

data.Name: relationship constraint type
data.Description: Type of constraint for a relationship, such as Restrict, Cascade, or Nullify.

data.Name: relationship type
data.Description: Type of relationship between two objects: Containment, Reference, Supertype, Catalog,etc.

data.Name: relative permeability basis
data.Description: Absolute or effective permeability basis for the relative permeability.

data.Name: representation type
data.Description: The type of computer representation used to manipulate a property value, e.g. Grid, Array, Primitive, etc.

data.Name: reservoir type
data.Description: Description of the reservoir type for a well test model.

data.Name: rheology model
data.Description: Mathematical model describing how the shear stress relates to the shear rate i.e. how a fluid flows and is deformed in response to applied stresses. Most popular model are Newtonian, Bingham Plastic and Power-Law

data.Name: rights type
data.Description: Type of lease rights

data.Name: rock class
data.Description: Classification of rocks into Chemical, Volcaniclastic, etc.

data.Name: rock genesis
data.Description: Classification of rocks by genetic origin, e.g. Sedimentary, Igneous, etc.

data.Name: rock subclass
data.Description: Classification of rocks into Carbonate, Evaporite, etc. Commonly called Lithology.

data.Name: rotation sense
data.Description: Describes the sense of the axis system rotation specified by {ROTATION_1,ROTATION_2,ROTATION_3}. Most commonly used are "X_Y_Z" and "Z_NEWX_NEWZ".

data.Name: running direction
data.Description: Running direction of an equipment: Pulling Out Of Hole-POOH (Up=-1) or Running In Hole-RIH (Down=1)

data.Name: safety drill type
data.Description: Type of Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental safety drill such as Fire Drill, Abandon Ship Drill, Spill Control Drill.

data.Name: sale group
data.Description: Within a business line, Sales services are gathered by group with technical commonalities.

data.Name: sample type
data.Description: Nature of the sample e.g. oil or gas

data.Name: sampling bottle type
data.Description: Type of sampling bottle

data.Name: scan type
data.Description: Describes the way in which a subject is scanned to take data samples or to generate an image.

data.Name: screen arrangement
data.Description: Position of the screens, such as in a shale shaker.

data.Name: screen motion
data.Description: An indicator of the current state of the movement induced by the vibrator(s) of a shale shaker screen

data.Name: screen tension type
data.Description: Type of screen tension (deck tensioned or factory pretensioned)

data.Name: section type
data.Description: Jeffersonian Section Type such as a Lot

data.Name: sedimentary channel type
data.Description: The type of the sedimentary environment that created the channel, e.g. Submarine, Stream, Tidal, etc.

data.Name: sedimentary feature type
data.Description: The type of the sedimentation feature associated with a subsurface or surface Earth region.

data.Name: sedimentary structure type
data.Description: The type of sedimentary structure associated with an interval.

data.Name: sedimentary unit type
data.Description: The type of sedimentary unit e.g. channel, bar, etc.

data.Name: seismic object type
data.Description: Type of seismic data object: data or survey geometry, 2 or 3D

data.Name: sensor type
data.Description: Type of sensor used to acquire data

data.Name: pressure sensor type
data.Description: Pressure sensor type

data.Name: surface sensor type
data.Description: Type of surface sensor such as depth sensor, hydraulics depth sensor, kelly revolution sensor, etc.

data.Name: temperature sensor type
data.Description: Type of temperature sensor

data.Name: separator line
data.Description: Type of separator line: e.g. oil outlet, gas outlet, water outlet or inlet

data.Name: separator type
data.Description: Separator type

data.Name: sequence boundary type
data.Description: The type of a Sequence Boundary in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Toplap, Concordance, Baselap, etc.

data.Name: sequence lower limit type
data.Description: The type of surface situated at the base of a sequence.

data.Name: sequence order
data.Description: The order of a sequence in the depositional process.

data.Name: sequence surface type
data.Description: The type of surface bounding a particular sequence.

data.Name: sequence trend
data.Description: The type of vertical evolution recognized in a particular sequence e.g. fining up.

data.Name: sequence type
data.Description: The type of sequence, e.g. granulometry, thickness, facies, etc.

data.Name: sequence upper limit type
data.Description: The type of limit bounding the top of a sequence.

data.Name: service type
data.Description: Type of service

data.Name: setting mode
data.Description: Mode for setting a plug or packer: by compression or inflation

data.Name: setting tool
data.Description: Generic type of plug or packer setting tool: Drill-Pipe or Wireline

data.Name: shear failure mode
data.Description: Mode, or geometry, of shear failure in a wellbore; depends on the magnitude and direction of the two orthogonal principal wellbore stresses that cause the shear failure.

data.Name: show type
data.Description: The type of hydrocarbon show from a Well or from a Sample (Core, Cuttings, etc.): e.g. Gas, Oil, etc.

data.Name: signal type
data.Description: Type of data signal.

data.Name: snap type
data.Description: When snapping to the Seismic Event Type the application should snap to the Largest or Closest (Valid only for peak or trough)

data.Name: solution gas oil ratio correlation
data.Description: Model used to compute gas solubility in oil

data.Name: structural dip type
data.Description: This property specifies whether the structural dip is constant, variable or contemporaneous.

data.Name: structural model type
data.Description: Structural hypothesis chosen to derive the cross section

data.Name: subsea equipment type
data.Description: Type of subsea equipment installed in facility or used in activity.

data.Name: surface surface intersection type
data.Description: The type of Surface-Surface intersection showing the types of the 2 intersecting surfaces.

data.Name: surface type
data.Description: The type of an Earth surface in the subsurface Earth structure, e.g. Fault, Horizon, Boundary, etc.

data.Name: survey east west
data.Description: Indicates whether survey location is East or West of reference line, such as principal meridian.

data.Name: survey north south
data.Description: Indicates whether survey location is North or South of reference line, such as survey baseline.

data.Name: survey type
data.Description: Type of survey, such as one performed on a Well, e.g., Check Shot or Deviation Survey, or on a Region, Land or Marine, , e.g., Seismic survey.

data.Name: tank type
data.Description: Tank type

data.Name: tectonic cycle type
data.Description: The type of tectonic cycle, i.e. distensive or compressive.

data.Name: tectonic feature type
data.Description: The type of tectonic environment associated with an Earth subsurface, e.g. Fault, Fold, etc.

data.Name: tensile failure mode
data.Description: Mode, or geometry, of tensile failure in a wellbore; depends on the direction of the principal wellbore stress that causes the tensile failure.

data.Name: thread type
data.Description: Type of thread for casing pipe (such as short, long, buttress, extreme line)

data.Name: conn 1 thread type
data.Description: Complete and non ambiguous identification of the first threaded connection, e.g., "Hydril Joint Type EIU", "Pittsburgh Special ACME-Thread Casing-Internal-upset"

data.Name: conn 2 thread type
data.Description: Complete and non ambiguous identification of the second threaded connection, e.g., "Hydril Joint Type EIU", "Pittsburgh Special ACME-Thread Casing-Internal-upset"

data.Name: tool type
data.Description: The type of a Tool usually used in some activity, e.g. CNTA, USIT, AIT, etc.

data.Name: drill survey tool type
data.Description: Generic type of survey tool such as single shot, multi shot, gyro.

data.Name: lwd tool type
data.Description: The type of a tool used for Logging While Drilling.

data.Name: mwd tool type
data.Description: The type of a tool used for Measurement While Drilling.

data.Name: wireline tool type
data.Description: The type of a Tool usually used in some wireline activity, e.g. CNTA, USIT, AIT, etc.

data.Name: treatment flow path
data.Description: Indicates how the fluid is pumped into the well e.g. by the casing, the tubing, the annulus Casing-tubing ...

data.Name: tube upset type
data.Description: Type of upset in tube or body

data.Name: tubular string connect type
data.Description: The string tubular equipment connection number that is at the top. Allowed values are: UNKNOWN, 1st connection, and 2nd connection.

data.Name: tubular string location type
data.Description: The location of the super tubular equipment where the sub tubular equipment is attached. Allowed values are: UNKNOWN, attached outside of super string equipment, and attached inside of super string equipment

data.Name: tubular type
data.Description: The type of a Tubular used in some activity or installed in and part of the well structure, e.g. Casing, Production Tubing, etc.

data.Name: unconformity type
data.Description: The type of an unconformity in the Earth subsurface, e.g. Joint, Disconformity, Diastem, etc.

data.Name: upper surface relation
data.Description: The type of relationship between a surface and the ones above (e.g. the surfaces below a Horizon are onlapping.)

data.Name: volume type
data.Description: The type of an Earth subsurface region or volume, e.g. Formation, Reservoir, Tank, Bed, etc.

data.Name: water rate meter type
data.Description: Type of liquid meter used to measure the water rate

data.Name: wavelet type
data.Description: Type of wavelet used to deconvolve seismic data or to convolve with a basic reflection model to produce synthetic seismic data.

data.Name: well production control mode
data.Description: Describes what controls the production flow of the well (e.g. constant wellhead pressure, constant flowrate)

data.Name: well projection type
data.Description: Characterizes the way a well borehole is projected onto a cross section.

data.Name: well test model
data.Description: Type of well test: e.g. Conventional, Horizontal, Interference, etc.

data.Name: well test model type
data.Description: Type of Well Test Model selected

data.Name: well test type
data.Description: The type of test conducted on a Well.

data.Name: well treatment type
data.Description: Matrix acidizing, Cementing, Acid fracturing, Hydraulic fracturing, Gravel Packing ...

data.Name: wellbore purpose
data.Description: A property indicating the purpose of a wellbore (borehole).

data.Name: wellbore storage type
data.Description: Describes Wellbore storage behavior as either constant, variable (exp), or variable (erf).

data.Name: wellhead connection type
data.Description: Type of wellhead connection (flange, tree- saver ..); data must identity the mechanical item unambiguously to allow a hydraulic connection e.g. Studded Flange API BX150-15000 psi.

data.Name: wetting type
data.Description: Classification of the wetting characteristic of the rock, such as Oil Wet or Water Wet.

data.Name: zone set type
data.Description: The type of a set of zone intervals traversing one or more Boreholes and/or one or more Earth subsurface Volumes.

data.Name: unit productivity index
data.Description: Productivity index per unit of length

data.Name: unknown
data.Description: Unknown property type; used to assert that a specific Property Code cannot be determined from the information provided.

data.Name: velocity
data.Description: The rate of change of the displacement of a body in time.

data.Name: acoustic velocity
data.Description: The velocity of an acoustic wave; the rate at which the wave travels from one point to another. Used generally for all elastic and seismic waves.

data.Name: apparent velocity
data.Description: In seismics, the phase velocity which a wavefront appears to have along a line of geophones. Otherwise, the inverse of the slope of a refraction time-distance curve.

data.Name: avg acoustic velocity
data.Description: Average velocity of an acoustic wave: the distance between two points divided by the travel time of the compressional wave between those points.

data.Name: avg seismic velocity
data.Description: Special usage of Avg_Acoustic_Velocity which deals specifically with the velocity between a reference datum near the surface and some subsurface point; often a vertical path is implied and the velocity is computed as depth divided by seismic travel time.

data.Name: interval velocity
data.Description: Average velocity in a layer or between two subsurface points; generally applied to a rock layer whose velocity can be considered homogeneous. May be derived from stacking velocity using the Dix equation (or a more refined variant).

data.Name: compressional velocity
data.Description: Velocity of a compressional acoustic wave (Vp).

data.Name: fluid compressional velocity
data.Description: Acoustic velocity of an acoustic (compressional) wave in fluid.

data.Name: matrix compressional velocity
data.Description: Acoustic velocity of a compressional wave in a given material or matrix.

data.Name: gas acoustic velocity
data.Description: Sound velocity of gas at reservoir pressure and temperature. Typical value is 200 m/s.

data.Name: group velocity
data.Description: The velocity with which the energy in a wavetrain travels. In dispersive media, it is the velocity of the envelope of the wavetrain.

data.Name: ray velocity
data.Description: The velocity in the direction of energy transport; in anisotropic media it is different from the direction in which the phase velocity is measured. Also called group velocity.

data.Name: migration velocity
data.Description: Velocity applied in seismic migration.

data.Name: mode converted velocity
data.Description: Converted-wave velocity corresponding to a Compressional wave traveling in one direction and a Shear wave traveling the opposite direction, with conversion at the reflector.

data.Name: avg mode converted velocity
data.Description: Average converted-wave velocity from the surface to the reflector. The converted wave velocity is determined from the time taken for the energy to travel in one direction as compressional wave and in the other as shear.

data.Name: interval mode converted velocity
data.Description: Converted-wave velocity measured over a finite interval, with the interval usually determined by geologic layering. The converted wave velocity is determined from the time taken for the energy to travel in one direction as Compressional wave and in the other as Shear.

data.Name: stack mode converted velocity
data.Description: Stacking converted-wave velocity, for a wave traveling through layers as a Compressional wave in one direction and a Shear wave in the other. This can be computed from a combined RMS average of the Compressional and Shear interval velocities.
