In practice it is usually determined directly from velocity analysis on short offset converted wave data.

data.Name: oil acoustic velocity
data.Description: Sound velocity of live oil at reservoir pressure and temperature. Typical value is 1000 m/s.

data.Name: phase velocity
data.Description: The velocity of any given phase (such as a trough) or a wave of single frequency; may differ from Group Velocity due to dispersion in the medium.

data.Name: rayleigh velocity
data.Description: The velocity of a Rayleigh wave (type of seismic wave propagated along the free surface of a semi-infinite medium.

data.Name: rms velocity
data.Description: Transit-time weighted root mean square of the interval velocities over a series if intervals.

data.Name: shear velocity
data.Description: The velocity of a shear wave (Vs); a shear wave is a type of seismic wave in which the particle motion is perpendicular to the direction of propagation; also called S-wave or secondary wave.

data.Name: avg shear velocity
data.Description: Average shear wave velocity, from the surface to the reflector. The shear wave velocity is determined from the two-way vertical time taken for the energy to travel to the reflector and back as a Shear wave.

data.Name: interval shear velocity
data.Description: Interval shear wave velocity, measured over a finite interval, with the interval usually determined by geologic layering.

data.Name: matrix shear velocity
data.Description: Acoustic velocity of a shear wave in a given material or matrix.

data.Name: stack shear velocity
data.Description: Stacking shear wave velocity computed from an RMS average of the Shear interval velocities. In practice it is often determined from velocity analysis on Shear wave data, or indirectly from the stacking velocities for Compressional and Converted wave data.

data.Name: stack velocity
data.Description: The velocity determined from velocity analysis based upon normal-moveout measurements.

data.Name: stoneley velocity
data.Description: The velocity of a Stoneley wave; a Stoneley wave is a type of seismic wave which is propagated along an interface, such as a tube wave in a borehole.

data.Name: velocity at z0
data.Description: (Instantaneous) Velocity at surface reference z=0 (z is time or depth).

data.Name: velocity to seismic datum
data.Description: Velocity of the medium between the zero-time reference of a particular survey to the Seismic Reference Datum.

data.Name: water acoustic velocity
data.Description: Sound velocity in water. Typical value under reservoir conditions is 1550 m/s.

data.Name: weathering velocity
data.Description: Average acoustic velocity of the weathered layer, the near-surface low velocity layer consisting of unconsolidated material and rock in which air rather than water fills the pore space.

data.Name: weathering velocity cdp
data.Description: Weathering velocity at a CDP.

data.Name: cable speed
data.Description: Cable speed, generally measured at the surface as an approximation of tool speed.

data.Name: corrosion rate
data.Description: The rate at which corrosion, a complex chemical or electrochemical process by which metal is destroyed, occurs. For example the rate at which a casing pipe rusts (corrodes).

data.Name: displacement velocity
data.Description: The velocity of the shock or displacement front.

data.Name: erosion rate
data.Description: The rate at which erosion occurs.

data.Name: flow velocity
data.Description: Flow velocity of fluid.

data.Name: apparent fluid velocity
data.Description: Apparent velocity of the fluid.

data.Name: bubble flow velocity
data.Description: The rate at which a fluid bubble, gas or liquid, flows through another fluid, gas or liquid. The Velocity depends on the densities and viscosities of the fluids.

data.Name: erosional velocity
data.Description: The velocity of a flow below which erosional damage to devices such as completion equipment is minimized.

data.Name: gas flow velocity
data.Description: Flow velocity of gas component of fluid.

data.Name: heavy phase flow velocity
data.Description: Flow velocity of heavy phase component of fluid.

data.Name: light phase flow velocity
data.Description: Flow velocity of light phase component of fluid.

data.Name: liquid flow velocity
data.Description: Flow velocity of liquid component of fluid.

data.Name: oil bubble flow velocity
data.Description: Oil Bubble Velocity

data.Name: oil flow velocity
data.Description: Flow velocity of oil component of fluid.

data.Name: slippage velocity
data.Description: In two-phase flow, the difference between the velocities of the two phases.

data.Name: water bubble flow velocity
data.Description: Water Bubble Velocity

data.Name: water flow velocity
data.Description: Flow velocity of water component of fluid.

data.Name: liquid flux per area
data.Description: Liquid flux per area

data.Name: nmr surface relaxivity
data.Description: NMR surface relaxivity

data.Name: penetration rate
data.Description: Usually used to describe the rate at which a formation is penetrated during drilling operation. In general, the rate at which an equipment penetrates a surface or subsurface volume.

data.Name: avg penetration rate
data.Description: Average drilling penetration rate (ROP)

data.Name: running speed
data.Description: Speed of an equipment running into (counted positive) or out of the hole (counted negative).

data.Name: avg running speed
data.Description: Average Speed of equipment running into (counted positive) or out of the hole (counted negative).

data.Name: sedimentation rate
data.Description: The rate at which sedimentation occurs.

data.Name: tool speed
data.Description: Speed of the tool; logging speed.

data.Name: max tool speed
data.Description: Maximum service speed allowed for, or attained by, a logging tool.

data.Name: volume per area per geologic time
data.Description: Describes the volume per area per million years. E.g. the quantity of hydrocarbons generated in a particular area in a certain timeframe
data.Code: volume per area per geologic time

data.Name: wind velocity
data.Description: Velocity of the wind

data.Name: beaufort scale number
data.Description: The Beaufort wind scale is a system used to estimate and report wind speeds when no measuring apparatus is available. It was invented in the early 19th century by Admiral Sir Francis Beaufort of the British Navy as a way to interpret winds from conditions at sea, e.g. 5 on the Beaufort scale corresponds to a wind of 17-21 knots and is defined as "Fresh Breeze: Moderate waves (1.8m), many white horses."

data.Name: velocity squared
data.Description: The square of a velocity

data.Name: viscosibility
data.Description: Normalized derivative of viscosity: -(dv/dp)/v where v=viscosity and p=pressure.

data.Name: water viscosibility
data.Description: Normalized derivative of viscosity for water: -(dv/dp)/v where v=viscosity and p=pressure.

data.Name: viscosity
data.Description: The property of a substance offering internal resistance to flow; a measure of the degree of fluidity.

data.Name: apparent viscosity
data.Description: Ratio Shear Stress/Shear Rate. Equal to Newtonian Viscosity for Newtonian fluid.

data.Name: filtrate viscosity
data.Description: The viscosity of the fluid filtrate i.e the viscosity of the fluid which crossed the filtering media.

data.Name: fluid viscosity
data.Description: The viscosity of a fluid (sample) at specific temperature and pressure conditions.

data.Name: funnel viscosity
data.Description: Time needed for a given quantity of fluid (generally a quart of mud) to flow into a specified size funnel (3/16 inch id tube of a 12 inch long funnel). Used for drilling fluids.

data.Name: gas viscosity
data.Description: The viscosity of a gas at specific temperature and pressure conditions.

data.Name: kinematic viscosity
data.Description: The dynamic viscosity of a fluid divided by the density of the fluid.

data.Name: liquid viscosity
data.Description: The viscosity of a liquid at specific temperature and pressure conditions.

data.Name: newtonian viscosity
data.Description: Slope of Shear Stress/Shear Rate curve for the Newtonian rheology model (Shear Stress proportional to Shear Rate)

data.Name: oil viscosity
data.Description: The viscosity of oil at specific temperature and pressure conditions.

data.Name: plastic viscosity
data.Description: Apparent viscosity of the Bingham Plastic model : Slope of the curve shear stress vs. shear rate (rheogram). Model equation is Shear_Stress = Yield_Stress + Plastic_Viscosity times Shear_Rate.

data.Name: api plastic viscosity
data.Description: Measure of the internal resistance to fluid flow attributable to the amount, type, and size of solids present in a given fluid. When using the direct-indicating viscometer, it is found by subtracting the 300-rpm reading from the 600-rpm reading of a Fann35 rheometer.

data.Name: casson plastic viscosity
data.Description: Measure of the internal resistance to fluid flow attributable to the amount, type, and size of solids present in a given fluid. The Casson model equation is: SQRT(Shear_Stress) = SQRT(Yield_Stress) + SQRT(Plastic_Viscosity X Shear_Rate)

data.Name: reservoir fluid viscosity
data.Description: The viscosity of reservoir fluid at specific temperature and pressure conditions.

data.Name: water viscosity
data.Description: The viscosity of water at specific temperature and pressure conditions.

data.Name: vitrinite reflectance
data.Description: The optical reflectivity of solid organic constituents of rock, known as vitrinite, which provides an indication of thermal maturity.

data.Name: volume
data.Description: A measure of the space occupied by a body in cubic units; e.g., cm3, in3, quarts, liters, etc.

data.Name: annulus volume
data.Description: The volume of the portion of the borehole which lies between the borehole wall and the casing.

data.Name: borehole volume
data.Description: The volume of the borehole.

data.Name: cumulative borehole volume
data.Description: Cumulative volume of the borehole (integrated over length of borehole).

data.Name: estimated borehole volume
data.Description: The estimated volume of the Open Hole used in fluid volume/placement computations

data.Name: cement volume
data.Description: Volume of cement.

data.Name: cumulative cement volume
data.Description: Cumulative volume of cement (may be integrated over length of borehole or over time of cementing operation).

data.Name: cumulative production volume
data.Description: Volume of fluids produced by a zone or interval since the beginning of the production

data.Name: cumulative condensate volume
data.Description: Cumulative condensate production.

data.Name: cumulative gas volume
data.Description: Cumulative gas production at standard conditions. At constant BHP or WHP, cumulative volume is not the straightforward sum of volume by RHU but determined by Inverse Laplace transformation.

data.Name: cumulative oil volume
data.Description: Cumulative oil production at standard conditions. At constant BHP or WHP, cumulative volume is not the straightforward sum of volume by RHU but determined by Inverse Laplace transformation.

data.Name: cumulative water volume
data.Description: Cumulative water production at standard conditions.

data.Name: cumulative volume
data.Description: The cumulative volume, typically of a fluid.

data.Name: cumulative water influx
data.Description: The cumulative volume of water that encroaches into a reservoir.

data.Name: dead volume
data.Description: Volume of material remaining in a container after normal emptying procedure, and thus not available for use.

data.Name: displacing fluid volume
data.Description: Volume of fluid used to displace another fluid. In special core analysis, may be expressed as unitless multiple of pore volume.

data.Name: drill fluid volume
data.Description: Volume of drilling fluid

data.Name: filtrate volume
data.Description: Volume of filtrate, such as recovered from an API Fluid Loss test. API RP13 Section 3

data.Name: hthp filtrate volume
data.Description: Volume of filtrate produced under high temperature, high pressure (HTHP) conditions.

data.Name: ltlp filtrate volume
data.Description: Volume of filtrate produced under low temperature, low pressure (LTLP) conditions.

data.Name: fluid loss
data.Description: The volume of drilling fluid filtrate which is obtained in a filtration test under specific test conditions; used as an indication of the expected rate of filtrate invasion into the formation during drilling.

data.Name: fluid volume
data.Description: Volume of fluid.

data.Name: mud tank volume
data.Description: The volume of a mud tank or pit

data.Name: fracture conductivity
data.Description: Fracture permeability - width product of a finite conductivity vertical or horizontal fracture.

data.Name: dimensionless fracture conductivity
data.Description: Ratio of fracture conductivity (fracture permeability x average width) to the (matrix permeability x fracture half_length) product. Standard industry acronym : "FCD", S.P.E. preferred form "CfD".

data.Name: gross rock volume
data.Description: Total rock volume from a top reservoir surface to a contact, usually the oil-water contact

data.Name: initial gas volume

data.Name: initial in situ gas volume

data.Name: initial in situ oil volume

data.Name: initial oil volume

data.Name: initial water volume

data.Name: kick tolerance volume

data.Name: liquid production volume

data.Name: matrix volume
data.Description: The volume of material in a porous system that does not include the volume of the pores.

data.Name: max volume
data.Description: The maximum volume not to be exceeded for a container (Tank, Mud Pit)

data.Name: mf titration volume
data.Description: Amount of 0.02 normal (N/50) standard sulfuric acid required in order to turn the color of methyl orange indicator solution from yellow to pink when determining methyl orange alkalinity of the mud filtrate, Mf, API RP13 Section 8, Chemical Analysis.

data.Name: nom liquid capacity
data.Description: Volume of fluid which can be contained in the vessel

data.Name: permeability thickness
data.Description: The product of permeability and thickness of the body acting as a conduit.

data.Name: net pay permeability thickness
data.Description: Thickness of the permeable net pay portion of the zone i.e., the product of the Net Pay Thickness and Net Pay Average Permeability

data.Name: net reservoir permeability thickness
data.Description: The product of the Net Reservoir Thickness and Net Reservoir Average Permeability.

data.Name: total permeability thickness
data.Description: Total permeability-thickness [= kh(1) + kh(2)] for a vertical interference test

data.Name: permeability length
data.Description: A permeability length used in rel per calculations

data.Name: pf titration volume

data.Name: pm titration volume
data.Description: Amount of 0.02 normal (N/50) standard sulfuric acid required in order to turn the color of phenolphthalein indicator solution from pink to colorless when determining phenolphthalein alkalinity of the mud, Pm, API RP13 Section 8, Chemical Analysis.

data.Name: pore volume
data.Description: The volume within a geologic volume that describes the connected void space within the matrix of rock.

data.Name: hydrocarbon pore volume
data.Description: The pore volume of a reservoir occupied by hydrocarbons in either the vapor or liquid phase.

data.Name: rat hole volume
data.Description: Available volume of fluids below testing valve. The rat hole is the section of the borehole running from the tester valve to the effective bottom of the well. The calculation of this volume is not straight-forward as the rat hole is not generally empty.

data.Name: remaining volume
data.Description: Volume of material which remains (e.g. remaining volume to be pumped)

data.Name: reservoir production volume
data.Description: Volume of fluids produced from a reservoir

data.Name: stage volume

data.Name: thorium concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Thorium

data.Name: uranium concentration
data.Description: Concentration of Uranium

data.Name: bulk density correction
data.Description: Correction to the Bulk Density log, as measured with a Gamma-gamma type logging device; used as an indication of hole condition to validate the Bulk_Density measurement; conventionally abbreviated DRHO.

data.Name: nominal weight
data.Description: The weight of a tubular such as casing or drillpipe that has been calculated based on a formula involving diameter and wall thickness of the tubular.

data.Name: scale deposit per length
data.Description: Scale deposit per length

data.Name: rugosity
data.Description: A measure of surface irregularity, such as of the borehole wall.

data.Name: absolute roughness
data.Description: Average amplitude of rugosity, such as the variations in the radius of tubing.

data.Name: density gradient
data.Description: A measure of the change in the density of a material per unit length.

data.Name: flowrate gradient
data.Description: A measure of the change in the flowrate of a fluid per unit length.

data.Name: irradiance
data.Description: Radiant flux per unit area

data.Name: dimensionless well x position
data.Description: Well position expressed as fraction of rectangle length ("xbx")

data.Name: dimensionless well y position
data.Description: Well position expressed as fraction of rectangle width ("yby")

data.Name: normalized distance
data.Description: Normalized distance to the center of a point cluster in multi-dimensional attribute-space.

data.Name: dimensionless borehole radius
data.Description: Dimensionless Borehole Radius ("rwD")

data.Name: dimensionless interwell distance
data.Description: Dimensionless inter-well distance for a horizontal interference test

data.Name: dimensionless rectangle height
data.Description: Rectangle height divided by reference length ("ByD")

data.Name: dimensionless rectangle length
data.Description: Rectangle length divided by reference length ("BxD")

data.Name: dimensionless rectangle width
data.Description: Rectangle width divided by reference length ("ByD")

data.Name: dimensionless boundary distance
data.Description: Distance to a boundary divided by wellbore radius

data.Name: standoff ratio
data.Description: A measure of standoff of tubular equipment from the borehole wall, computed as the ratio of Standoff to the difference between hole radius and tubular radius; Standoff Ratio is 0 if the tubular is in contact with the hole wall, 1 if the tubular is centered in the hole.

data.Name: length per rotation
data.Description: Length per angle of rotation

data.Name: penetration per rotation
data.Description: It is usually used to describe the formation penetrated distance per drill bit rotation during drilling operation.

data.Name: relative permeability
data.Description: The ratio of effective permeability divided by the absolute permeability; e.g. the relative permeability of a rock to that of any of its contained fluids.

data.Name: relative permeability gas
data.Description: Ratio of effective gas permeability to absolute permeability. Usually abbreviated as Krg

data.Name: relative permeability oil
data.Description: Ratio of effective oil permeability to absolute permeability. Usually abbreviated as Kro.

data.Name: relative permeability water
data.Description: Ratio of effective water permeability to absolute permeability. Usually abbreviated as Krw.

data.Name: dielectric constant
data.Description: The ratio of the Permittivity of a material to that of free space.

data.Name: rig pitch angle
data.Description: Measure of the fore-aft rotational movement of the rig due the combined effects of wind and waves.

data.Name: rig roll angle
data.Description: Measure of the side-to-side rotational movement of the rig due the combined effects of wind and waves; measured as the angle from vertical.

data.Name: background pressure trend
data.Description: Background pressure trend for a horizontal interference test

data.Name: co2 foam quality
data.Description: Ratio volume of CO2 over foam volume. Indicator of the quality of a foam generated with CO2 for well treatment. Below 50% the foam is not stable, above 95% the foam changes to a mist. C02 foam are used when low pH is required.

data.Name: displacement efficiency
data.Description: The fraction of displaceable fluids/hydrocarbons that has been actually displaced when contacted by a displacing fluid.

data.Name: fracturing efficiency
data.Description: Ratio of Fracture Volume at end of job to Total Volume Pumped. The difference between the two volumes represents the volume which leaked off into the formation.

data.Name: energy half time
data.Description: Time, within a specified interval, at which half the energy of the interval occurs

data.Name: fracture bridging factor
data.Description: Ratio of fracture width to mean proppant diameter (Industry usage: 2.5.) below which bridging will occur (proppant cannot move through the fracture).

data.Name: geostress ratio
data.Description: The ratio of any two far-field principal stresses in the earth; see subtypes.

data.Name: max horizontal to min horizontal geostress ratio
data.Description: Ratio of maximum horizontal to minimum horizontal stress. (Normally abbreviated SH/Sh)
data.Code: max horizontal to min horizontal geostress ratio

data.Name: min horizontal to vertical geostress ratio
data.Description: Ratio of minimum horizontal to vertical stress. (Normally abbreviated Sh/SV)
data.Code: min horizontal to vertical geostress ratio

data.Name: layer transmissibility ratio
data.Description: Ratio of layer transmissibility to total transmissibility ("kappaj")

data.Name: n2 foam quality
data.Description: Ratio volume of N2 over foam volume . Indicator of the quality of a foam generated with N2 for well treatment. Below 50% the foam is not stable, above 95% the foam changes to a mist.

data.Name: reduced pressure
data.Description: The pressure of a fluid divided by the critical pressure of the fluid.

data.Name: relative power
data.Description: Ratio of two powers

data.Name: volume fraction
data.Description: The ratio of the volumes occupied by two components, or by one component to the total volume of the system.

data.Name: albite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of albite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: anhydrite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of anhydrite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: ash volume fraction

data.Name: biotite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of biotite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: calcite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of calcite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: carbon volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of carbon with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: carbonate volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of carbonate rock with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: chlorite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of chlorite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: clay volume fraction
data.Description: Volume fraction of clay as calculated, measured or inferred from formation properties.

data.Name: net pay clay volume fraction
data.Description: Average clay volume fraction in the net pay portion of the zone interval (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

data.Name: net reservoir clay volume fraction
data.Description: Average volume fraction of clay in the Net Reservoir portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

data.Name: coal gas concentration
data.Description: Coal gas concentration as a volume ratio

data.Name: coal volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of coal with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: dolomite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of dolomite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: dry clay volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of dry clay with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: evaporite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of evaporitic rock with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: feldspar volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of feldspar with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: flushed zone dissolved salt volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of dissolved salt in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.
data.Code: flushed zone dissolved salt volume fraction

data.Name: flushed zone fluid volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of fluid in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: flushed zone obmf volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of oil-based mud filtrate in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: formation volume factor
data.Description: The ratio of the volume occupied by a fluid at specified conditions, such as reservoir conditions, to the volume which would be occupied at standard conditions.

data.Name: gas formation volume factor
data.Description: Ratio of gas volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions to the gas volume at surface (stock tank) conditions. Normally abbreviated Bg.

data.Name: liquid formation volume factor
data.Description: Ratio of total liquid volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions to the total liquid volume at surface (stock tank) conditions.

data.Name: oil formation volume factor
data.Description: For a sample of oil and its residual solution gas at surface, the ratio of the volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions to the volume at surface (stock tank) conditions. Normally abbreviated Bo; typical range 1.1 - 2.

data.Name: total formation volume factor
data.Description: Ratio of fluid volume (liquid + total solution gas) at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions to the volume of liquid and residual solution gas at surface (stock tank) conditions. Used for two-phase systems; abbreviated Bt; typical range 1.1 - 200.

data.Name: water formation volume factor
data.Description: Ratio of water volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions to the water volume at surface (stock tank) conditions. Normally abbreviated Bw; typical range .99 - 1.07.

data.Name: gas fluid ratio
data.Description: The ratio of gas within a fluid otherwise named foam quality when the gas is used to foam the fluid.

data.Name: gas fraction
data.Description: Volumetric fraction of gas in the total fluid

data.Name: mud background gas factor
data.Description: Drill fluid background gas content as output by the chromatograph in circulating conditions.

data.Name: mud connection gas factor
data.Description: Drill fluid gas content spike as output by the chromatograph after stopping circulation in order to make or break connections.

data.Name: mud total gas
data.Description: The total hydrocarbon content of the drilling fluid, by volume concentration

data.Name: mud trip gas factor
data.Description: Bottom hole drill fluid gas content spike as output by the chromatograph after stopping circulation for a significant time interval such as when tripping into the hole.

data.Name: gas liquid ratio
data.Description: Volume ratio of gas to liquid (oil + water) in a volume of fluid.

data.Name: producing gas liquid ratio
data.Description: The ratio of produced gas to produced liquid (oil + water) at the wellhead

data.Name: solution gas liquid ratio
data.Description: The ratio of dissolved gas volume to total liquid (oil + water) volume

data.Name: wellhead producing gas liquid ratio
data.Description: Ratio of volume of gas to volume of liquids produced at the wellhead.

data.Name: gas oil ratio
data.Description: A measure of the volume of gas which is produced with a given quantity of oil.

data.Name: free gas oil ratio
data.Description: The ratio of the volume of free gas to the volume of oil for a reservoir fluid at standard conditions.

data.Name: initial gas oil ratio
data.Description: Gas-Oil Ratio at the beginning of the production.

data.Name: reservoir gas oil ratio
data.Description: The ratio of gas to oil of the reservoir fluid at reservoir condition

data.Name: solution gas oil ratio
data.Description: Measure of the degree to which a gas is soluble in oil; ratio of the dissolved gas volume to liquid hydrocarbon volume, often designated Rs Oil

data.Name: gas volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of gas with respect to the total volume; the product of Porosity and Gas_Saturation

data.Name: flushed zone gas volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of gas in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: undisturbed zone gas volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of gas in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: glauconite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of glauconite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: gypsum volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of gypsum with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: halite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of halite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: holdup
data.Description: In a producing well, the volume fraction of a specific fluid phase in the upward-moving stream. The relative quantities of fluids produced are related to the holdup and upward velocity of each phase.

data.Name: gas holdup
data.Description: Volume fraction of gas in the upward-moving stream of a producing well.

data.Name: oil holdup
data.Description: Volume fraction of oil in the upward-moving stream of a producing well.

data.Name: water holdup
data.Description: Volume fraction of water in the upward-moving stream of a producing well.

data.Name: hydrocarbon volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of hydrocarbon with respect to the total volume; the product of porosity and hydrocarbon saturation

data.Name: flushed zone hydrocarbon volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of hydrocarbon in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: moved hydrocarbon volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of moved hydrocarbons with respect to the total volume; moved hydrocarbons are those which have been displaced from the flushed zone by the invasion process.

data.Name: net pay moved hc volume fraction
data.Description: Net pay moved hydrocarbon volume fraction: moved oil saturation (Sxo-Sw) in the net pay of the zone multiplied by the net pay average porosity.
data.Code: net pay moved hc volume fraction

data.Name: residual hydrocarbon volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of residual hydrocarbons with respect to the total volume; residual hydrocarbons are those still in place in the flushed zone after the invasion process.

data.Name: undisturbed zone hydrocarbon volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of hydrocarbon in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: igneous volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of igneous rock with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: illite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of illite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: inverse formation volume factor
data.Description: The ratio of the volume occupied by a fluid at standard conditions to the volume which would be occupied at specified conditions, such as reservoir conditions.

data.Name: inverse gas formation volume factor
data.Description: Ratio of gas volume at surface (stock tank) conditions to the gas volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions.

data.Name: inverse liquid formation volume factor
data.Description: Ratio of total liquid volume at surface (stock tank) conditions to the total liquid volume at specified (typically, reservoir) conditions.

data.Name: isolated porosity volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of isolated porosity with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: kaolinite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of kaolinite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: liquid gas ratio
data.Description: Volume ratio of liquid (oil + water) to gas in a volume of fluid.

data.Name: wellhead producing liquid gas ratio
data.Description: Ratio of volume of liquids to volume of gas produced at the wellhead; used primarily to express the amount of condensate produced in gas wells; typical unit is barrel per million cubic feet (RP66: 1E-6 bbl/ft3)

data.Name: max shale volume fraction
data.Description: Maximum value of Shale/Clay volume fraction

data.Name: metamorphic volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of metamorphic rock with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: mineral concentration
data.Description: Volume of a particular mineral per unit volume of the investigated material, such as a sample.

data.Name: montmorillonite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of illite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: muscovite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of muscovite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: nmr 3d map
data.Description: Map of volume fractions for different transverse relaxation times (T2), different diffusion coefficients (DC), and different relaxation time ratios (T1/T2); normally represented as a series of 2D maps of volume fraction values indexed by T2 and DC components, with each 2D map representing one T1/T2 ratio.

data.Name: nmr dc distribution
data.Description: Distribution of volume fractions for different values of diffusion coefficients (DC); normally represented as a waveform of volume fraction values indexed by DC components.

data.Name: nmr dct1 map
data.Description: Map of volume fractions for different diffusion coefficients (DC) and different longitudinal relaxation times (T1); normally represented as a 2d map of volume fraction values indexed by DC components along the y-axis and T1 components along the x-axis.

data.Name: nmr dct2 map
data.Description: Map of volume fractions for different diffusion coefficients (DC) and different transverse relaxation times (T2); normally represented as a 2d map of volume fraction values indexed by DC components along the y-axis and T2 components along the x-axis.

data.Name: nmr relaxation time ratio distribution
data.Description: Distribution of volume fractions for different values of relaxation time ratios (T1/T2); normally represented as a waveform of volume fraction values indexed by T1/T2 components.

data.Name: nmr t1 distribution
data.Description: Distribution of volume fractions for different values of longitudinal relaxation times (T1); normally represented as a waveform of volume fraction values indexed by T1 components.

data.Name: nmr t1t2 map
data.Description: Map of volume fractions for different longitudinal relaxation times (T1) and different transverse relaxation times (T2); normally represented as a 2d map of volume fraction values indexed by T1 components along the y-axis and T2 components along the x-axis.

data.Name: nmr t2 distribution
data.Description: Distribution of volume fractions for different values of transverse relaxation time (T2); normally represented as a waveform of volume fraction values indexed by T2 components.

data.Name: oil brine ratio
data.Description: Ratio of oil volume to brine volume for a fluid, such as an oil based mud

data.Name: oil concentration
data.Description: Oil Concentration per fluid Volume

data.Name: oil fraction
data.Description: Volumetric fraction of oil in the total fluid

data.Name: oil gas ratio
data.Description: Ratio of the volume of oil (including condensate) to that of gas.

data.Name: oil volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of oil with respect to the total volume; the product of Porosity and Oil_Saturation

data.Name: flushed zone oil volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of oil in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: undisturbed zone oil volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of oil in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: oil water ratio
data.Description: Ratio of oil volume to water volume for a fluid, such as an oil based mud

data.Name: orthoclase volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of orthoclase with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: parallel porosity volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of parallel porosity with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: porosity
data.Description: Pore volume per unit gross volume. Porosity is determined from measurements on cores or interpreted from logs.

data.Name: apparent porosity
data.Description: Initial estimate of porosity, normally from logs, not corrected for the (often large) effects of clays, gas, etc. Such estimates should only be used for qualitative interpretation of clean, gas-free intervals.

data.Name: bin porosity
data.Description: Contribution of porosity from a given "bin" (with certain characteristics) to the total porosity; e.g., in nuclear magnetic resonance data processing, the "bins" typically correspond to different pore size ranges.

data.Name: crossplot porosity
data.Description: Estimate of porosity determined by plotting one type of data against another.

data.Name: density porosity
data.Description: Porosity derived from a formation density measurement.

data.Name: density porosity dolomite
data.Description: Porosity derived from a formation density measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is dolomite.

data.Name: density porosity limestone
data.Description: Porosity derived from a formation density measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is calcite.

data.Name: density porosity sandstone
data.Description: Porosity derived from a formation density measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is quartz.

data.Name: neutron porosity
data.Description: Porosity as measured with an neutron logging device.

data.Name: epithermal neutron porosity
data.Description: Porosity as measured with an epithermal neutron device.

data.Name: matrix epithermal neutron porosity
data.Description: Matrix response of an epithermal neutron porosity logging device.

data.Name: neutron porosity dolomite
data.Description: Porosity derived from a neutron logging measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is dolomite.

data.Name: neutron porosity limestone
data.Description: Porosity derived from a neutron logging measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is calcite.

data.Name: neutron porosity sandstone
data.Description: Porosity derived from a neutron logging measurement, assuming that the rock matrix material is quartz.

data.Name: thermal neutron porosity
data.Description: Porosity as measured with a thermal neutron logging device.

data.Name: matrix thermal neutron porosity
data.Description: Matrix response of a thermal neutron porosity logging device.

data.Name: nmr porosity
data.Description: Apparent formation porosity as measured with an nuclear magnetic logging device.

data.Name: sonic porosity
data.Description: Porosity calculated using the acoustic slowness measurement from a sonic log.

data.Name: sonic porosity dolomite
data.Description: Porosity calculated using the compressional wave travel time measurement from an acoustic log with a dolomite matrix travel time.

data.Name: sonic porosity limestone
data.Description: Porosity calculated using the compressional wave travel time measurement from an acoustic log with a limestone matrix travel time.

data.Name: sonic porosity sandstone
data.Description: Porosity calculated using the compressional wave travel time measurement from an acoustic log with a sandstone matrix travel time.

data.Name: standoff porosity
data.Description: Porosity measurement of the "standoff" region, a very shallow porosity determination used to correct formation porosity measurements from nuclear logging tools.

data.Name: avg porosity
data.Description: Average value of the material Porosity.

data.Name: effective porosity
data.Description: The porosity available to free fluids, excluding non-connected porosity and space occupied by bound water.

data.Name: gross porosity
data.Description: The average porosity in a gross thickness interval or a group of intervals.

data.Name: interval porosity
data.Description: Interval value of the material Porosity (Porosity for a layer).

data.Name: min porosity
data.Description: Minimum value for Porosity

data.Name: net pay porosity
data.Description: Average Porosity of the levels which satisfy "pay zone" criteria; such criteria typically include cutoffs for clay content, porosity, water saturation and permeability.

data.Name: net reservoir core porosity point match

data.Name: net reservoir log porosity point match
data.Description: Average porosity in the Net Reservoir portion of the summation interval, computed from log data by point-match method.
data.Code: net reservoir log porosity point match

data.Name: net reservoir porosity
data.Description: Average porosity in the Net Reservoir portion of the zone (thickness weighted arithmetic average).

data.Name: primary porosity
data.Description: The porosity remaining after sediments have been deposited but without considering changes because of subsequent chemical action or water flow.

data.Name: secondary porosity
data.Description: The additional porosity created by chemical changes, specially fissures, fractures, solution vugs and dolomitization.

data.Name: total porosity
data.Description: The total volume fraction of a rock which is occupied by fluid; includes all forms of porosity, including that occupied by bound fluids, and is independent of rock and fluid materials and of environmental effects

data.Name: potash volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of potash with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: pyrite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of pyrite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: qfm volume fraction

data.Name: quartz volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of quartz with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: recovery factor
data.Description: Recovery factor of reservoir fluids expressed as the ratio of standard volumes (stock tank barrels, etc.) recovered to pore volume.

data.Name: reduced volume
data.Description: The volume of a fluid divided by the critical volume of the fluid.

data.Name: sand volume fraction
data.Description: Volume fraction of sand as calculated, measured or inferred from formation properties.

data.Name: shale volume fraction
data.Description: Volume fraction of shale as calculated, measured or inferred from formation properties.

data.Name: shrinkage factor
data.Description: A measure of the decrease in volume of the liquid phase caused by release of solution gas and/or by the thermal contraction of the liquid; the reciprocal of formation volume factor.

data.Name: siderite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of siderite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: silt volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of silt with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: smectite volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of smectite with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: tar volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of tar with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: total organic carbon

data.Name: total organic matter

data.Name: trona volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of trona with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: vapor oil-gas ratio

data.Name: water activity

data.Name: water concentration

data.Name: water cut

data.Name: wellhead producing water cut

data.Name: water fraction

data.Name: water volume fraction

data.Name: bound water volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of bound Water with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: flushed zone free water volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of free water in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: flushed zone irreducible water volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of irreducible water in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: flushed zone water volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of water in the flushed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: undisturbed zone free water volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of free water in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Name: undisturbed zone water volume fraction
data.Description: The volume fraction of water in the undisturbed zone with respect to the total volume.

data.Description: Water oil ratio when a sample is taken
